4a0b98aa.description:
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
   

  

**Job Description**
***Job Family Definition:***
 Provides leadership to drive AI, Automation, and Analytics initiatives. Manages end\-to\-end lifecycle of AI/ML, automation, and data analytics Programs/Projects. Manages project teams and resources including planning, scheduling, tracking progress, communicating status, and managing risk across a matrixed organization to deliver measurable outcomes.
   

  

**Management Level Definition**
 Contributions include applying developed expertise in AI, Automation, and Analytics to solve moderately complex problems. Recommends solution approaches. May act as Project lead. Exercises independent judgment while working with cross\-functional teams for assigned work within defined policies and procedures.
   

  

**HPE Operations** 
 is our innovative IT services organization. It provides the expertise to advise, integrate, and accelerate our customers’ outcomes from their digital transformation. Our teams collaborate to transform insight into innovation. In today’s fast paced, hybrid IT world, being at business speed means overcoming IT complexity to match the speed of actions to the speed of opportunities. Deploy the right technology to respond quickly to market possibilities. Join us and redefine what’s next for you
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
***Responsibilities:***
* Manages and leads a program involving one or more functions and project teams to drive the engineering development and implementation process for a subsystem or component of a product or service offering.
* Manages AI, Automation, and Analytics programs involving one or more functions and Project teams.
* Develops program/project roadmaps, schedules, deliverables, budgets.
* Collaborates and Coordinates activities across data scientists, automation developers, and stakeholders.
* Communicates progress, escalations, and issue analysis to leadership and stakeholders.
* Tracks progress against established plan and makes decisions to alter or update schedule and resource allocation to meet
* Ensures adherence to budgets and established product roadmaps and schedules.
* Leads and provides guidance and mentoring to less\-experienced staff members.


**What You Need To Bring**
***Education and Experience Required:***
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Management, Engineering, Computer Sciences, or equivalent.
* PMP/PMI certification preferred.
* Typically, 4\-6 years of experience in program management with digital transformation OR AI Automation \& Analytics experience.


**Knowledge And Skills**
* Using project planning tools and software packages to create, manage, and track project results.
* Understanding AI/ML lifecycle, automation tools, and data analytics
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating and directing matrixed teams and resources.
* Ability to create and manage program schedules, budgets, and resource allocation plans.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; mastery in English and local language.
* Ability to effectively communicate program plans, proposals, and results, and negotiate options at management levels.


**What We Can Offer You**
**Health \& Wellbeing**
 We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.
   

  

**Personal \& Professional Development**
 We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
   

  

**Unconditional Inclusion**
 We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

e16ae92c.title: Solutions Architect - Customer Excellence Optimization
e16ae92c.description:
**About Us**
 Planful is the pioneer of financial performance management cloud software. The Planful platform, which helps businesses drive peak financial performance, is used around the globe to streamline business\-wide planning, budgeting, consolidations, reporting, and analytics. Planful’s award\-winning AI capabilities accelerate decision\-making, helping Planful users in over 100 countries to close faster, accelerate cycle times, increase productivity, and improve accuracy. Planful is a private company with more than 1,500 customers, including Bose, Boston Red Sox, Five Guys, Grafton Plc, Gousto, and Specialized, and is backed by Vector Capital, a leading global private equity firm. Learn more at Planful.com.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Planful is seeking a customer\-focused Solution Architect to join our Customer Success team. As a Customer Optimization Solution Architect, you will be an expert working with existing Planful customers evaluating their current business processes, use cases and application challenges, finance transformation goals, and technology needs. You will bring deep experience in financial performance management and a strong understanding of how EPM solutions support planning, budgeting, forecasting, consolidations, reporting, and analytics.
   

  

 Planful is looking for a dynamic, high\-energy professional with prior hands\-on experience working with EPM tools and at least 3\+ years of experience on EPM solutions and FP\&A background. In this role, you will partner closely with Account Management, Customer Success, Support and other cross\-functional teams to support existing customers reviewing the current architecture of their application.
   

  

**Requirements**
* Strong finance background with at least 3\+ years’ experience in FP\&A and EPM tools.
* Ability to understand and explain both business and technical issues related to a customer’s proposed solution.
* A collaborative and customer centric mindset to help customers with their finance performance management.
* Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple customer engagements and priorities simultaneously.
* Ability to deliver product demos and presentations to finance, accounting, and executive audiences.


**Responsibilities**
* Lead conversation with customers to understand their ongoing challenges with existing setup and come up with optimal solutions.
* Maintain strong product competence by staying current on new product enhancements, best practices, and market trends across the EPM domain.
* Cross collaborates with internal teams, Customer Success, Account Management, Product and Engineering teams to support customers.
* Serves as an expert on Planful FP\&A suite and shares best practices with customers around FP\&A practices.
* Act as an escalation point for complex functional challenges, focusing on root cause analysis and long\-term resolution
* Proactively identify risks, gaps, and opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations to improve outcomes
* Assess existing customer configurations and recommend enhancements aligned to current and future business needs


**Why Planful**
 Planful Exists To Enrich The World By Helping Our Customers And Our People Achieve Peak Performance. To Foster The Best In Class Work We’re So Proud Of, We’ve Created a Best In Class Culture, Including
   

  

* Volunteer days, Birthday PTO, and company\-wide Wellness Days
* Supply of diapers and meal deliveries for the first month of your Maternity/Paternity leave
* Office hubs in Hyderabad and Indore. Employees also receive benefits such as a home office setup allowance, as well as monthly reimbursements for Wi\-Fi and cell phone expenses.
* Join Employee Resource Groups like Women of Planful, Parents of Planful, and more. We celebrate individuality and encourage teammates to bring their authentic selves to work \- with full support for creating new ERGs and communities along the way
* Participate in People Programs that foster connection and wellbeing, such as Movember, Summer Wellness, Breast Cancer Awareness Month, and Hispanic Heritage Month

1657bea6.title: Azure Architect (Data and AI)
1657bea6.description:
**Roles \& Responsibilities**

* Design end\-to\-end data architecture on Azure covering ingestion, storage, transformation, governance, and consumption layers
* Define reference architectures using Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, and Azure SQL/Cosmos DB
* Architect AI/ML and Generative AI solutions using Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, and Cognitive Services
* Design data governance, security, and compliance frameworks using Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog, and Azure security best practices
* Create solution blueprints, high\-level and low\-level design documents, and target\-state architecture diagrams
* Partner with sales teams on customer discovery calls to understand current data landscape, pain points, and business goals
* Lead technical solutioning for RFPs/RFIs, prepare architecture proposals, effort estimates, and delivery roadmaps
* Deliver architecture presentations, PoCs, and demos to technical and business stakeholders
* Support commercial teams with technical positioning of Azure Data \& AI offerings against customer requirements
* Provide hands\-on architectural oversight during implementation, ensuring adherence to design and Azure best practices
* Guide data engineering and data science teams on pipeline design, data modeling, MLOps, and deployment patterns
* Review code, pipelines, and infrastructure\-as\-code for architectural compliance, performance, and cost optimization
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues and provide escalation support during critical project phases
* Mentor engineers and consultants on Azure data platform and AI capabilities

**Ideal Candidate**

* Strong Azure Data \& AI Architect Profile with pre\-sales solutioning and hands\-on delivery leadership
* Mandatory (Experience 1\): Must have 10\+ years overall, with 8\+ years in Azure Data/AI architecture, and proven experience architecting and delivering large\-scale data platforms on Microsoft Azure
* Mandatory (Experience 2 ): Must be able to design end\-to\-end Azure data architecture (ingestion, storage, transformation, governance, consumption), create reference architectures, and produce solution blueprints, HLD/LLD, and target\-state diagrams.
* Mandatory (Experience 3\): Must have pre\-sales experience — customer discovery, technical solutioning for RFPs/RFIs, architecture proposals, effort/cost estimation, delivery roadmaps, and architecture presentations/PoCs/demos.
* Mandatory (Experience 4 ): Must have provided hands\-on architectural oversight during delivery (Well\-Architected Framework), guiding data engineering/science teams on pipeline design, data modeling, MLOps, and deployment, and reviewing code/pipelines/IaC for compliance, performance, and cost
* Mandatory (Experience 5 – Microsoft Partner): Must have prior experience in a Microsoft Partner organization, with direct involvement in achieving/maintaining the Data \& AI (Azure) Solutions Partner designation, and hands\-on contribution to passing the Microsoft Data \& AI specialization audit (customer success references, skilling, performance evidence)
* Mandatory (Tech skill 1\): Must have strong expertise in Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric, and/or Azure Databricks.
* Mandatory (Tech skill 2\): Must have experience with Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI Service, and building AI/ML or GenAI\-powered solutions (Azure AI Foundry, Cognitive Services)
* Mandatory (Tech skill 3\): Must have a solid understanding of ETL/ELT pipelines, data modeling (dimensional / data vault), and orchestration tools (Azure Data Factory, Synapse Pipelines).
* Mandatory (Tech skill 4\): Must have familiarity with Microsoft Purview (or equivalent) for data governance, cataloging, and lineage, plus working knowledge of Azure security, networking, and identity (Entra ID, Private Link, Key Vault, RBAC)
* Mandatory (Tech skill 5\): Must have hands\-on scripting/programming in Python, SQL, and/or Spark, and IaC experience (Bicep, ARM templates, or Terraform) for provisioning Azure resources.
* Mandatory (Communication): Must have strong client\-facing communication, able to present architecture to both technical and executive audiences.
* Preferred (Certifications): Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Data Engineer Associate, Azure AI Engineer Associate, or DP\-600 (Fabric Analytics Enginee
* Preferred (Other): Power BI semantic modeling/reporting; MLOps tools (MLflow, Azure ML pipelines, CI/CD for ML); consulting / SI / Microsoft\-partner (Solutions Partner) environment experience

Pay: From ₹100,000\.00 per month

* Paid time off

* Your Current CTC and Your Notice Period

* Total: 10 years (Required)

533b2b4e.title: Lead I - Cloud Infrastructure Services
533b2b4e.description:
**Role description**  

Datacenter engineer \- Hand \& Eyes Maintain the physical integrity and availability of the data center infrastructure. It requires a mix of hardware proficiency, basic networking knowledge, and strict adherence to safety and operational protocols (like ITIL) . Rack \& Stack: Unboxing \& Inventory: Receiving new hardware (servers, switches, storage arrays), verifying contents, and updating asset management system. Mounting: Installing rails and mounting equipment into datacenter racks according to elevation diagrams. Decommissioning: Identifying unused servers, unmounting them, wiping data (when required), and preparing them for recycling or disposal. 2\. Cable Management: Patching and Labeling Copper and fiber optic cables between devices and patch panels. 3\. Drive Swaps: Physically replacing failed Hard Drives (HDD) or Solid State Drives (SSD) in hot\-swappable bays. 4\. Troubleshooting \& Testing Physical servers, storage and Network switches, Visual Inspection, Power Cycle and Loopback Testing 5\. Vendor Escort : Escort Duty \- Supervising third\-party vendors (HVAC technicians, electricians, or hardware OEM repair techs) to ensure they follow security protocols. 6\. Logistics, Shipping/Receiving: Managing the loading dock and ensuring incoming gear is staged in a secure "burn\-in" area. Physical: Ability to lift 50\+ lbs and work on ladders or under raised floors. Technical: Familiarity with server vendors and cable types (LC/SC Fiber, RJ45\). Tools: Proficiency with crash carts, cable testers, label makers, and basic hand tools. Soft Skills: Strong communication for relaying real\-time status to remote engineers. CompTIA A\+, ANSI/TIA\-942, BICSI\-DCDC (Data Center Design Consultant) , RCDD (Registered Communications Distribution Designer), CDCP (Certified Data Centre Professional),

Data Center Operations,SSD

**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  

As a Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L2\) at NTT DATA, you will play an essential role in maintaining our clients' IT infrastructure and systems. Your expertise will help keep everything running smoothly by proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems. You'll be the go\-to person to restore services and ensure our clients' satisfaction.  

  

Your typical day involves managing work queues, addressing incidents and requests within agreed SLAs, and updating tickets with the actions taken. By identifying, analysing, and logging issues before they escalate, you'll be instrumental in maintaining service quality. You'll also collaborate closely with other teams and clients to provide second\-level support, ensuring seamless communication and efficient problem resolution.  

  

You will execute changes meticulously, understanding and mitigating risks, and contribute to the change management process with detailed documentation. Your role includes auditing incident and request tickets for quality, recommending improvements, and identifying tasks for automation to enhance efficiency. Additionally, you'll handle client escalations with professionalism and assist in disaster recovery functions and tests when necessary.  

  

Working within our diverse and inclusive environment, you'll help drive the optimization of efforts by working with automation teams and supporting L1 Engineers. Your responsibility also extends to contributing to various projects, ensuring that all changes are approved, and maintaining a positive outlook even in high\-pressure situations.

* Proficiency in planning activities and projects, taking changing circumstances into account.
* Ability to work longer hours when necessary and adapt to changing circumstances with ease.
* Proven ability to communicate effectively and work across different cultures and social groups.

**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  

As a Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L2\) at NTT DATA, you will play an essential role in maintaining our clients' IT infrastructure and systems. Your expertise will help keep everything running smoothly by proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems. You'll be the go\-to person to restore services and ensure our clients' satisfaction.  

  

Your typical day involves managing work queues, addressing incidents and requests within agreed SLAs, and updating tickets with the actions taken. By identifying, analysing, and logging issues before they escalate, you'll be instrumental in maintaining service quality. You'll also collaborate closely with other teams and clients to provide second\-level support, ensuring seamless communication and efficient problem resolution.  

  

You will execute changes meticulously, understanding and mitigating risks, and contribute to the change management process with detailed documentation. Your role includes auditing incident and request tickets for quality, recommending improvements, and identifying tasks for automation to enhance efficiency. Additionally, you'll handle client escalations with professionalism and assist in disaster recovery functions and tests when necessary.  

  

Working within our diverse and inclusive environment, you'll help drive the optimization of efforts by working with automation teams and supporting L1 Engineers. Your responsibility also extends to contributing to various projects, ensuring that all changes are approved, and maintaining a positive outlook even in high\-pressure situations.  

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:*** Moderate\-level experience in managed services roles handling cross\-technology infrastructure.
* Knowledge of ticketing tools, preferably ServiceNow.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes and experience working with vendors and third parties.
* Proficiency in planning activities and projects, taking changing circumstances into account.
* Ability to work longer hours when necessary and adapt to changing circumstances with ease.
* Proven ability to communicate effectively and work across different cultures and social groups.
* Positive outlook and ability to work well under pressure.
* Commitment to placing clients at the forefront of all interactions, understanding their requirements, and ensuring a positive experience.
* Bachelor's degree in IT/Computing or equivalent work experience.
**Workplace type****:**

On\-site Working **About NTT DATA**  

NTT DATA is a $30\+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune


Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through


responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with


unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and


application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move


confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more


than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as


established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each


year in R\&D.

 **Equal Opportunity Employer**  

NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

 **Third parties fraudulently posing as NTT DATA recruiters**


NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. Please remain vigilant of third parties who may attempt to impersonate NTT DATA recruiters whether in writing or by phone in order to deceptively obtain personal data or money from you. All email communications from an NTT DATA recruiter will come from an **@nttdata.com** email address. If you suspect any fraudulent activity, please *contact us*.

927bf473.title: Principal Software Architect
927bf473.description:
OPENTEXT \- THE INFORMATION COMPANY
  
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  

AI\-First. Future\-Driven. Human\-Centered.
  
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  

**Your Impact:**  

We are seeking a Principal Software Architect to lead the evolution of OpenText's Identity and Access Management (IAM) platform into a modern, cloud\-native architecture powered by the Core Identity Foundation (CIF). This strategic platform serves as the foundation for OpenText's next\-generation IAM offerings, delivering secure, scalable, and resilient identity services across both multi\-tenant and dedicated deployment models.
  
As a key technical leader, you will define the architecture that enables enterprises to govern, secure, and manage human, machine, and emerging AI\-driven identities at scale. You will help shape the future of identity by expanding support for modern authentication, authorization, identity governance, privileged access, and agentic AI security capabilities, further reinforcing OpenText's leadership position in the identity and access management market.
  
The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in distributed cloud systems with a strong background in identity standards, cybersecurity architecture, and enterprise\-scale IAM platforms.
  
  

**What the role offers:**  

* Define the long\-term architectural vision for OpenText's Identity and Access Management platform, aligning product strategy, technology investments, and customer requirements.
* Lead the transformation of legacy IAM products and services into a cloud\-native, microservices\-based SaaS platform.
* Architect highly scalable identity services supporting authentication, authorization, federation, identity lifecycle management, and policy enforcement across global enterprise environments.
* Design secure identity infrastructure capable of supporting workforce, customer, partner, machine, and AI\-driven identities.
* Drive innovation in securing and governing non\-human identities, service accounts, API identities, workload identities, and agentic AI systems.
* Architect solutions leveraging modern identity standards and protocols, including OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, SCIM, FIDO2, WebAuthn, and emerging identity technologies.
* Define architectures that support Zero Trust security principles, adaptive access controls, risk\-based authentication, and continuous authorization models.
* Modernize data architecture, identity stores, directories, and policy engines to support large\-scale identity governance and high\-performance access decisions.
* Establish architectural patterns for multi\-tenancy, tenant isolation, compliance, resiliency, observability, and operational excellence.
* Ensure platform readiness for regulatory and industry compliance requirements including GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, and other applicable standards.
* Lead cloud architecture decisions across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments, ensuring high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
* Collaborate with engineering, security, product management, customer success, and executive stakeholders to drive platform strategy and execution.
* Serve as a technical authority and mentor, guiding engineering teams on identity architecture, security best practices, and cloud\-native design patterns.
* Present architectural strategy, innovation roadmaps, and technical direction to executive leadership, customers, partners, and industry stakeholders.


**What you need to succeed:**  

* 15\+ years of experience in enterprise software architecture, distributed systems, or cloud platform engineering.
* Experience designing or architecting Identity and Access Management (IAM), Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM), or Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions.
* Proven track record modernizing monolithic enterprise platforms into cloud\-native, microservices\-based architectures.
* Deep expertise in authentication, authorization, identity federation, access governance, and policy\-based security models.
* Strong knowledge of industry standards including OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, SCIM, FIDO2, WebAuthn, and PKI\-based security.
* Extensive experience designing multi\-tenant SaaS platforms deployed on public cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Strong understanding of Zero Trust architectures, identity\-centric security, API security, secrets management, and secure software design.
* Deep experience with Kubernetes, containers, service meshes, CI/CD pipelines, and modern cloud\-native application patterns.
* Expertise in designing highly available systems with disaster recovery, fault tolerance, and global scale requirements.
* Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence technical direction across multiple organizations.


Preferred Skills
  
  

* Experience building or architecting enterprise IAM, IGA, or PAM platforms.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Ping Identity, ForgeRock, SailPoint, CyberArk, or similar identity ecosystems.
* Experience implementing Zero Trust initiatives and identity\-centric security programs.
* Knowledge of identity threat detection and response (ITDR), identity security posture management, and privileged access security.
* Experience securing machine identities, cloud workload identities, service\-to\-service authentication, and AI agents.
* Understanding of emerging standards and frameworks for AI identity, agent authorization, and autonomous system governance.
* Experience with observability, telemetry, and performance optimization for large\-scale distributed identity systems.


**One last thing:**  

OpenText is more than just a corporation, it's a global community where trust is foundational, the bar is raised, and outcomes are owned. Join us on our mission to drive positive change through privacy, technology, and collaboration. At OpenText, we don't just have a culture; we have character. Choose us because you want to be part of a company that embraces innovation and empowers its employees to make a difference.
  
  

OpenText's efforts to build an inclusive work environment go beyond simply complying with applicable laws. Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.
  
If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact us athr@opentext.com. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

c3327f7e.title: Advanced Specialist, Enterprise Architect - (AI Systems & Distributed Engineering)
c3327f7e.description:
**Job Title: Advance Specialist ,Enterprise Architect**

**About the role:**

Seeking a visionary Enterprise Architect to be part of the Enterprise Architecture team. This is not an "advisory" role — we require a practitioner who balances high\-level strategic governance with deep\-dive technical execution. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between traditional distributed and enterprise systems and the emerging frontier of Agentic AI, transforming how the enterprise leverages autonomous agents and LLM\-driven workflows.


**Experience Level:** 12\-15 Years **Location:** Bangalore or Chennai, India **Role Type:** Hands\-on Enterprise Architect


**Key Responsibilities**

* **Architectural Strategy \& Blueprint Ownership**
* Own and maintain the enterprise architecture blueprint — current\-state and target\-state views across application, data, integration, and infrastructure layers.
* Define and evangelize reference architectures and reusable patterns for agentic AI systems (agent orchestration, tool\-calling, memory/state management, guardrails) so delivery teams don't reinvent foundational patterns per project.
* **AI Agent Ecosystems**
* Design and govern the architecture for multi\-agent systems, including agent\-to\-agent communication protocols, orchestration frameworks, and tool/function\-calling interfaces.
* Define standards for grounding, memory, retrieval, and context management across LLM\-driven workflows.
* Establish human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints and escalation paths for autonomous agents operating on production data or systems.
* Evaluate and select frameworks/platforms for agent orchestration (e.g., orchestration engines, model routing, guardrail layers), balancing build vs. buy.
* **Modeling \& Governance**
* Chair or actively participate in the Architecture Review Chapter; define review cadence, entry/exit criteria, and a clear exception\-handling process for teams that need to move fast.
* Own Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and maintain a lightweight, non\-bureaucratic approval workflow so governance catches drift without blocking delivery.
* Define non\-negotiable guardrails for AI/agentic systems — data access boundaries, PII handling, human\-in\-the\-loop requirements, and audit logging — that any new agent workflow must pass through review.
* Maintain enterprise modeling artifacts (capability maps, data flow diagrams, integration catalogs) as the single source of truth referenced during reviews.

**Required Technical Skills**

**AI**

* Hands\-on experience with LLM application architecture: RAG pipelines, agent frameworks, prompt/context engineering, model evaluation and guardrails.
* Familiarity with multi\-agent orchestration patterns and tool\-use/function\-calling architectures.

**Cloud \& Infrastructure**

* Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS/Azure/GCP), containerization (Kubernetes), and infra\-as\-code.
* Experience designing for scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency at enterprise scale.

**Distributed \& Enterprise Systems Integration**

* Strong background in distributed systems design (event\-driven architecture, microservices, API gateways, messaging systems).
* Experience integrating legacy enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, core platforms) with modern cloud\-native and AI\-driven components.

**Data Architecture**

* Experience designing enterprise data architectures — data pipelines, data mesh/data fabric concepts, governance, and lineage.
* Ability to model and maintain the data\-flow view that underpins the enterprise digital twin.

**Modeling \& Governance Tooling**

* Practical experience with architecture modeling notations/tools (e.g., ArchiMate, C4 model, TOGAF\-aligned frameworks) and running formal EA review processes.

**Qualifications**

* 12 \- 15 years of progressive experience in software engineering and solution architecture.
* Demonstrated ability to strategise and develop PoC and add create practices around it.
* A portfolio of successful large\-scale modernization or AI\-transformation projects, ideally including experience participating in an EA governance process (ARB, ADRs) from scratch or maturing an existing one.
* Prior experience building or working with an enterprise digital twin or equivalent simulation/dependency\-modeling capability is a strong plus.

**Who we are:**

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.


Pearson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E\-Verify. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.


If you are an individual with a disability and are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our career site as a result of your disability, you may request reasonable accommodations by emailing TalentExperienceGlobalTeam@grp.pearson.com.

5f61efdd.title: Solution Delivery Architect
5f61efdd.description:
12 of the top 15 pharma generic companies in the world trust Leucine to manufacture the drugs that reach millions of patients every day.
   

  

 Pharma manufacturing is one of the last large industries still running on paper, Excel, and tribal knowledge. A single missed step in a batch record can mean a recall, a regulatory warning, or a drug that should never have left the plant.
   

  

 Leucine is the AI platform replacing all of it. Series A, backed by top\-tier global investors, 60\+ pharma enterprises in production, and the team that's going to define this category.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Lead end\-to\-end solution design for pharmaceutical and life\-sciences clients
* Translate complex business requirements into scalable, maintainable architectures
* Collaborate with product, engineering, QA and client teams to ensure on\-time delivery
* Provide technical thought leadership and mentorship to junior architects and developers
* Drive proof\-of\-concepts, feasibility studies, and performance tuning initiatives
* Ensure compliance with industry regulations (e.g., 21 CFR Part 11, GMP)


**Requirements**
**Must Have**
* 2\-5 years of consulting or industry experience in pharma, life sciences, or related sectors
* Bachelor's in Chemical, Mechanical or Biotechnology Engineering (or closely related)
* Demonstrated track record of architecting enterprise\-grade software solutions
* Strong understanding of manufacturing workflows, validation processes and regulatory needs
* Excellent communication skills—able to present complex designs to non\-technical stakeholders
* Preferred Experience \& Sourcing Targets


**Nice to Have**
* Industry pedigree: candidates currently or formerly at Cipla, Dr. Reddy's, Pfizer, Novartis, etc
* Consulting backgrounds: life\-sciences practice at PwC, KPMG, McKinsey, BCG or similar
* Experience working with digital validation platforms, LIMS integrations or process\-management tools


**Benefits**
* Be part of a fast\-growing SaaS company transforming the future of pharmaceutical manufacturing through cutting\-edge technology
* Collaborate with a passionate, high\-performing team building innovative AI\-powered digital solutions
* Take ownership of impactful client implementations from day one, with ample opportunities for learning, career growth, and professional development
* Enjoy a competitive compensation package designed to reward your contributions
* Comprehensive Health Insurance with industry\-leading coverage for your peace of mind
* Complimentary Meals \& Refreshments: Stay energized with unlimited breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner provided at the office
* Family\-Friendly Leave Policies, including Paternity Leave and Compassionate Leave, to support you through life's important moments

1a50d056.title: Solution Architect And Product Owner
1a50d056.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Unified Support Services (USS) Solution Architect \& Product Owner, Support Experience Platforms (U642\)**
 At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

 EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization. As part of Enterprise Technology, you'll be at the forefront of integrating technology into what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 EY's global Enterprise Technology group provides enabling services across enterprise platforms, infrastructure, digital workplace and service operations. The Solution Architect \& Product Owner is a pivotal role within Unified Support Services, accountable for the end\-to\-end solution architecture, integration strategy, product roadmap and delivery of Support Experience platforms.
   

  

 The role serves as the architectural authority for the Support Experience technology ecosystem. The individual will design, govern and enable integrated solutions across ServiceNow, Genesys Cloud, LogMeIn Rescue, Qualtrics, Nexthink, Microsoft Copilot, knowledge platforms, automation solutions and other Service Desk technologies. The role requires deep ServiceNow architecture expertise, strong systems integration capability and sufficient product ownership experience to translate business priorities into a coherent architecture and executable roadmap.
   

  

 The successful candidate will bring together business, product, architecture, engineering, security, operations and vendor teams to deliver scalable, secure, resilient and user\-centered support solutions from concept through implementation and operational adoption.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Act as the lead Solution Architect and design authority for the Unified Support Services Support Experience ecosystem.
* Define current\-state, target\-state and transition architectures for Support Experience platforms, including the supporting technology roadmap.
* Own end\-to\-end solution design across user channels, workflows, integrations, data, knowledge, automation, AI capabilities and operational processes.
* Provide architectural leadership across ServiceNow ITSM, r, Virtual Agent, Service Catalog, Knowledge Management, CMDB, IntegrationHub and Flow Designer.
* Design scalable ServiceNow solutions, data models, workflows and platform extensions while protecting platform integrity, maintainability and upgradeability.
* Own the end\-to\-end integration strategy across ServiceNow, Genesys Cloud, LogMeIn Rescue, Qualtrics, Nexthink, Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft Teams, identity services, enterprise knowledge and automation platforms.
* Define API\-led, event\-driven, workflow\-based and middleware integration patterns, including authentication, authorization, error handling, monitoring, data synchronization and recovery.
* Enable continuity of identity, conversation, intent, device context, case context and interaction history across chatbot, live chat, voice, portal, remote support and assisted\-service channels.
* Lead the Genesys integration roadmap with ITSM and digital channels to support intelligent routing and escalation between virtual, digital and voice channels without avoidable loss of context.
* Architect secure integration with LogMeIn Rescue, including remote\-session launch, user and case context, technician workflow, audit information and case updates.
* Architect the use of Nexthink telemetry and automation capabilities to support proactive issue identification, contextual diagnostics and remediation workflows.
* Integrate Qualtrics experience data with support platforms to enable feedback capture, experience analysis and closed\-loop service improvement.
* Define knowledge integration and orchestration across ServiceNow Knowledge, OEM knowledge sources, internal runbooks and enterprise repositories.
* Define architecture patterns and governance controls for virtual agents, Copilot experiences, agent\-assist capabilities, enterprise search and AI\-enabled support.
* Establish architecture principles, reference architectures, reusable patterns, technical guardrails, interface standards and non\-functional requirements.
* Lead solution architecture reviews and ensure alignment with Enterprise Architecture, information security, privacy, data governance, compliance and resilience requirements.
* Provide technical leadership to engineering teams, platform teams, vendors and implementation partners throughout design, build, testing, deployment and transition to operations.
* Review solution designs, integration specifications, data mappings, user stories, test strategies, release plans and production\-readiness evidence.
* Own technical risks, dependencies, architecture decisions, exceptions and technical debt, ensuring timely resolution and transparent escalation.
* Define and communicate the product vision, platform strategy, value proposition and roadmap for Support Experience platforms.
* Own and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, architectural dependencies, operational impact, risk and user experience outcomes.
* Translate business objectives and architecture into epics, capabilities, features, non\-functional requirements, acceptance criteria and release plans.
* Partner with stakeholders to gather and refine requirements, evaluate solution options and validate that delivered capabilities meet intended outcomes.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives, while providing architecture direction and timely decisions.
* Define and monitor measures for platform adoption, reliability, integration performance, self\-service, automation, experience and value realization.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to senior leaders and communicate architecture options, trade\-offs, recommendations, risks and roadmap implications clearly.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**To qualify for the role you must have**
* 12\+ years of experience across enterprise technology, solution architecture, platform engineering, IT service management or digital workplace solutions.
* 7\+ years of ServiceNow solution architecture or equivalent senior technical leadership experience.
* Proven experience architecting enterprise\-scale employee support, service management or omnichannel service solutions.
* Strong ServiceNow expertise across ITSM, Employee Center, Virtual Agent, Service Catalog, Knowledge Management, CMDB, IntegrationHub and Flow Designer.
* Demonstrated experience designing complex integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise platforms using APIs, events, middleware and orchestration technologies.
* Practical architecture or integration experience involving Genesys Cloud and one or more of LogMeIn Rescue, Qualtrics and Nexthink.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, event\-driven architecture, integration security, identity and access management, data flows, observability and resilient interface design.
* Experience leading architecture governance, technical design reviews and delivery assurance across internal teams and external partners.
* Experience translating architecture and business priorities into product roadmaps, epics, non\-functional requirements and executable delivery plans.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, influencing, decision\-making and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively across a complex, global and matrixed organization.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices and ITIL\-aligned service management processes.


**Ideally, you'll also have**
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator and relevant Certified Implementation Specialist credentials.
* ServiceNow Certified Application Developer or architect\-level ServiceNow credentials; Certified Technical Architect is preferred.
* TOGAF or an equivalent enterprise architecture certification.
* Experience with Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI, conversational AI, enterprise search or knowledge graphs.
* Experience delivering Digital Employee Experience, proactive support, intelligent automation or AI\-enabled IT support transformation.
* Experience defining AI, knowledge governance and data protection controls for enterprise support solutions.
* Confidence to make timely decisions, articulate trade\-offs and challenge proposed options constructively.
* A customer\-centric mindset and the ability to connect technical solutions to measurable user and business outcomes.


**What We Look For**
* A technology leader who combines deep ServiceNow architecture expertise with strong product judgment and end\-to\-end delivery accountability.
* A proven ability to define target architecture, govern complex integrations and lead cross\-functional teams from strategy through implementation and operational adoption.
* Strong systems thinking and the ability to balance enterprise standards, user experience, business value, delivery pragmatism and long\-term maintainability.
* Overall experience relevant to an Assistant Director\-level role in enterprise support technology, solution architecture or service management transformation.
* Willingness to support a global service environment and collaborate across time zones as required.


**What We Offer**
 As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, global team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here's a snapshot of what we offer:
   

  

* Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

216251d1.title: Forward Deployed Engineering Leader- Microsoft AI Business Solutions
216251d1.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**Crowe's Microsoft focused delivery practice brings together advisory, outcome delivery and managed services across Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, data, automation and AI. The practice is expected to double over the next two years, and this role will help shape how our approximately 20 person India engineering team operates as it grows.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**We are looking for an experienced engineering leader who has built strong teams, raised technical standards and improved how complex software is delivered. Deep experience with every Microsoft product is not required. What matters most is engineering judgment, people leadership, learning agility and the ability to work with platform specialists to make sound architecture and delivery decisions.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**This is a player coach role. You will remain technically engaged through architecture reviews, critical design decisions, prototypes, complex delivery situations and customer conversations. You will not be expected to be the deepest specialist in every Microsoft technology, but you must be able to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and help teams reach practical, defensible decisions.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Build a high performing engineering organization with clear expectations for quality, ownership, collaboration, technical judgment and continuous improvement.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Set and evolve engineering and architecture standards across applications, data, cloud, automation, AI, security and integration, partnering with Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure specialists where deep platform expertise is needed.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Stay close to the work by reviewing critical designs, contributing to prototypes and accelerators, helping resolve complex delivery issues and participating in important client conversations.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Translate ambiguous business problems into practical solution approaches, including deciding when AI or an agentic workflow is appropriate and when better data, a clearer process or a deterministic solution will serve the client better.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Coach engineers, technical leads and architects; identify high potential talent; strengthen succession; influence performance decisions; and make difficult talent calls when needed.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Improve the team's ability to work directly with business users, IT teams, architects and senior leaders, particularly when requirements are incomplete or business processes need to change.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Help expand the practice across Power Platform, Azure, data, automation, Copilot and agentic AI by creating an environment in which specialists can learn from one another and apply strong engineering fundamentals consistently.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What you will do, continued**
-------------------------------

* **Identify opportunities to automate delivery, reuse components and create Crowe intellectual property that reduces effort, improves quality and increases margin across multiple engagements.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Establish meaningful measures for throughput, cycle time, predictability, rework, defects, escalations, reuse and team health, then drive visible improvement against them.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Support solution shaping, estimation, technical workshops, pre sales and executive discussions, connecting technical choices to client outcomes, delivery risk and commercial value.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Partner with practice leadership to turn repeatable delivery patterns into fixed fee or managed services offerings with clear scope, architecture, delivery playbooks and operating measures.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

**Within your first year, you will have:**
------------------------------------------

* **Raised the engineering bar. Teams are operating with clearer standards, stronger architecture discipline and greater ownership of difficult decisions.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strengthened the leadership bench. Technical leads and high potential engineers are visibly more capable, and expectations and performance decisions are clearer.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Improved delivery health. Predictability, cycle time, quality, escalations and rework are measured, understood and moving in the right direction.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Put reuse to work. Components, delivery patterns, automation and AI enabled workflows are being applied across multiple engagements rather than remaining isolated within one project.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Built credibility across the Microsoft practice. Platform specialists see you as a leader who improves their decisions and effectiveness, even when they have deeper product expertise.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Earned client trust. Clients and colleagues involve you in ambiguous, high consequence technical and delivery decisions.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Opened a stronger commercial path. The practice has a growing pipeline of repeatable fixed fee or managed services offerings supported by real delivery playbooks.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Developed practical fluency across Crowe's Microsoft portfolio and a clear understanding of where specialist depth is required.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Required experience**
-----------------------

* **Ten or more years of software engineering experience, including at least five years leading engineering teams in a global or distributed environment.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **A demonstrated record of building high performing teams, developing leaders, mentoring engineers and improving engineering culture and delivery outcomes.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong technical foundations across modern application architecture, cloud platforms, APIs, integrations, data, security, automation and software delivery practices.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Required experience, continued**
----------------------------------

* **Experience setting technical standards and leading architecture or design decisions across complex products, platforms or client engagements.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Sufficient hands on depth to review designs, challenge technical assumptions, guide prototypes and lead teams through difficult engineering problems.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience with AI enabled software, automation or data driven solutions, including the judgment to evaluate whether AI is appropriate for a business problem.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong client and executive communication skills, with the ability to translate between business outcomes, engineering tradeoffs and delivery risk.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience leading through a meaningful business or engineering transformation that changed how work was performed, not simply which system was used.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Comfort operating with ambiguity, taking ownership and making progress before every detail is known.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Preferred experience**
------------------------

* **Experience with one or more parts of the Microsoft business applications and cloud ecosystem, such as Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Dataverse, Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI or Azure AI Search.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience in consulting or professional services, including scoped client engagements, solution shaping, estimation and technical workshops.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience leading production AI enabled or agentic solutions with appropriate evaluation, security, governance and human oversight.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Exposure to fixed fee delivery, managed services, reusable intellectual property or other approaches that improve delivery leverage and margin.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Business process experience in areas such as customer service, sales, field service, finance, operations, risk or compliance.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**How we will support your success**
------------------------------------

**You will work closely with experienced Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure practitioners who provide deep product expertise. In turn, you will help those specialists apply stronger engineering methods, architecture discipline, people leadership and delivery practices. We expect you to build practical Microsoft fluency quickly, while being candid about where specialist input is needed.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Mindset we value**
--------------------

* **You make other engineers and leaders better, remain technically engaged and do not need to be the expert in every room.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **You automate unnecessary work, communicate clearly, seek evidence, invite challenge and own outcomes across people, technology, delivery and clients.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**

**Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high\-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Beyond that, we're looking for someone who:**
-----------------------------------------------

* **Has an automation mindset — the instinct is to eliminate the work, not just scale the number of people doing it.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Communicates just as well in front of an engineering team as in front of a client's leadership, without needing two different vocabularies to do it.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Takes ownership without waiting for permission and is willing to move before the path is fully clear.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Has led through a real business transformation before — a change in how work actually gets done, not just a system migration.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  

  

**How You Can Grow:**  

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  

  

**More about Crowe:**


Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.


Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third\-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre\-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.


We are committed to a merit\-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job\-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

6ae5365f.title: Data Architect
6ae5365f.description:
**Project Role :** 
 Data Architect
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Define the data requirements and structure for the application. Model and design the application data structure, storage and integration.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 AWS Architecture
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum 7\.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Design and implement scalable, secure, and highly available AWS architectures.
   

  

 Define and enforce cloud best practices for development, deployment, and operations.
   

  

 Lead migration of on\-premise applications and workloads to AWS.
   

  

 Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
   

  

 Implement monitoring, logging, and disaster recovery strategies.
   

  

 Optimize cloud costs and resource utilization.
   

  

 Ensure compliance with security standards and governance policies.
   

  

 Provide technical leadership and mentorship to development and DevOps teams.
   

  

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
 Strong expertise in AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, VPC, CloudFormation, IAM, ECS/EKS).
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).

6685d813.title: Cloud Operations Engineer
6685d813.description:
**Our story**
 At Alight, we believe a company’s success starts with its people. At our core, we Champion People, help our colleagues Grow with Purpose and true to our name we encourage colleagues to “Be Alight.”
   

  

**Our Values:**
* Agility: Move with purpose, learn fast, and adapt quickly.
* Leadership: Lead by example, own the outcome, and serve others.
* Integrity: Do the right thing, even when it is difficult or unseen.
* Growth Mindset: Stay curious, keep learning, and continue improving.
* High Quality: Do it thoughtfully, completely, and well.
* Trust: Earn trust through consistency, authenticity, and credibility.


 It’s why we’re so driven to connect passion with purpose. Alight helps clients gain a benefits advantage while building a healthy and financially secure workforce by unifying the benefits ecosystem across health, wealth, wellbeing, absence management and navigation.
   

  

 With a comprehensive total rewards package, continuing education and training, and tremendous potential with a growing global organization, Alight is the perfect place to put your passion to work.
   

  

 Join our team if you Champion People, want to Grow with Purpose through acting with integrity and if you embody the meaning of Be Alight.
   

  

 Learn more at careers.alight.com .
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Provide hands on technical support related to the overall health and maintenance of the Windows / Linux operating environments in support of 24/7 operations
* Ability to decompose complex problems to ensure timely and accurate resolution of system anomalies before they impact operations.
* Performance and capacity management of the server environment
* Design and execute disaster recovery plans
* Backup and recovery of the server environment


 Requirements:
