8436cdf7.title: Security Architect — Microsoft Security Platform
8436cdf7.description:
Job Description
  
**Avanade India**

**Security Architect — Microsoft Security Platform**

**Practice:** Cyber Security, Avanade India


**Location:** Bengaluru / Delhi NCR / Mumbai, India (Hybrid)


**Experience:** 14–18 years in the cyber security domain, with deep, current, hands\-on architecture experience across the Microsoft security platform — Microsoft Sentinel, Defender, Purview, Entra ID and Intune


**Role Summary**
----------------

Avanade India’s Cyber Security practice is looking for a Security Architect with genuine depth across the full Microsoft security estate. This is a senior, client\-facing role for someone who can hold a security conversation with a CISO in the morning, defend a Sentinel data architecture with a SOC team in the afternoon, and be equally credible in both rooms.


The emphasis is on breadth across the Microsoft security platform combined with real depth in each pillar — threat protection, cloud security, identity, data security and compliance — and the ability to design them as one integrated architecture rather than a set of separately deployed products. You will lead security architecture on client engagements, shape pursuits as the security SME, and build the standards, IP and skilling that the practice runs on.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own end\-to\-end security architecture for client engagements — target\-state security architecture, Zero Trust design, control mapping and multi\-year security roadmaps grounded in the client’s risk profile and regulatory context.
* Architect and lead Microsoft Sentinel implementations: workspace and tenant design, ingestion strategy, log tiering and cost optimisation, detection engineering in KQL, UEBA, SOAR playbooks and threat intelligence integration.
* Lead migrations from legacy SIEM platforms (Splunk, QRadar, ArcSight and similar) to Microsoft Sentinel — content and use\-case migration, parallel running, validation and decommissioning.
* Design across Microsoft Defender XDR — Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps — covering deployment architecture, policy design, tuning, incident correlation and cross\-product investigation.
* Architect cloud workload and posture security with Defender for Cloud — CSPM and CWPP, secure score improvement, regulatory compliance dashboards, and container, server and database protection.
* Design Microsoft Purview solutions across data security and compliance: information protection and sensitivity labelling, DLP, insider risk management, data lifecycle and records, eDiscovery and Compliance Manager.
* Architect identity security on Entra ID: conditional access design, Privileged Identity Management, identity governance and entitlement management, passwordless and phishing\-resistant authentication, and identity threat detection and response.
* Design endpoint security through Intune — security baselines, attack surface reduction and compliance policies — integrated with Defender for Endpoint.
* Lead security assessments and maturity reviews — gap analysis against NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS and Microsoft Zero Trust maturity, with prioritised, costed remediation roadmaps.
* Design SOC target operating models and detection strategy: use\-case catalogues, detection engineering lifecycle, incident response runbooks, threat hunting, automation and MDR/managed service interlock.
* Advise on securing AI adoption — Copilot readiness and oversharing remediation, data security posture for AI, agent governance, and the controls that make AI deployment defensible.
* Align security architecture to regulatory and data protection requirements — India’s DPDP Act, GDPR, and sector guidance such as RBI, SEBI or IRDAI where applicable.
* Act as security design authority across delivery: design reviews, architecture governance, escalation support and assurance of security deliverable quality.
* Lead security solutioning on pursuits — workshops, solution architecture, estimation, proposals and RFP responses — presenting credibly to CISO\-level stakeholders.
* Build practice IP: reference architectures, deployment accelerators, detection content libraries, assessment frameworks and delivery playbooks.
* Mentor security architects, consultants and analysts; drive certification and skilling across the security capability.

**Required Skills \& Experience**
---------------------------------

* 15–20 years in cyber security across architecture, engineering, consulting or security operations, with a substantial recent focus on the Microsoft security platform.
* Deep, hands\-on architecture experience across Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, Defender for Cloud, Purview, Entra ID and Intune — beyond product positioning, into design decisions, trade\-offs and known pitfalls.
* Strong Microsoft Sentinel depth: ingestion and cost architecture, KQL proficiency, detection engineering, automation with Logic Apps, and experience running or migrating a SIEM at enterprise scale.
* Proven design experience across the Defender suite, including deployment at scale, policy and exclusion strategy, alert tuning and reduction of analyst noise.
* Solid Purview experience across information protection, DLP and at least one of insider risk, data lifecycle or eDiscovery — including classification and labelling strategy.
* Strong identity security background: Entra ID architecture, conditional access, privileged access, identity governance, and hybrid identity in complex estates.
* Working knowledge of Azure platform security — network security, Key Vault, encryption, and how platform design affects security posture.
* Practical command of security frameworks and standards: NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, MITRE ATT\&CK, and Zero Trust reference models.
* Experience with data protection and regulatory requirements applicable to Indian and global clients, and the ability to translate them into technical controls.
* Demonstrated experience leading security assessments and producing prioritised, executive\-ready roadmaps and business cases.
* Incident response and threat landscape awareness — able to reason about attacker behaviour, not only about product configuration.
* Strong client\-facing consulting skills, including CISO and executive stakeholder engagement and pre\-sales solutioning, estimation and proposal work.
* Track record of mentoring and technically leading security teams on medium\-to\-large engagements.
* Clear technical writing — architecture documents, assessment reports, standards and runbooks at client\-ready quality.

**Preferred / Good to Have**
----------------------------

* Microsoft certifications: SC\-100, SC\-200, SC\-300, SC\-400 or AZ\-500; industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor.
* Experience supporting Microsoft security specializations and partner programmes — capability alignment, audit and evidence preparation.
* Experience designing or running MDR / managed security services — shift models, SLAs and service transition.
* Automation and IaC for security deployment — PowerShell, Logic Apps, Bicep or Terraform for repeatable security configuration.
* Exposure to OT/IoT security (Defender for IoT) or to securing manufacturing and critical infrastructure environments.
* Multi\-cloud security experience (AWS, GCP) and integration of third\-party tooling into Sentinel.
* Experience in regulated industries — BFSI, healthcare, energy or public sector — including regulator\-facing work.
* Experience in a global delivery / SI or Microsoft partner environment with distributed teams.
* Thought leadership — speaking, publishing or detection content shared with the security community.

  
Qualification
  
NA

1aeda29c.title: Consultant, Managed Services
1aeda29c.description:
**We Breathe Life Into Data**
 At Komodo Health, our mission is to reduce the global burden of disease. And we believe that smarter use of data is essential to this mission. That’s why we built the Healthcare Map — the industry’s largest, most complete, precise view of the U.S. healthcare system — by combining de\-identified, real\-world patient data with innovative algorithms and decades of clinical experience. The Healthcare Map serves as our foundation for a powerful suite of software applications, helping us answer healthcare’s most complex questions for our partners. Across the healthcare ecosystem, we’re helping our clients unlock critical insights to track detailed patient behaviors and treatment patterns, identify gaps in care, address unmet patient needs, and reduce the global burden of disease.
   

  

 As we pursue these goals, it remains essential to us that we stay grounded in our values: be awesome, seek growth, deliver “wow,” and enjoy the ride. At Komodo, you will be joining a team of ambitious, supportive Dragons with diverse backgrounds but a shared passion to deliver on our mission to reduce the burden of disease — and enjoy the journey along the way.
   

  

**Leadership At Komodo Health**
 Mavens is a Komodo Health company focused on delivering Salesforce\-based solutions that drive workflow and digital engagement across the life sciences industry. The Mavens Managed Services team partners closely with our customers post initial implementation to support long term success with our solutions. Our managed services team serves as trusted advisors who understand both the evolving technology and the business challenges our customers face.
   

  

 Managed Services Consultants are the primary long\-term partners for our customers, acting as a fully integrated extension of the customer’s IT team. They balance day\-to\-day administrative support with complex release management, ensuring that applications are functioning properly to support business\-critical processes. They play a strategic role in building and maintaining strong customer relationships and continuously seek opportunities to further assist customers with their evolving needs.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a goal\-oriented and self\-motivated individual who is comfortable working in fast\-paced work environments. They demonstrate strong collaboration skills by working effectively across internal teams and with customers to drive shared outcomes. They hold themselves accountable to commitments and follow through with a high degree of ownership. They bring creativity and resourcefulness to problem\-solving, finding practical solutions in ambiguous or complex situations. They approach interactions with empathy, fostering trust with both customers and colleagues.
   

  

**The Opportunity at Mavens**
**Communications \& Project Management**
* Lead Stakeholder Engagement: Lead weekly status calls, third\-party vendor alignments, and design reviews.
* Manage Project Documentation: Prepare status call content (dashboards, agendas) and manage the RAIL (Rolling Action Item Log) by creating and updating items in real\-time.
* Release Planning: Create and maintain release timelines and support customers with release candidate prioritization.
* Governance \& Business Planning: Provide technical recommendations and work in collaboration with customers to define a clear roadmap.
* Internal Collaboration: Maintain clear and proactive communication with internal stakeholders \- including practice leads, consultants, developers, architects, and QA \- to share customer context, coordinate delivery activities, and surface risks or escalations through the appropriate channels.


**Requirements \& Build**
* Analyze Business Needs: Prepare for and lead requirements gathering sessions.
* Technical Implementation: Assess Level of Effort (LOE) for functional items and complete or delegate build/configuration changes.
* DevOps \& Deployment: Manage repositories and promote completed build to higher environments.
* Maintain Documentation: Manage requirements, test cases, functional and technical guides, integration specifications, and other application documentation.


**Testing \& Quality Assurance**
* Validation: Perform System Integration Testing (SIT) and provide guidance/support for User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Spot Checks: Validate deployments by checking changes in higher environments.


**Ongoing Support \& Maintenance**
* User \& Data Management: Handle user lifecycle (creation, deactivation, permissions) and maintain data integrity (duplicate management, record updates).
* Issue Management: Investigate reported issues, monitor error reports, and triage/escalate problems as needed to ensure resolution.
* Reporting: Create and update reports and perform data extractions/exports for the customer.


**Competencies**
* Platform Expertise: Strong knack for understanding how applications work and envisioning solutions on the Force.com platform.
* Functional Advisory: Ability to provide "how\-to" technical assistance and advise customers on product features and enhancements.
* Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to seamlessly connect and translate between technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Documentation Mastery: Experience authoring requirements, system specifications, and application guides.
* Project Management: Understanding of core project management concepts, including timeline management and LOE assessment.
* Industry Knowledge: Life Sciences or Pharmaceutical experience is a significant plus.
* Education \& Certification: Bachelor’s degree preferred; Salesforce Certification is required.


**Values**
 If you are wondering if this is the right role for you, ask yourself if you are already a Maven:
   

  

* A Maven is open to saying yes and shows good judgment in ambiguity
* A Maven takes accountability and is constantly learning
* A Maven is fearless, resourceful, and scrappy
* A Maven communicates with integrity, empathy, and humility
* A Maven brings energy into the room and gives more than they take
* A Maven in an entrepreneur who creates opportunity and momentum
* A Maven is a craftsman who uses technology to solve business problems
* A Maven makes our customer the hero


**Komodo's AI Standard**
 At Komodo, we're not just witnessing the AI revolution – we're leading it. This is a pivotal moment in time, where being first to market with AI transforms industries and sets the bar. We've already established industry leadership in leveraging AI to revolutionize healthcare, and we expect every team member to contribute. AI here isn't optional; it's foundational. We expect you to integrate AI into your daily work – from summarizing documents to automating workflows and uncovering insights. This isn't just about efficiency; it's about making every moment more meaningful, building on trust in AI, and driving our collective success.
   

  

***Join us in shaping the future of healthcare intelligence.*
 Where You’ll Work**
 Komodo Health has a hybrid work model with hubs in San Francisco, New York City, and Chicago. Roles vary — some can be performed from anywhere in the country, others are scoped to a specific region, and some are based near one of our hubs. For hub\-based Dragons, we're building intentional in\-office rhythms alongside the flexibility that's core to how we work. Whatever your setup, expectations will always be clear before you join.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
 Komodo Health provides equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type with regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
   

  

 By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read and understand Komodo Health’s Privacy Notice for Employees and Contractors.

ccb12c08.title: Lead Managed Services Consultant
ccb12c08.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
   

  

 By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.
   

  

 Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
 Lead managed services delivery for Sprinklr CCaaS customers, driving platform configuration, optimization, and adoption across digital and voice ecosystems. Act as a hands\-on solution lead ensuring scalable design, strong customer outcomes, and continuous value realization.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Translate customer business requirements into best\-practice CCaaS solutions aligned to Sprinklr capabilities and defined solution blueprints.
* Own and manage end\-to\-end configurations across omnichannel workflows, routing, IVR, case management, SLA frameworks, and automation.
* Manage and maintain core configuration architecture, ensuring alignment with customer blueprints, supportability, and scalability standards.
* Configure and optimize advanced routing models including skills\-based routing, priority logic, queue segmentation, and escalation workflows.
* Design and enhance IVR flows, voice queue logic, call routing paths, and contact center workflow automation.
* Build and optimize bot workflows, conversational AI journeys, and automation frameworks to improve containment, productivity, and customer experience.
* Drive platform adoption by aligning features to customer use cases, usage patterns, and operational objectives.
* Monitor and improve customer contact center operational metrics such as SLA adherence, AHT, queue performance, response times, productivity, and CSAT.
* Identify platform gaps and optimization opportunities and implement best practice solutioning to improve efficiency and service outcomes.
* Manage post go\-live changes, releases, configuration updates, and continuous platform improvements across the customer lifecycle.
* Support and guide API, CRM, telephony, and third\-party system integrations to enable connected workflows and unified service operations.
* Lead training and onboarding sessions for agents, admins, and customer teams to drive adoption of workflows, tools, and operating practices.
* Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to identify new opportunities, drive platform consumption, and support upsell/cross\-sell discussions.
* Act as the primary technical and functional point of contact, advising stakeholders on solution design, adoption strategy, and operational improvements.
* Leverage AI and automation opportunities to improve ROI, efficiency, and service performance.


**What Makes You Qualified?**
**Must Have Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience in managed services, CCaaS, or technology consulting.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Sprinklr CCaaS or similar platforms such as Genesys, Cisco Webex Contact Center, Twilio Flex, or comparable solutions.
* Strong knowledge of IVR, routing strategies, queue management, chatbot workflows, case management, and SLA configurations.
* Experience designing and supporting omnichannel customer journeys across digital and voice channels.
* Understanding of telephony concepts such as VoIP, SIP, CTI, and ACD.
* Experience with API, CRM, and third\-party integrations.
* Hands\-on experience in system configuration, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate business needs into platform solutions.


**Good To Have Skills**
* Exposure to AI\-driven support models, automation use cases, and digital deflection strategies.
* Experience with social and digital engagement platforms.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset with understanding of customer service KPIs.
* CCaaS certifications such as Genesys, Cisco, or Avaya preferred.


**Who You Are**
* A strong technical consultant with an ownership mindset.
* Able to independently manage customer outcomes and multiple engagements.
* Skilled at balancing hands\-on delivery with stakeholder engagement and solution guidance.
* Customer\-focused, solution\-oriented, and driven by continuous improvement.


**What Success Looks Like**
* High platform adoption and improved operational performance across customer accounts.
* Strong customer retention and measurable expansion opportunities.
* Successful delivery of scalable, optimized, and well\-governed CCaaS solutions.
* Recognition as a trusted advisor for day\-to\-day platform and service improvements.


**We focus on our mission** 
 : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
   

  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.


**We believe in our product** 
 : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
   

  

**We invest in our people** 
 : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well\-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
   

  

 To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
   

  

 To learn more about all\-things\-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
   

  

**EEO \- Our philosophy** 
 : Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
   

  

 Sprinklr is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
   

  

 Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
   

  

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** 
 Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
   

  

 If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

f34ca6c5.title: Delivery Manager
f34ca6c5.description:
**Anchanto \| Job Description**
**PBU Delivery \& Agile Operations Manager – OMS**
 Location: Pune, India \| Reports to: Product Business Unit Head \| Experience: 6\+ Years \| Type: Full time, Work from Office
   

  

**About The Role**
 Anchanto is a global enterprise\-grade B2B SaaS company. We provide cloud software for brands, retailers, and logistics providers to manage orders, inventory, marketplaces, fulfilment, parcel tracking, and omnichannel commerce.
   

  

 As Anchanto evolves toward integrated Product Business Units (PBUs), we need a leader who can run the delivery operating system of a business unit. This role combines multi\-pod Scrum leadership, program delivery, resource and capacity planning, financial visibility, operational governance, and PBU administration.
   

  

 This is not a ceremony\-only Scrum Master role. The person is expected to independently create structure, maintain a single view of all commitments, challenge unrealistic plans, hold senior stakeholders accountable, and ensure work gets delivered with speed, predictability, and quality. The role requires a strong presence with Product, Engineering, QA, DevOps, Customer Delivery, Support, and the PBU Head.
   

  

**Why This Role Exists**
 The PBU model brings Product, Engineering, QA, Architecture, DevOps, Implementation, and Support closer together around a single product outcome. To make this model work, the PBU needs one owner for delivery rhythm, portfolio visibility, resource loading, risk management, operational discipline, and leadership reporting. This role exists to ensure that the PBU does not depend on fragmented trackers, informal follow\-ups, or late escalations.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
 The role owns nine areas. The expectation across all of them is the same: strong ownership, data over opinion, early visibility of risk, clear accountability, and reliable execution.
   

  

* Multi\-pod Scrum and Agile delivery management
* Manage approximately 6 to 10 active Scrum teams or delivery pods in parallel, with the ability to scale the operating cadence as the PBU grows.
* Ensure effective sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily Scrum, reviews, retrospectives, and Scrum of Scrums without creating unnecessary ceremony.
* Ensure every pod has a clear sprint goal, ready backlog, acceptance criteria, realistic capacity plan, visible dependencies, and agreed Definition of Ready and Definition of Done.
* Monitor and improve commitment reliability, cycle time, lead time, throughput, scope churn, spillover, defect leakage, escaped defects, and release predictability.
* Improve velocity and flow sustainably without compromising quality or using story points as an individual productivity measure.
* Coach teams toward self\-organisation while holding teams and leaders accountable for agreed process and delivery standards.
* Identify recurring blockers, late requirements, delayed QA, weak Jira hygiene, and process failures, and drive root\-cause corrective action.
* Integrated delivery and portfolio planning
* Maintain one consolidated delivery plan across product roadmap, customer projects and customisations, technical debt, innovation, compliance, production incidents, and L3 support.
* Translate PBU priorities into executable milestones, pod plans, owners, dependencies, and resource requirements.
* Maintain visibility of planned versus actual progress, delivery confidence, critical path, scope changes, customer commitments, and roadmap displacement.
* Ensure customer\-specific work does not silently displace roadmap commitments without an explicit business decision.
* Classify work as reusable product capability, hybrid product/customer work, or customer\-specific customisation to support the right product and commercial decision.
* Support quarterly planning, monthly operating reviews, and major reprioritisation decisions with clear options and impacts.
* Maintain decision logs for material scope, priority, resource, budget, and date changes.
* Resource loading and capacity management
* Maintain a current capacity and allocation view across Product, Engineering, QA, Architecture, DevOps, Design, Implementation, and Support.
* Identify overload, underutilisation, shared\-resource conflicts, skill bottlenecks, and single points of failure before they affect delivery.
* Recommend pod composition based on work requirements, available skills, and delivery risk.
* Present practical trade\-off options when capacity is insufficient, including scope reduction, phased delivery, resequencing, date revision, temporary reallocation, hiring, or contracting.
* Prevent teams from accepting commitments without validated scope, dependencies, and confirmed capacity.
* Track planned versus actual utilisation and explain material variance.
* Delivery accountability and stakeholder leadership
* Act as the operating owner for PBU delivery and ensure commitments are converted into clear plans, owners, dates, and closure.
* Hold Product Managers, Engineering Managers, QA Leads, Architects, and other stakeholders accountable for agreed actions and standards.
* Conduct difficult delivery conversations when scope, dates, quality, resource availability, or process discipline are at risk.
* Challenge unrealistic commitments, incomplete requirements, unsupported dates, and unapproved customer promises with facts and alternatives.
* Escalate unresolved issues to Engineering Heads, the PBU Head, or leadership with impact, options, recommendation, and decision required.
* Maintain a visible and credible presence across the PBU; this role must not operate as a passive coordinator or status chaser.
* Financial and commercial governance
* Work with Finance and PBU leadership to track planned versus actual effort, budget consumption, forecast to complete, vendor or contractor cost, rework, and support cost.
* Maintain operational cost visibility for major roadmap initiatives and customer projects.
* Support customer\-project margin and cost\-to\-value discussions by providing reliable delivery, effort, and forecast data.
* Identify material variance early and recommend corrective action.
* Ensure scope changes are reflected in effort, schedule, resource, and commercial discussions.
* Distinguish clearly between effort, cost, budget, billing, revenue, and margin. Formal accounting remains with Finance; this role owns the reliability of delivery inputs.
* Quality, release, and production governance
* Create and maintain PBU\-level release\-readiness criteria covering functional completion, regression, integration, security, performance, open defects, rollback, monitoring, and support readiness.
* Facilitate go/no\-go discussions and provide a clear delivery recommendation based on risk and evidence.
* Track defect leakage, production incidents, rework, release failures, and recurring root causes.
* Ensure RCAs have clear owners, corrective actions, due dates, and verified closure.
* Include L3 support and production incidents in capacity plans so support demand is visible rather than treated as an unplanned interruption.
* Ensure delivery speed does not compromise quality, security, customer experience, or compliance.
* PBU administration and team operations
* Coordinate smooth onboarding for new PBU members, including access, tools, product orientation, process induction, stakeholder introductions, role clarity, and required training.
* Coordinate employee exits with HR, IT, Security, Finance, and functional managers, including access revocation, knowledge transfer, work reassignment, asset return, and documentation handover.
* Maintain the PBU roster, role map, allocation view, onboarding status, and critical knowledge coverage.
* Identify skill gaps and coordinate training, coaching, hiring, or external support.
* Ensure critical knowledge and delivery responsibility are not concentrated with one individual.
* Compliance and operational controls
* Track PBU obligations related to ISO, GDPR, information security, data retention, customer audits, internal controls, and market or regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate with Security, Legal, Compliance, Product, and Engineering owners to ensure actions and evidence are completed on time.
* Maintain compliance actions, evidence, owners, and due dates, and escalate overdue or high\-risk items.
* Ensure compliance work is included in delivery plans and resource allocations rather than managed outside the operating plan.
* Support audit preparation and closure of observations for the PBU.
* Leadership reporting, systems, and continuous improvement
* Create a concise weekly PBU operating report covering delivery health, milestones, confidence, capacity, roadmap versus customer work, quality, production health, cost or effort variance, risks, recovery actions, and decisions required.
* Run weekly delivery reviews, cross\-pod dependency reviews, release\-readiness reviews, monthly leadership reviews, and quarterly planning retrospectives.
* Ensure Jira, Confluence, portfolio views, RAID logs, decision logs, and dashboards operate as trusted systems of record.
* Automate reporting, Jira hygiene, risk detection, meeting summaries, dependency tracking, and readiness checks wherever practical.
* Use AI and automation responsibly to improve delivery speed, data accuracy, and management visibility.
* Measure whether process changes improve predictability, quality, flow, and team effectiveness; remove governance that does not create value.


**Cross\-Functional Operating Model**
 Partner
   

  

 Primary partnership area
   

  

 PBU Head
   

  

 PBU priorities, investment choices, portfolio trade\-offs, budget, and final escalation decisions
   

  

 Product Management
   

  

 Roadmap, problem definition, business value, requirements readiness, and product\-versus\-custom decisions
   

  

 Engineering Managers / Engineering Head
   

  

 Technical execution, engineering capacity, architecture, quality practices, skill development, and people leadership
   

  

 QA, DevOps, Security, and Architecture
   

  

 Release readiness, test coverage, environments, production health, security, compliance, and technical dependencies
   

  

 Customer Delivery, Sales, and Customer Success
   

  

 Customer commitments, implementation milestones, scope changes, commercial assumptions, and escalation
   

  

 Finance
   

  

 Budget, cost rates, forecast, project financials, margin visibility, and reconciliation
   

  

 HR, IT, and Administration
   

  

 Onboarding, exits, access, assets, employee operations, and workforce records
   

  

**What Good Looks Like After 12 To 18 Months**
* The PBU has one trusted, current view of all roadmap, customer, technical, compliance, and support commitments.
* Six to ten parallel pods operate with predictable delivery rhythm, clear dependencies, and strong quality discipline.
* Leadership receives concise, decision\-ready visibility rather than manual status collection.
* Capacity conflicts, skill gaps, and delivery risks are identified early and resolved through explicit trade\-offs.
* Customer commitments do not silently displace roadmap work.
* Quality, security, release readiness, and production health are integrated into delivery planning.
* Budget, effort, and cost variance are visible and used in priority and investment decisions.
* Onboarding, exits, access, compliance, and audit actions are completed reliably and on time.
* The PBU operates proactively and independently, with fewer escalations caused by unclear ownership or missing information.
* The delivery operating model improves continuously through automation, AI, and measurable process improvement.


**Skills And Experience**
* 6\+ years across software delivery, program management, project management, Agile delivery, product operations, or engineering operations.
* At least 5 years managing Agile software delivery teams, including demonstrated responsibility for multiple teams or workstreams in parallel.
* Experience managing at least 4 teams directly; experience with 6 or more parallel squads or pods is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in integrated delivery planning, resource loading, capacity management, risk and dependency management, and release governance.
* Experience challenging senior stakeholders and influencing Product, Engineering, QA, and customer\-facing teams without direct reporting authority.
* Working knowledge of budgeting, planned\-versus\-actual effort, forecast variance, vendor cost, and project financial health.
* Strong Jira, Confluence, dashboarding, and executive reporting capability.
* Good understanding of software development, APIs, environments, CI/CD, testing, production support, and release management.
* Ability to create structure where information, ownership, and processes are fragmented.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to present clearly to Engineering Heads, PBU Heads, and senior leadership.


**Preferred Experience**
* Enterprise SaaS, B2B software, e\-commerce, supply chain, OMS, WMS, logistics, or fulfilment domain exposure.
* Experience with OMS, order orchestration, e\-commerce, marketplace integrations, order lifecycle management, or omnichannel fulfilment is preferred.
* Experience with customer implementations, product customisation, and roadmap\-versus\-customer trade\-offs.
* Experience managing 30 or more people across virtual or cross\-functional pods.
* Experience with L3 support, production incidents, RCAs, and operational service levels.
* Exposure to ISO, GDPR, SOC 2, information security, or customer audit controls.
* Experience using Power BI, Jira Plans, Advanced Roadmaps, Aha!, or other portfolio\-management tools.
* Experience with AI\-enabled delivery, workflow automation, or reporting automation.
* CSM, PSM, SAFe, PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification.


**Leadership Behaviours We Expect**
 Managers at Anchanto are expected to operate with high ownership, solve problems rather than escalate confusion, use systems and data over opinions, communicate clearly and directly, challenge constructively, build trust through reliability, improve processes continuously, collaborate without bureaucracy, and act with urgency and accountability.
   

  

**What This Role Is Not**
* A ceremony\-only Scrum Master role.
* A Jira administrator or meeting coordinator.
* A passive follow\-up or status\-chasing role.
* A PMO reporting role that presents problems without recommendations.
* A substitute Product Manager, Engineering Manager, Finance partner, or Compliance specialist.
* A role that accepts every stakeholder commitment without validating scope, capacity, quality, and commercial impact.


**Success Measures**
 Indicative KPI
   

  

 What it measures
   

  

 Multi\-pod delivery predictability
   

  

 Commitment reliability, milestone adherence, and delivery confidence across parallel pods
   

  

 Delivery flow
   

  

 Cycle time, lead time, throughput, ageing work, and spillover trends
   

  

 Quality and release health
   

  

 Defect leakage, escaped defects, release failures, production incidents, and RCA closure
   

  

 Capacity effectiveness
   

  

 Resource conflicts, overload, underutilisation, single points of failure, and planned\-versus\-actual allocation
   

  

 Portfolio visibility
   

  

 Accuracy and completeness of the integrated PBU plan and decision log
   

  

 Customer commitment governance
   

  

 Customer work accepted with validated feasibility and no hidden roadmap displacement
   

  

 Financial visibility
   

  

 Planned\-versus\-actual effort, cost variance, forecast accuracy, and project financial inputs
   

  

 Risk and dependency management
   

  

 Critical risks identified early, owned, and closed within agreed timelines
   

  

 PBU administration
   

  

 Onboarding, access, exit, knowledge transfer, and roster accuracy against SLA
   

  

 Compliance readiness
   

  

 ISO, GDPR, security, audit, and regulatory actions closed on time with evidence
   

  

 Leadership reporting
   

  

 Accuracy, timeliness, clarity, and decision usefulness of weekly and monthly PBU reports
   

  

 Automation and improvement
   

  

 Reduction in manual reporting and measurable improvement from AI or workflow automation
   

  

**Closing**
 At Anchanto, faster delivery must come with stronger ownership, better quality, and clearer business visibility. This role builds and runs the operating system that enables a Product Business Unit to deliver as one accountable team. If you are comfortable managing multiple delivery pods, making difficult trade\-offs, challenging senior stakeholders, and creating structure in a fast\-moving environment, this is an opportunity to shape how Anchanto scales its product delivery model.

 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
   

  

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Role Summary:
   

  

 The Risk and Security team (RAS) is a key component of the Value\-Added Services (VAS) PD division within Visa. VAS\-RAS has a suite of high visibility, high\-volume, revenue earning applications that provide solutions related to Risk Management, Identity and Authentication. 34346ee6.title: Technical Program Manager
34346ee6.description:
Job Description: Technical Program Manager (Hackathons \& Innovation Challenges)
 



 Position: Program Manager
 



 Location: Noida, UP, India (On\-site)
 



 Type: Full\-Time
 



  





**The role** 




 You are the single point of ownership for every program you run — end to end, from pre\-launch kickoff to the final debrief. Not the coordinator of it: the owner. Scope, the client relationship, and the final call all sit with you.
 



 What makes this role different from a conventional program management role is where the ownership comes from.
 



 You will be the trusted partner for our clients and the central hub for all internal teams, ensuring that every hackathon is delivered flawlessly, on time, and within budget. This role is for a natural leader who thrives on structure, excels at communication, and has a passion for turning ambitious ideas into reality.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



* Technical program design. Problem statements, evaluation criteria, judging rubrics, and tech\-stack fit. You decide what a good submission looks like and defend that standard to clients and juries.
* End\-to\-end program ownership. Multiple concurrent programs from post\-sales handover through delivery and debrief. Scope, objectives, timelines, and resourcing are yours to define.
* The client relationship, post\-sales. Primary point of contact once sales hands over. You set expectations, manage change, and are the voice on technical scope and feasibility — including on what isn’t deliverable.
* Strategic program architecture. You build the blueprint. Defining objectives, resource allocation, and timelines is your domain. You ensure every component is technically sound and logistically viable before a single line of code is written.
* Internal cross\-functional bridge. You lead the charge across Marketing, Operations, and SME teams. You are the glue that keeps diverse internal stakeholders aligned and focused on delivering a cohesive product.
* Risk and quality gatekeeping. Spotting friction before it happens. You own the mitigation strategies and maintain a relentless standard for the participant experience and final deliverables.
* Scope and fiscal discipline. You hold the line on the budget and the agreed\-upon roadmap. Using rigorous verification, you ensure we deliver exactly what was promised without slippage.
* External partner synchronization. Managing the ecosystem. You direct third\-party vendors and partners to ensure their contributions integrate seamlessly into the live event execution.
* Documentation and executive reporting. Maintaining the narrative of progress. You provide clear, direct visibility on milestones and technical hurdles to both clients and our leadership team.
* Jury and participant experience. Recruiting and briefing evaluators, running the judging process with rigour, and making sure the experience holds up for developers and students who chose to spend a weekend on it.



  





**What you'll need** 



* Deep technical fluency. You can hold an architecture\-level conversation with a client, a jury, or a partner without escalating it. You can read a submission and judge whether it actually works. Hands\-on coding is not required — credible technical judgement is non\-negotiable.
* Experience. 4–7 years in program or project management in a technical environment — technical program management, developer relations, solutions or pre\-sales engineering, or an engineer who moved into program work. Enterprise clients somewhere in that history.
* Domain expertise. Working knowledge of the domains we run challenges in — AI/ML, cloud, and data at minimum. Enough to tell an ambitious problem statement from an unworkable one.
* Enterprise client\-facing strength. Polished, direct, and comfortable holding a line on scope with a senior stakeholder who wants more than was agreed.
* Organisational discipline. Several programs running at once, each with its own client, timeline, and jury. Detail matters and slippage is visible.
* Developer and student community instinct. You understand what makes a hackathon worth entering, and what makes participants disengage.

Experience leading mid to large\-size Oracle programs as a Solution Architect in transformation programs, with a deep understanding of the customer journey to Oracle and the various options available.
  
  

Experience in pre\-sales activities, including leading RFP/RFI responses as Solution Lead, and managing multiple streams within a program such as functional, integration, data migration and change management.

d633ad0b.title: Platform Solution Architect
d633ad0b.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*

**Job Description:**


We are looking for a hands\-on Solution Architect to own the end\-to\-end architecture of our platform and drive its evolution as we scale. You will design, build, and maintain a multi\-service application spanning backend, frontend, AI/ML services, and cloud infrastructure, while ensuring the platform is secure, scalable, and maintainable. As we move deeper into client conversations, this role also requires you to represent engineering in client discussions and lead the design of integrations between our platform and external HRMS (Human Resource Management System) or ATS (Applicant Tracking System) products.  

  

**Role Details:**

* Own the technical architecture of the platform end\-to\-end, including backend services, frontend applications, data stores, and cloud infrastructure.
* Design and evolve a scalable, secure, and maintainable microservices architecture using Java and Spring Boot, deployed on AWS (with a growing footprint on GCP and Azure).
* Guide and review the development of Python FastAPI\-based AI services, including integration with OpenAI and Vapi for conversational/voice AI use cases.
* Define data architecture and access patterns across MongoDB and Redis, ensuring performance, consistency, and cost efficiency at scale.
* Architect and oversee real\-time communication features using WebSockets, and asynchronous messaging workflows via MSG91 (email/SMS) and WhatsApp.
* Set technical direction for the Angular, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS frontend, and the Electron\-based desktop application, ensuring consistency, performance, and code quality.
* Establish and enforce standards for observability and monitoring using Grafana (backend/infra) and Sentry (frontend), including alerting and incident response practices.
* Own authentication and identity architecture across Microsoft SSO and related identity providers, ensuring secure access management for enterprise clients.
* Guide secure use of Microsoft Graph API for email\-based workflows in staffing scenarios, and Judge0 for code\-execution/assessment use cases.
* Drive build vs. buy and tooling decisions, manage technical debt, and maintain architecture documentation (system diagrams, ADRs, data flow diagrams).
* Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines and build processes (Maven and related tooling) to support reliable, frequent releases.
* Participate in client discussions and solutioning calls, translating client requirements into technical designs and realistic delivery estimates.
* **Lead the design and delivery of integrations between our platform and third\-party HRMS/ATS systems (e.g., data sync, SSO, webhooks, candidate/employee data exchange, API\-based or file\-based integrations).**
* Act as the primary technical point of contact for prospective and existing clients on integration feasibility, data security, and architecture questions during pre\-sales and onboarding.
* Mentor engineers across backend, frontend, and AI teams, and conduct architecture/design reviews for major features.

 **Mandatory Technical skills:**

**Backend \& Cloud**

* Java and Spring Boot for building production\-grade microservices
* AWS: strong hands\-on experience across compute, storage, networking, and managed services; working knowledge of GCP and Azure is a plus (platform is moving toward a broader multi/all\-AWS setup)
* MongoDB and Redis: schema/data modeling, indexing, caching strategies, and performance tuning
* Python and FastAPI for AI\-service development
* WebSocket\-based real\-time systems
* Maven\-based build and dependency management
* Grafana for metrics, dashboards, and alerting

**Frontend**

* Angular and TypeScript for enterprise web applications
* Tailwind CSS for scalable, consistent UI styling
* Electron for cross\-platform desktop application development
* Sentry for frontend error monitoring and performance tracking

**Integrations, Messaging \& AI**

* MSG91 (email and SMS) and WhatsApp Business API for transactional/notification workflows
* Vapi for voice bot/conversational AI integrations
* OpenAI APIs for AI\-assisted product features
* Judge0 for code execution/assessment workflows
* Microsoft Graph API for email\-specific staffing workflows
* Microsoft SSO and enterprise identity/authentication protocols (OAuth2, SAML, OIDC)
* Jupyter for prototyping and validating AI/data workflows

 **Mandatory Non\-Technical skills:**

* Experience with additional cloud platforms (GCP, Azure) beyond AWS.
* Familiarity with conversational AI/voice bot platforms and prompt engineering for LLM\-based features.
* Exposure to DevOps practices: containerization, infrastructure\-as\-code, and CI/CD pipeline design.
* Relevant certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, Azure/GCP equivalents) are a plus.

 **Education Qualification and Certifications** required, If any

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8\-14 years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 3\+ years designing and owning system architecture for production applications at scale.
* Demonstrated experience architecting systems that combine backend services, frontend applications, cloud infrastructure, and third\-party integrations.

**Job Description**
**Solutions Architect:**
 Mattel is seeking an experienced Oracle Supply Chain Solution Architect to lead and define requirements for transformation initiatives in our toy manufacturing and distribution operations. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between business needs and technical execution, ensuring our Oracle\-based supply chain solutions drive efficiency, scalability, and innovation.
   

  

 This role will collaborate with business stakeholders, process owners, and technical teams to deliver end\-to\-end solutions—particularly in Order\-to\-Cash (O2C) and other supply chain modules like Inventory, Order Management, Procurement, Costing, PDH —aligned with Mattel’s strategic vision.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Own the Product Vision \& Roadmap Define and maintain a clear product strategy for Oracle Supply Chain modules, ensuring alignment with Mattel’s transformation goals.
* Requirements Gathering \& Prioritization Partner with supply chain leaders, operations teams, and IT to capture detailed business requirements and translate them into functional specifications.
* Solution Design Guidance Work closely with the technical team to design scalable, efficient solutions within Oracle applications (ERP/Cloud), ensuring business needs are met without unnecessary customization.
* Order\-to\-Cash Expertise Lead enhancements and solutions for O2C processes, including order management, fulfillment, invoicing, and revenue recognition.
* Cross\-Module Collaboration Provide input and oversight on related supply chain modules such as Procurement, Inventory, Manufacturing, Logistics, and Planning.
* Backlog Management Create, prioritize, and refine the product backlog, ensuring features are delivered with high business value.
* Testing \& Validation Oversee UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and ensure solutions meet functional, performance, and compliance requirements.
* Continuous Improvement Identify opportunities to improve processes and leverage Oracle capabilities to streamline operations.


**Qualifications**
 Qualifications \& Experience
   

  

* Education Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Information Technology, or related field; MBA or equivalent preferred.
* Experience
* 10\+ years of experience in Oracle Supply Chain solutions (Oracle Fusion Cloud).
* Proven experience as a Solution Architect or similar role driving ERP transformation projects.
* Strong functional expertise in Order\-to\-Cash and at least one additional supply chain module (Procurement, Inventory, Manufacturing, Logistics, or Planning).
* Experience in manufacturing and/or consumer goods industry; toy manufacturing experience a plus.
* Skills
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
* Ability to document and track requirements
* Adept at translating business needs into technical requirements.
* Understanding of Agile delivery methodologies.

**Job Description**
 We are seeking an experienced Enterprise Solution Architect with expertise in High Performance Computing (HPC) and Container platforms in Linux\-based environments to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for architecting solutions including but not limited to installation, configuration, integration and implementation of HPC technologies and enterprise\-grade container orchestration platform.
   

  

 We are looking for a person with very strong technical skills and a proven track record of designing and working with container platforms such as Red Hat OpenShift, SUSE Rancher, CNCF Kubernetes, HPC Schedulers such as Slurm or PBS Pro, HPC/AI Cluster management technologies such as HPCM or BCM and the ability to work in a dynamic customer\-focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills.

* Customer\-centric mindset:

 Â· Communicate complex technical concepts and findings to non\-technical stakeholders

**Required Skills**

 such as operating systems, storage, servers, parallel file systems, schedulers, and container orchestration platforms.

 Â· Knowledge of network protocols like TCP/IP, S3, FTP, NFS, or SMB/CIFS
   

  

 Â· Familiarity with microservices architecture, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps tools.
   

  

 Â· Excellent problem\-solving abilities, analytical thinking, and communication skills to interact with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
   

  

 Â· Ability to lead technical projects by gathering the requirements, preparing the architecture / design and executing it end to end. Must be able to bring clarity and drive complex projects involving multiple stakeholders.

 Â· Demonstrates a solid knowledge of the company's breadth of solutions.

**Qualifications**

81937e6f.title: Delivery Manager - SyncOS
81937e6f.description:
Asia's leading robotics solutions provider, automating enterprise supply chains since 2017\. Botsync is a Singapore\-based robotics and automation company building autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) and intelligent orchestration software that transform warehouse and factory operations across APAC. Founded in 2017, we design, manufacture, and deploy intelligent robots \- including our MAG series \- that handle material movement at scale, so humans can focus on higher\-value work.


Alongside our hardware, we've built syncOS, the industry's first no\-code, vendor\-agnostic orchestration and fleet management platform that coordinates robots, industrial systems, and workflows across modern facilities \- turning weeks\-long deployments into hours, without halting production or calling in specialists.


Today we're still that young, passionate team \- just with more like\-minded people who've joined us along the way. We're all obsessed with one thing: making robotics and automation simpler, faster to adapt, and more reliable on real factory floors.


If you love robots, hate inefficiency, and want to build things that actually run in production \- you'll fit right in.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own SyncOS customer engagements end to end, from scope alignment and implementation planning through testing, acceptance, and production go\-live.
* Align customers and internal teams on outcomes, scope, acceptance criteria, responsibilities, and timelines before execution begins.
* Lead customer communication on delivery progress, decisions, risks, dependencies, and changes.
* Translate each engagement into an execution plan covering SyncOS configuration, integrations, engineering work, testing, and deployment.
* Manage scope, milestones, engineering capacity, dependencies, and risks across multiple active engagements.
* Maintain credible delivery commitments, surface threats early, and drive recovery decisions when plans move off track.
* Develop practical knowledge of SyncOS architecture, workflows, integration points, and deployment constraints.
* Partner with Engineering and Solutions to challenge assumptions and distinguish configuration, integration, and product\-development work.
* Assess the effort and timeline impact of new requirements before they enter execution, keeping customer and internal commitments aligned.
* Escalate trade\-offs between customer needs, product capability, engineering capacity, and delivery commitments when required.
* Build consistent practices for planning, status reporting, risk management, implementation readiness, and handover.
* Capture recurring implementation friction and work with Product and Engineering to standardize, automate, or productize solutions.

  

**Requirements** **Essential:**

* 6\-9 years of experience in technical delivery, implementation, solutions, technical program management, or a similar customer\-facing role.
* Proven ownership of multiple enterprise software implementations from scope definition through production go\-live.
* Experience delivering integration\-heavy software involving multiple systems, dependencies, and customer\-specific constraints.
* Ability to build enough technical depth to challenge estimates, identify dependencies, and contribute meaningfully to implementation discussions.
* Strong scope and change management without compromising customer relationships or delivery commitments.
* Confidence working directly with customers when projects are ambiguous, dependencies fail, or commitments are at risk.
* Experience coordinating engineering capacity across concurrent engagements and making explicit sequencing and prioritization trade\-offs.
* Clear communication with technical teams and senior customer stakeholders, supported by delivery plans grounded in underlying work and dependencies.

 **Highly desirable:**

* Exposure to industrial automation, robotics, warehouse automation, manufacturing software, workflow orchestration, integration, or low\-code platforms.
* Experience integrating WMS, MES, ERP, PLCs, automation equipment, or customer APIs in live operational environments, with evidence of standardizing repeated delivery work.

 **Benefits**  

* Competitive salary
* Comprehensive health benefits package
* Hustle of a young startup, always something to do and something to improve
* Opportunities for professional development and growth into management roles
* Collaborative and inclusive work environment

9e7d709f.title: Implementation Engagement Manager
9e7d709f.description:
Black Duck Software, Inc. helps organizations build secure, high\-quality software, minimizing risks while maximizing speed and productivity. Black Duck, a recognized pioneer in application security, provides SAST, SCA, and DAST solutions that enable teams to quickly find and fix vulnerabilities and defects in proprietary code, open source components, and application behavior. With a combination of industry\-leading tools, services, and expertise, only Black Duck helps organizations maximize security and quality in DevSecOps and throughout the software development life cycle.
   

  

 Are you an energetic and customer\-focused
 **Project or Program Manager** 
 ? Are you action\-oriented and proactive by nature? Can you quickly decompose complex concepts and explain them in a way that makes sense to technical and non\-technical audiences? If so, we want to speak to you!
   

  

**Black Duck** 
 , a repeated leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Application Security, is seeking an experienced Project / Engagement Manager to help our Implementation and Services Team drive customer onboarding and adoption. We’re looking for someone to help take our business to the next level of excellence in delivery and customer delight!
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Black Duck Technical Services team is dedicated to supporting our customers in developing their AppSec vision and achieving their goals quickly. We accomplish this through the delivery of exemplary product implementations and adoption\-focused services that are tailored to their specific needs. Our services are designed to help customers of all sizes and types, from Startup’s to global organizations, build secure, high\-quality software faster and maximize the value of their Black Duck tools.
   

  

**A Day in Your Life** 
  

  

 In this role, you'll be responsible for the planning and successful implementation of Black Duck solutions to help the world’s leading technology companies meet their software security goals.
   

  

* Project Management: You’ll serve as project lead and own all functional aspects of the engagement. This includes requirements gathering and translating the scope of work into a project plan containing milestones, deliverables, dependencies, critical path, and RACI.
* Delivery: You’ll coordinate people (vertical, horizontally) and processes to ensure projects are delivered on\-time, on\-track, and within budget to consistently produce high quality outcomes.
* Communication: You’ll establish and maintain relationships at all levels of the customer organization including project team members, executive sponsors and key stakeholders.
* Status Reporting: You’ll develop status reports and communicate clear, accurate, and timely updates regarding project health and progress
* Risk Management: You’ll diagnose implementation challenges/risks, develop contingency plans, and implement changes to drive risk mitigation.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: You’ll lead cross\-functional teams (collocated and remote) to ensure stakeholders (Sales, TAMs, CSMs, Tech Support, SEs, etc.) are aligned and informed.
* Accountability: You’ll set clear expectations with internal and external team members and hold them accountable for deadlines and project deliverables.
* Process Improvement: You’ll document lessons learned and recommend process and methodology improvements to improve execution on future projects.


**About You**
 You’ll have:
   

  

* At least 5 years of experience in a client\-facing professional services, consulting, or project management role.
* Proactive, thorough, and transparent in communication \- people rarely need to follow up with you.
* Process driven and have a strong desire to create, implement, and iterate on processes that lead to a standardized and positive customer experience.
* Exceptional EQ, critical thinking and problem\-solving skills
* Experience working in a global environment and supporting customers in different time\-zones.
* Experience with mixed onshore/offshore delivery models.
* Proven ability to lead projects for both SaaS and On\-prem solutions.
* Willingness to work flexible hours to support North America and EMEA customer engagements.


 You May Have:
   

  

* A track record of managing onboarding / adoption focused professional services and customer success engagements for complex products.
* Familiarity with the DevOps and Application Security space
* PMP, PRINCE2 Foundation/PRINCE2 Practitioner, or other project management certification.
* Experience with PSA and Project Management tools, preferably with one or more of the following: Salesforce, TeamWork, Certinia, Confluence, Jira


**Your Education:**
* A bachelors or masters degree


*Black Duck is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, age, disability, sexual orientation, veteran or military service status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Black Duck complies with all applicable laws prohibiting employment discrimination in every jurisdiction where it operates and provides reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law.*

8aacebdc.description:
**Job Title: Program Manager – Certification Development****Location: Remote**  

EC\-Council is the world’s largest cyber security technical certification body. We operate in 170 countries globally and we are the owner and developer of various world\-famous cyber security programs. We are proud to have trained and certified over 400,000 information security professionals globally that have influenced the cyber security mindset of countless organizations worldwide. **www.eccouncil.org** **Role Overview:**
We are looking for an experienced Program Manager – Assessment \& Certification Development to lead the end\-to\-end development and continuous improvement of professional certification assessments.  

This role sits at the intersection of assessment strategy, certification development, subject\-matter expertise, psychometrics, and program governance. The successful candidate will work closely with internal stakeholders, subject\-matter experts, psychometricians, and certification governance committees to ensure that our assessments accurately measure the knowledge, skills, and competencies required for professionals in the field.  

The role requires strong program management capability, assessment expertise, attention to detail, and the ability to operate effectively within a highly governed certification environment. **Key Responsibilities:*** Lead the end\-to\-end assessment and certification development lifecycle, from JTA and competency analysis through exam blueprinting, item development, validation, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Lead Job Task Analysis (JTA) and ensure assessments are aligned to current industry roles, tasks, competencies, and professional practice.
* Develop and maintain exam blueprints, assessment specifications, competency models, and content domains in collaboration with SMEs and psychometric professionals.
* Lead item development, review, validation, and performance analysis, ensuring items meet quality, relevance, cognitive\-level, and technical standards.
* Apply strong knowledge of psychometric principles, including validity, reliability, fairness, standard setting, item analysis, and assessment performance.
* Coordinate SME workshops, validation studies, and assessment reviews and translate findings into actionable assessment improvements.
* Ensure assessment development is well\-documented, evidence\-based, and aligned with certification governance and accreditation requirements.
* Manage multiple assessment\-development programs, including timelines, SMEs, stakeholders, risks, and deliverables.
* Collaborate with Certification Operations, Exam Security, Product, Technology, and other teams to ensure assessments are ready for secure and effective delivery.
Identify opportunities to improve the quality, scalability, efficiency, and defensibility of certification assessments.  
* 

  

**What We're Looking For:*** PhD or master’s degree in psychology, Assessment, Education, Technology, Cybersecurity, Business, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in professional certification, assessment/examination development, credentialing, or psychometrics.
* Proven experience managing high\-stakes professional certification or assessment programs.
* Strong knowledge of Job Task Analysis (JTA), Role Delineation/Job Practice Analysis, exam blueprinting, item development, content validation, and assessment governance.
* Strong working knowledge of psychometric principles, including validity, reliability, item analysis, statistical evaluation, and standard setting.
* Experience working with SMEs, psychometricians, item writers, and cross\-functional stakeholders to develop and validate assessments.
* Strong program management, analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
* Experience in an accredited or standards\-driven certification environment preferred.
* ISO/IEC 17024 knowledge is a strong plus.
Experience in cybersecurity, IT, technology, or professional certification is an advantage.  
* 

  

**About Our Culture:**
EC\-Council is driven by a mission to strengthen global cybersecurity capability and advance the profession of ethical hacking and information security. Our teams operate across regions and cultures, united by integrity, professionalism, and a commitment to meaningful impact. Continuous learning and accountability are encouraged, empowering individuals to take ownership of their contributions. Respect, trust, and ethical conduct guide how we work with colleagues, partners, and the global cybersecurity community. **Additional Information:**
EC\-Council is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. We do not discriminate based on these or any other characteristics protected by applicable laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

If you have a medical condition or disability that limits your ability to complete any part of the application process and require reasonable accommodation, please contact us at ecchr@eccouncil.org and let us know how we can assist.  

To be eligible for this position, candidates must be able to provide proof that they are either a citizen of the country or have legal authorization to work in the country where the position is posted and are currently residing there. EC\-Council does not offer employment to ineligible candidates and reserves the right to revoke employment in case the candidate loses the authorization to work.  

If, as part of the recruitment process, you are required to complete or submit any form of work, project, case study, or assignment, please note that such material will be considered the exclusive property of EC\-Council. By submitting such work, you acknowledge that EC\-Council retains all rights, title, and interest in the submitted content, including any intellectual property contained therein.
