5cb3a843.title: Business Program Manager
5cb3a843.description:
Fynd is a frontier technology company. We started at the intersection of technology and retail because that is where technology was the least available. Over the years, we became one of India’s largest retail technology platforms. But retail was the entry point, not the boundary.  

Today, Fynd builds intelligent software that runs business operations. Not tools that help people work faster, but systems that absorb entire functions: manufacturing, marketing, logistics, commerce, quality control. We sit inside our customers’ businesses, harvest deep domain context, and build AI systems that operate autonomously. We are expanding from retail into manufacturing, generative media, physical AI, and healthcare. **Role Overview**
We are looking for a **Business Program Manager –** Retail Digital Transformation \& GenAI who can translate complex business challenges into scalable technology solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of the retail domain, preferably within the Fashion and Lifestyle sector, along with experience in digital transformation and technology\-led product development.
You will own the product vision and requirements, analyse existing business processes, identify gaps, and work with cross\-functional teams to develop and roll out effective solutions. You will also use Generative AI tools to improve product discovery, requirement analysis, prototyping, and overall execution. **What will you do at Fynd?****Product Strategy and Ownership*** Own the product vision, roadmap, and execution for assigned retail technology solutions.
* Understand business objectives and convert them into clear product requirements and priorities.
* Create detailed product requirement documents, user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria.
* Prioritise product features based on business impact, customer needs, technical feasibility, and available resources.
* Define measurable success metrics and track product performance after launch.
* Ensure that product initiatives are aligned with the company’s overall business and technology strategy.

**Business Process and Gap Analysis*** Understand and document existing retail and operational processes.
* Break down complex business processes and identify inefficiencies, gaps, and automation opportunities.
* Identify business requirements and scenarios that may not be clearly articulated by stakeholders.
* Recommend technology\-led solutions to improve operational efficiency and customer experience.
* Work closely with business teams to validate requirements and ensure that proposed solutions address the actual problem.
* Develop a strong understanding of retail, fashion and lifestyle, e\-commerce, supply chain, inventory, and omnichannel operations.

**Product Development and Delivery*** Work closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Operations, and Business teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Drive product development from requirement gathering and solution design to testing and production rollout.
* Coordinate product testing, User Acceptance Testing, issue resolution, and launch readiness.
* Ensure that all business and functional requirements are validated before product rollout.
* Manage dependencies, risks, and delivery timelines across multiple stakeholders.
* Support business teams during implementation and ensure smooth product adoption.
* Monitor post\-launch performance and drive continuous product improvements.

**Generative AI and Technical Understanding*** Use Generative AI tools for research, requirement analysis, prototyping, documentation, and problem\-solving.
* Identify opportunities to embed AI capabilities into products and business workflows.
* Work with technical teams to assess the feasibility and scalability of AI\-led solutions.
* Have a good understanding of APIs, integrations, data flows, system architecture, and technology dependencies.
* Stay updated on developments in Generative AI, retail technology, and digital transformation.
* Experiment with new AI tools and approaches to improve product development speed and quality.

**Stakeholder Management*** Collaborate with senior business leaders, customers, Product, Engineering, Design, Operations, and other cross\-functional teams.
* Conduct requirement\-gathering workshops and product demonstrations.
* Communicate product decisions, priorities, dependencies, and progress clearly to stakeholders.
* Handle conflicting requirements and provide constructive pushback when required.
* Manage stakeholder expectations while maintaining focus on product and business outcomes.
* Present product updates, risks, recommendations, and performance metrics to senior leadership.

 **Some Specific Requirements*** 4–8 years of experience in Product Management, Digital Transformation, Business Transformation, or a similar role.
* Strong experience in owning technology products from discovery and requirement gathering through launch and adoption.
* Experience in retail technology, e\-commerce, Fashion and Lifestyle, omnichannel commerce, supply chain, or related domains.
* Strong hands\-on exposure to Generative AI tools and their application in product development and business operations.
* Experience creating product roadmaps, PRDs, user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria.
* Hands\-on experience managing product testing, UAT, implementation, and rollout.
* Ability to analyse complex business processes and identify unarticulated requirements or operational gaps.
* Good understanding of APIs, integrations, data flows, and enterprise technology systems.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment, handle pressure, and manage multiple priorities.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to challenge assumptions and provide informed pushback.
* A proactive, articulate, and ownership\-driven approach to work.

**Good to Have*** Experience working with enterprise retail or Fashion and Lifestyle brands.
* Experience leading large\-scale digital transformation programmes.
* Exposure to Order Management Systems, Warehouse Management Systems, inventory management, marketplaces, or store operations.
* Experience using AI tools to build prototypes, automate workflows, or support product decision\-making.
* Prior experience working in a B2B SaaS or enterprise technology company.

 **What do we offer?** **Growth**
At Fynd, growth is limitless. We nurture a culture that encourages innovation, embraces challenges, and supports continuous learning. As we expand into new product lines and global markets, we’re seeking talented individuals eager to grow with us.
We believe in empowering our people to take ownership, lead with confidence, and shape their careers.* Learning Wallet: Enrol in external courses or certifications to upskill—we’ll reimburse the costs to support your development.

**Culture**
We believe in building strong teams and lasting connections.* Regular community engagement and team\-building activities
* Biannual events to celebrate achievements, foster collaboration, and strengthen our workplace culture

**Wellness**
Your well\-being is our priority. Comprehensive Mediclaim policy for you, your spouse, children, and parents **Work Environment**
We thrive on collaboration and creativity. Our teams work from the office five days a week to encourage open communication, teamwork, and innovation.  

Join us to be part of a dynamic environment where your ideas make an impact!

e98655ec.title: Solution Architect - Shared Services
e98655ec.description:
**Job ID** R.0061427 **Primary location** Bengaluru, Karnataka **Date posted** 09/11/2026 **Worker type** Regular **Workplace flexibility** Remote \- Nationwide Save


Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well\-being, and work\-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.


Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.


**Job Summary**
===============


As a Solution Architect at Empower, you will be a hands\-on technical leader and solution\-shaping architecture contributor supporting Human Resources, Legal, Compliance, and the Office of the CIO. You will partner with business leaders, Business and Enterprise Architects, product owners, cybersecurity, engineering, operations, data, and vendor teams to translate business outcomes, regulatory obligations, and operational needs into secure, scalable, resilient, and cost\-effective end\-to\-end solutions.


The role spans SaaS platforms, cloud services, applications, integrations, data, and infrastructure, with particular emphasis on ServiceNow and AWS. You will guide initiatives from discovery through implementation, define target\-state and reference architectures, document decisions and trade\-offs, and establish reusable patterns and guardrails. You will also support the broader shared\-services technology landscape, including Atlassian Jira and Confluence, Palantir Foundry, SQL Server, and PostgreSQL, while ensuring solutions are supportable, observable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise standards.


**Responsibilities**
====================


* Own end\-to\-end solution architecture for moderately to highly complex initiatives across Human Resources, Legal, Compliance, and the Office of the CIO, connecting business capabilities and processes to application, integration, data, security, and technology designs.
* Lead discovery and translate functional and nonfunctional requirements \- including security, privacy, records retention, auditability, availability, recovery, performance, scalability, supportability, and cost \- into practical architecture options and recommendations.
* Create and maintain architecture deliverables such as current\-state and target\-state views, context and logical diagrams, deployment models, data flows, integration designs, nonfunctional requirements, architecture decision records, reference architectures, roadmaps, and transition plans.
* Serve as a ServiceNow architecture lead, defining scalable platform and solution designs across workflows, the platform data model, CSDM and CMDB, integrations, identity and security, custom applications, environment strategy, performance, upgradeability, and platform governance. Evaluate fit\-to\-platform and minimize unnecessary customization.
* Design AWS solutions aligned with AWS Well\-Architected principles across identity and access management, networking, compute, storage, databases, integration, observability, backup and recovery, high availability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
* Define and guide infrastructure automation using AWS CloudFormation and/or Terraform, including reusable templates and modules, source control, automated validation, environment promotion, secrets handling, policy guardrails, and stack, state, and drift management.
* Embed DevOps and DevSecOps practices into solution designs, including CI/CD, automated testing, security scanning, release and rollback strategies, monitoring and logging, alerting, incident readiness, and operational handoff.
* Architect secure, reusable integration patterns across SaaS platforms, AWS, on\-premises systems, and vendor ecosystems using APIs, events, messaging, files, and data pipelines. Define contracts, authentication, error handling, observability, and lifecycle governance.
* Guide relational database architecture for SQL Server and PostgreSQL, including data design, performance, security, high availability and disaster recovery, backup and recovery, migration, and appropriate use of AWS managed database services.
* Provide architecture oversight through delivery by reviewing detailed designs, guiding engineering teams, leading proofs of concept, resolving cross\-system dependencies, and verifying implementation against approved architecture.
* Evaluate technologies and vendor solutions, advise on build, buy, and configure decisions, and identify opportunities to simplify, modernize, rationalize, and optimize the shared\-services application portfolio and run cost.
* Contribute to architecture standards, design\-review forums, reusable patterns, decision records, and lessons learned. Communicate recommendations, risks, and trade\-offs clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================


* At least 5 years of progressive experience designing and delivering enterprise technology solutions, including ownership of end\-to\-end solution design for multiple moderately to highly complex initiatives.
* Demonstrated ServiceNow solution or platform architecture experience in a large enterprise environment \- not solely platform administration or development \- including translating business requirements into platform capabilities and governing implementation.
* Deep knowledge of the ServiceNow platform architecture, including but not limited to, application scopes, Business Rules, Script Includes, ACLs, APIs, and platform configuration.
* Strong AWS architecture experience and working knowledge across core cloud domains, with the ability to evaluate security, resilience, operational, performance, and cost trade\-offs.
* Hands\-on experience with infrastructure as code using AWS CloudFormation and/or Terraform, including reusable components and automated deployment workflows.
* DevOps or DevSecOps experience with Git\-based delivery, CI/CD, automated testing, deployment automation, observability, and production supportability.
* Enterprise application and integration architecture experience across SaaS, cloud, and on\-premises systems, with strong knowledge of API, event, identity, and data integration patterns.
* Experience designing solutions using both SQL Server and PostgreSQL, with an understanding of performance, security, high availability and disaster recovery, backup and recovery, and migration considerations.
* Ability to define and evaluate functional and nonfunctional requirements and to design for privacy, security, auditability, segregation of duties, records management, and other controls appropriate to sensitive or regulated environments.
* Strong architecture modeling and documentation skills, with experience in design reviews, architecture decision records, reference patterns, and implementation governance.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, facilitation, and communication skills, with the ability to influence cross\-functional teams and explain technical decisions, risks, and trade\-offs to varied audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================


* ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or comparable architecture\-level experience; Certified System Administrator (CSA), Certified Application Developer (CAD), or relevant Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) credentials.
* Architecture experience with ServiceNow capabilities relevant to shared services, such as ITSM, ITOM, Strategic Portfolio Management, HR Service Delivery, Integrated Risk Management or GRC, Legal Service Delivery, App Engine or Workflow Studio, Integration Hub, MID Server, CSDM, and CMDB.
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect \- Associate or Professional, and/or a HashiCorp Terraform certification.
* Enterprise architecture or administration experience with Atlassian Jira and Confluence, including workflows, permissions, automation, integrations, Marketplace app governance, and cloud or data\-center lifecycle management.
* Palantir Foundry experience, including data integration and pipelines, Ontology modeling, application or workflow enablement, security and governance, and production lifecycle practices.
* Experience supporting Human Resources, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Finance, or Office of the CIO technology capabilities in a regulated enterprise.
* Experience with containers, serverless computing, event\-driven architecture, microservices, and scripting or automation languages.
* Familiarity with architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, Agile or product operating models, SaaS and platform lifecycle management, vendor evaluation, cloud financial management or FinOps, and application rationalization.

**Education**
=============


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. A master's degree is a plus.

**Physical Requirements/Working Conditions**
============================================


* Normal office working conditions.

Do we want to call out another qualification: Deep knowledge of the ServiceNow platform architecture, including but not limited to, application scopes, Business Rules, Script Includes, ACLs, APIs, and platform configuration.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, religion, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable state or local law.

When an incident closes, make sure the knowledge base captures the cause, permanent fix and lessons learned.

* Recommend, configure and validate RBI\-approved Hazelcast designs for high availability, resilience, throughput and scalability in line with Hazelcast guidance, working with L2 and developers on complex workflow, connector, integration and performance issues.
* Plan and carry out approved UAT, pre\-production and production updates with impact and risk analysis, approved operating procedures, test and rollback plans, execution in approved maintenance windows and post\-change validation.
* Advise RBI security teams on Hazelcast hardening; assess releases and patches and maintain upgrade, adoption and infrastructure\-lifecycle roadmap recommendations.
* Work with RBI’s performance\-monitoring team to establish baselines, diagnose bottlenecks and implement tuning and configuration improvements with measurable before\-and\-after results.
* Perform capacity planning and sizing and conduct periodic capacity and utilization reviews, including annual audits and corrective recommendations for threshold breaches.
* Maintain senior\-level operating procedures and technical documentation; guide L1/L2 teams through knowledge sharing, current industry trends, best practices and thoughtful automation.
* Provide senior oversight for complex or escalated service requests, authorizations, coordination issues and configuration\-backup concerns, while the L2 TAM owns routine handling. Help keep the agreed roles and responsibilities (RACI) and escalation matrix current, join remote, OEM and on\-call coverage, and contribute to quarterly service\-level reporting and RBI certification. The team supports unlimited cases, with response targets of 30 minutes initially and 1 hour ongoing for P1; 1 hour and 2 hours for P2; 4 hours and 8 business hours for P3; and 8 hours and 2 working days for all other cases.

  

### **WHAT YOU HAVE**

  

* Graduate qualification such as BE, BSc, MCA or equivalent; an engineering background is preferred.
* At least 6 years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years designing, implementing and upgrading Hazelcast or the directly relevant OEM product.
* Advanced Hazelcast architecture, configuration, high\-availability, resilience and distributed\-caching expertise, including security hardening and lifecycle management across UAT, pre\-production and production.
* Demonstrated ownership of complex production incidents, P1 root\-cause analysis, permanent corrective actions and OEM engineering/support escalations.
* Strong performance\-tuning, capacity\-planning, sizing, throughput and scalability skills supported by measurable validation.
* Ability to work with RBI stakeholders, developers and L1/L2 teams; communicate recommendations and approved decisions clearly and produce strong operating procedures, configuration records, root\-cause analysis reports, roadmaps and knowledge\-transfer guidance.
* Be prepared to share degree records, project dates, relevant experience and evidence of your Hazelcast or OEM association so Hazelcast can support RBI’s approval process.

  

### **About Hazelcast**


The world's largest leading companies trust Hazelcast and its unified real\-time data platform to take instant action on streaming data. With a stream processing engine and fast data store integrated into a single solution, businesses can simplify real\-time architectures for next\-gen applications and AI/ML departments to drive new revenue, mitigate risk, and operate efficiently \- at a low TCO.
  

  

To learn more about Hazelcast, or to join our community of CXOs, architects, and developers at brands such as HSBC, JPMorgan Chase, Volvo, New York Life, Domino's, and others, visit hazelcast.com  

  

**Equal Opportunities at Hazelcast**  

  

We welcome people from all backgrounds, ethnicities, races, religions, gender, sexual identities, abilities, and personal circumstances, in a spirit of inclusivity and belonging.We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer, and believe we see strength in diversity.  

  

If you require any accommodation to assist you in the interview process, please submit this with your application.We offer competitive salaries with a flexible, empathetic and highly collaborative working environment.  

  

If you are motivated by the prospect of a career with a forward\-thinking tech company, we'd love to hear from you.

da0401bb.title: Architect- DEX
da0401bb.description:
Overview:

This role sits within PepsiCo’s global IT Operations team and focuses on transforming the way IT incidents and service requests are handled through intelligent automation and self\-healing. The Self\-Healing and Service Desk Automation Specialist plays a key role in designing, developing, and deploying automated solutions—primarily using SysTrack Selfheal—to proactively detect and resolve issues before they impact users. You’ll work closely with service desk teams, infrastructure engineers, and digital workplace specialists to identify automation opportunities, build playbooks, and continuously enhance system performance and user experience. Beyond technical delivery, the role emphasizes data\-driven decision\-making, agile collaboration, and end\-user experience improvement. In essence, this role is about bridging IT operations and automation engineering—turning reactive support into proactive, self\-healing systems that reduce tickets, improve MTTR, and enhance digital experience across the enterprise.
Responsibilities:
* Be a part of a global engineering team responsible for designing, developing, and deploying self\-healing and automation solutions.
* Design and implement automated solutions using SysTrack Selfheal to resolve IT incidents and service requests efficiently.
* Drive improvements in the Digital Employee Experience (DEX) score through targeted automation and self\-healing use cases.
* Collaborate closely with the End\-User Computing (EUC) and Global Workspace Services (GWS) teams to ensure the proper implementation of permanent fixes (solves) derived from Problem Management to address root causes impacting DEX.
* Develop and maintain playbooks for self\-healing actions, ensuring accuracy and effectiveness.
* Integrate SysTrack Selfheal with existing IT infrastructure and monitoring tools.
* Analyse incident and service request data to identify opportunities for automation.
* Collaborate with the Service Desk team to identify and prioritize automation initiatives.
* Continuously monitor and improve the performance of self\-healing automation.
* Provide technical support to the Service Desk team on SysTrack Selfheal functionalities.
* Stay up to date on the latest advancements in SysTrack Selfheal, automation best practices, and other relevant ITSM/ITOM tools.
* Agile software development practices for customizations to the platform and applications.
* Implement ITSM modules, workflow customization, ticketing process automation, report development, dashboard creation, and system configurations.
* Deliver a high level of knowledge and customer service within the ITSM Suite.
* Organize and prioritize development efforts, interface with vendors and management, and potentially coordinate the efforts of additional administrators.
* Consider dependencies, relationships, and integration points to ensure proper solution integration with other systems when applicable.
* Effectively manage and execute high\-level tasks assigned via user stories.


Qualifications:
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Total 11\+ years of experience in IT Operations/Service Management/Service Desk /End User Computing arena:
	+ 5\+ years of working knowledge of Selfheal or Digital Experience (DEX) monitoring tools, like Systrack, Nexthink, Riverbed, Aptean, etc.
	+ 8\+ years of experience in IT Process Automation using tools like UiPath, Automation Anywhere, etc.
	+ 5\+ Years of experience working on the ServiceNow Platform (ITSM, Process Mining, etc.)
	+ 10\+ years of ITIL experience, certified ITIL v3 Expert/Intermediate or ITIL 4 Practitioner.
* Excellent communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Must have very strong storytelling and MS PowerPoint skills.
* Understanding of Agile ways of working – Scrum ceremonies.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in English and the ability to concisely express complex issues/solutions.

62c33ac4.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
62c33ac4.description:
**Description**
 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
   

  

**What You'll Actually Be Doing**
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation \& ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


**You're Our Person If...**
* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third\-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Cloud Solution Delivery Lead Consultant to join our team in Pune, Mahārāshtra (IN\-MH), India (IN).

 We are looking for Senior Azure Platform Engineers to join a newly formed Azure squad within a cloud platform engineering service we are delivering for a leading UK financial services organisation.
   

  

 You will be a founding member of a five\-person squad, working in two\-week sprints under a UK\-based Engineering Lead and alongside an established AWS squad. The team builds the client's Azure platform as a set of reusable, versioned products — landing zones, Terraform modules, policy baselines, standard images and CI/CD pipelines — consumed by engineering teams across the organisation through a self\-service internal developer platform. As a senior engineer you will take ownership of significant platform components, set the engineering bar for the squad, and help establish its standards and ways of working from day one.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Platform engineering: Design and build Azure landing zone components — subscription vending, networking, identity integration, policy baselines and guardrails — as reusable Terraform modules.
* Component ownership: Own significant platform products end\-to\-end: design, build, test, documentation and release management.
* CI/CD pipelines: Build and maintain GitHub Actions pipelines for infrastructure delivery, with security scanning, policy checks, testing and cost controls embedded as quality gates.
* Azure Local and hybrid: Contribute to the engineering of Azure Local capability and hybrid automation, extending the platform model into the client's private cloud estate.
* Standard images: Build and maintain pipelines for hardened compute standard images (build, test, publication).
* Self\-service products: Package platform capabilities for consumption as self\-service golden paths through the Port.io developer portal catalogue.
* Engineering standards: Help establish squad conventions — code review discipline, module structure, testing standards and documentation — and uphold them through peer review.
* Mentoring: Support and coach the squad's mid\-level engineers; contribute to design discussions with the Engineering Lead and Platform Architect.


**Required Experience**
* 10\+ years: in infrastructure, cloud or DevOps engineering, of which 8\+ years hands\-on Azure engineering.
* Azure platform depth: Strong experience with enterprise Azure — management groups, subscription design, Azure Policy, networking (hub\-spoke or vWAN), Entra ID and security baselines.
* Terraform: Advanced, production Terraform experience: writing reusable modules, managing state, versioning and testing infrastructure code.
* CI/CD: Hands\-on experience building infrastructure pipelines with GitHub Actions or an equivalent platform (Azure DevOps, GitLab CI) with willingness to standardise on GitHub Actions.
* Engineering discipline: Strong Git workflow, code review and documentation habits; experience working in sprint\-based agile teams.
* Collaboration: Comfortable working in a distributed team with UK\-based technical leadership and client stakeholders; clear written and spoken English.


**Technologies \& Tools**
 The Azure squad operates a modern, standardised toolchain:
   

  

* Core: Azure, Azure Local (Azure Stack HCI), Azure Arc, Terraform, GitHub, GitHub Actions.
* Policy and security: Azure Policy, Wiz and Checkov IaC scanning, OPA policy\-as\-code.
* Pipeline quality: tflint, terraform\-docs, Infracost, Terratest.
* Orchestration: GitHub Actions for standard workflows; Temporal for complex, long\-running orchestration.
* Consumption: Port.io internal developer portal as the self\-service consumption route for Azure and private cloud products.
* Standard images: Image pipeline tooling for compute standard images (build, hardening, testing, publication).


**Desirable**
* Microsoft certifications (AZ\-104 Azure Administrator, AZ\-305 Azure Solutions Architect, AZ\-400 DevOps Engineer).
* Azure Local / Azure Stack HCI or Azure Arc experience.
* Experience with policy\-as\-code (OPA, Sentinel) and IaC security scanning (Checkov, Wiz, tfsec).
* Exposure to internal developer portals (Port.io, Backstage) or platform engineering models.
* Experience in financial services or similarly regulated environments.
* Scripting in Python, PowerShell or Bash for automation tooling.

We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. **Group Function** \- The Intelligent Automation department, serves as the Center of Excellence within the Customer Experience \& Digital division, driving automation projects at FAB. The Specialist is expected to support other team members in completing projects on schedule while adhering to engineering processes such as code reviews, source control, unit testing, use case analysis, and defect management. The Solution Architect – Senior is responsible for defining and developing solution architectures that align with enterprise architecture strategies, principles, policies, standards, and business requirements. The role involves translating complex business and technical requirements into scalable solution designs, evaluating multiple architectural options, conducting cost\-benefit analysis, and recommending optimized solutions. The Solution Architect – Senior also stays current with emerging technologies and supports pilots and proof\-of\-concept initiatives to validate new technology capabilities.


Key Responsibilities


* Define solution and system architectures in alignment with enterprise architecture strategies, standards, reference architectures, and technology principles.
* Decompose systems into components, perform functional allocation, and establish interfaces between systems and system components.
* Develop and evaluate multiple solution options, conduct cost\-benefit analysis, and recommend optimized solutions based on business and technical requirements.
* Design scalable architecture solutions for cloud\-based platforms, enterprise applications, data and analytics platforms, and integrated systems.

**Job Description**
-------------------


**Job Description: Architecture Lead / Chief Architect**
========================================================


**Position:** Architecture Lead / Chief Architect
  

**Experience:** 15 to 18 years
  

**Project Exposure:** Public spaces, high\-rise buildings, large\-scale commercial, institutional, mixed\-use, civic, and infrastructure\-related developments


**Role Summary**
----------------


We are looking for an experienced and design\-driven Architecture Lead / Chief Architect to lead architectural design, planning, coordination, and delivery for large\-scale public space and high\-rise building projects. The role requires strong capability in master planning, concept development, façade design coordination, digitalisation initiatives, BIM\-enabled workflows, PPVC and precast project coordination, design management, multidisciplinary coordination, client presentations, stakeholder engagement, collaboration with international consultants, and team leadership. The candidate should be able to drive design excellence, improve digital design processes, manage complex project interfaces, and ensure timely delivery of technically sound, cost\-effective, buildable, and high\-quality architectural solutions.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Lead architectural design and planning for public spaces, high\-rise buildings, mixed\-use developments, commercial, institutional, and large\-scale building projects.
* Develop and guide master planning, site planning, zoning, circulation, massing, built\-form, spatial organization, and architectural design strategies.
* Drive projects from concept design through schematic design, design development, tender documentation, construction documentation, and site coordination stages.
* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of architects, senior architects, BIM teams, consultants, and design coordinators to ensure quality and timely delivery.
* Prepare, review, and present design concepts, technical proposals, design narratives, reports, drawings, and presentation material for clients and senior stakeholders.
* Coordinate with structural, MEP, façade, landscape, interiors, sustainability, fire and life safety, BIM, planning, contracts, procurement, and execution teams.
* Coordinate façade design intent, façade systems, materials, performance requirements, interfaces, mock\-ups, and technical details in collaboration with façade consultants and specialist vendors.
* Collaborate with international design consultants, specialist architects, façade experts, and global technical teams to align design intent, local requirements, execution feasibility, and project deliverables.
* Ensure integrated design coordination across disciplines and resolve design clashes, interface issues, technical queries, and constructability challenges.
* Manage client interactions, consultant workshops, stakeholder review meetings, design presentations, and approval processes.
* Drive design decisions with focus on functionality, aesthetics, statutory compliance, constructability, cost effectiveness, value engineering, and project timelines.
* Review architectural drawings, BIM models, specifications, material proposals, design calculations, area statements, and technical deliverables for accuracy and completeness.
* Ensure compliance with applicable local building regulations, statutory norms, NBC provisions, accessibility requirements, fire safety norms, and project\-specific design standards.
* Support business development and tender\-stage submissions through design inputs, technical write\-ups, concept presentations, scope definition, and design strategy.
* Monitor design progress, identify risks, manage dependencies, and drive closure of design deliverables in line with project milestones.
* Drive digitalisation initiatives including BIM\-based design coordination, model\-based reviews, digital collaboration platforms, design automation, standardization of workflows, and improved information management across project teams.
* Coordinate architectural design requirements for PPVC, precast, modular construction, DfMA approaches, lifting and installation constraints, module planning, interface details, tolerance coordination, and site execution requirements.
* Promote innovation, digital design workflows, BIM\-based coordination, standardization, sustainable design principles, and best practices across the architecture team.
**Required Qualifications and Experience**
------------------------------------------


* Bachelor’s degree in Architecture; Master’s degree in Architecture, Urban Design, Planning, or related field will be an added advantage.
* 15 to 18 years of professional experience in architectural design, design management, and multidisciplinary coordination.
* Strong project experience in public spaces, high\-rise buildings, large\-scale commercial, institutional, civic, transport, mixed\-use, hospitality, or infrastructure\-related developments.
* Proven experience in leading architecture teams and managing complex design deliverables across multiple project stages.
* Experience in client\-facing roles, design reviews, consultant coordination, stakeholder management, and senior\-level presentations.
* Experience in façade design coordination, façade consultant reviews, building envelope integration, material finalization, performance coordination, and interface resolution for high\-rise and large\-scale projects.
* Demonstrated ability to work with international consultants, overseas design offices, global specialist teams, and multidisciplinary stakeholders across different work cultures, time zones, and project delivery standards.
* Hands\-on experience in digitalisation of design delivery, BIM\-led coordination, digital review workflows, common data environments, design dashboards, and technology\-enabled project coordination.
* Project experience in PPVC, precast, modular, prefabricated, or DfMA\-based building systems, including early\-stage design planning, coordination with specialist vendors, production constraints, transportation, erection sequence, and interface resolution.
* Good understanding of statutory approval processes, building codes, planning norms, construction detailing, project specifications, and quality standards.
**Technical Skills**
--------------------


* Strong knowledge of architectural design development, master planning, spatial planning, façade design, façade systems, building envelope coordination, material selection, performance requirements, and construction detailing.
* Ability to review and coordinate architectural drawings, BIM models, technical specifications, design reports, and consultant deliverables.
* Working knowledge of BIM workflows, Revit, AutoCAD, Navisworks, BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud, common data environments, digital review platforms, design coordination dashboards, SketchUp, Rhino, or equivalent design and coordination platforms.
* Good understanding of high\-rise building planning, core design, vertical transportation, podium planning, basement planning, public interface, security zoning, and service integration.
* Understanding of PPVC, precast, modular construction, DfMA principles, prefabrication detailing, module coordination, tolerance requirements, lifting provisions, joint detailing, and coordination with manufacturing and site execution teams.
* Knowledge of sustainable design, passive design strategies, green building requirements, universal accessibility, and fire and life safety coordination.
**Leadership and Core Competencies**
------------------------------------


* Strong design leadership with the ability to guide teams and drive results across complex projects.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, resolve design conflicts, and take timely decisions under project pressure.
* Strong coordination mindset with experience working across internal teams, clients, consultants, contractors, and execution teams.
* Outcome\-oriented approach with focus on quality, timelines, cost optimization, value engineering, and client satisfaction.
* Ability to mentor architects, build team capability, review design output, and establish design standards and workflows.
* Ability to lead digital transformation, promote BIM adoption, improve design productivity, and guide teams in PPVC, precast, modular, and industrialised construction coordination workflows.
* Strategic thinking with ability to contribute to business development, technical proposals, and design\-led project wins.
**Expected Deliverables**
-------------------------


* Architectural concepts, master plans, design reports, design narratives, presentations, and technical proposal inputs.
* Coordinated architectural drawings, BIM models, schedules, specifications, and design documentation across project stages.
* Coordinated façade design inputs, façade consultant comments, system interface details, material boards, mock\-up review inputs, and building envelope coordination outputs.
* Digital coordination outputs, BIM review trackers, design dashboards, model\-based issue logs, common data environment updates, and standardized digital workflow documents.
* PPVC, precast, and modular construction coordination outputs including module planning inputs, interface details, tolerance coordination notes, vendor coordination comments, and buildability review inputs.
* Design review comments, coordination trackers, RFI responses, stakeholder meeting inputs, and closure of design issues.
* Approved client presentation material, consultant coordination outputs, and milestone\-based design submissions.
* Integrated, buildable, compliant, cost\-effective, and high\-quality architectural design solutions aligned with project goals.

**Job Summary**
 Cloud architect role responsible for designing and optimizing secure scalable and resilient solutions on AWS using services such as container orchestration managed caching messaging and API management while ensuring strong governance and cost efficiency for enterprise clients in a hybrid work model with a focus on operational excellence and compliance alignment
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design robust cloud reference architectures that leverage container orchestration managed caching distributed messaging and secure API exposure to deliver reliable and scalable business platforms that align with enterprise standards and long term technology strategy
* Implement and optimize container based workloads using managed orchestration and serverless container services to ensure consistent application deployment high availability and efficient resource utilization across multiple environments
* Configure and manage managed caching services to reduce application latency optimize data retrieval patterns and improve overall system responsiveness while maintaining cost effectiveness and operational stability
* Architect and integrate asynchronous messaging patterns using managed message queuing services to decouple application components increase fault tolerance and support high throughput transaction processing in complex distributed systems
* Design and govern API management solutions that provide secure controlled and observable access to backend services while enforcing usage policies request throttling and analytics to support partner and internal integration ecosystems
* Utilize advisory tooling to continuously assess cost security performance and service limits providing actionable recommendations that improve reliability reduce operational risk and maintain budget alignment for cloud workloads
* Configure and maintain configuration management services to track resource changes enforce configuration policies and support compliance reporting across multiple accounts and environments for regulated and enterprise clients
* Design network topologies using virtual private networking connectivity options and routing configurations that provide secure segmentation high availability connectivity and optimized traffic flows between cloud and on premises environments
* Implement and tune web application protection capabilities including rule sets access controls and traffic inspection to defend applications against common threats while balancing security posture with application performance and usability
* Manage and optimize multi account governance structures using organization management capabilities that support centralized policy enforcement consolidated billing and controlled account provisioning for large scale cloud adoption
* Develop and maintain command line driven automation workflows that streamline environment provisioning configuration management and operational tasks to reduce manual effort and improve consistency across deployment pipelines
* Collaborate with cross functional teams including developers security specialists and operations professionals to translate solution requirements into feasible cloud designs while promoting best practices and shared ownership of outcomes
* Provide guidance and knowledge sharing to stakeholders on cloud architecture decision tradeoffs resilience patterns cost optimization techniques and migration strategies to support informed decision making and sustainable cloud growth
* Drive continuous improvement in observability incident response readiness and operational resilience by defining metrics dashboards and runbooks that align with business service level objectives and customer experience priorities


**Qualifications**
* Possess eight to eleven years of professional experience in designing and implementing cloud or distributed systems solutions with a strong focus on enterprise scale adoption and operational excellence
* Demonstrate advanced hands on expertise with managed container orchestration services including configuring clusters deploying workloads managing updates and optimizing resource usage for production environments
* Show proven experience configuring and tuning managed caching services message queuing platforms and API management solutions to support high performance low latency and loosely coupled application architectures
* Exhibit strong proficiency with security and governance services including web application protection advisory tools configuration management and organization level policies with a focus on compliance and risk mitigation
* Display solid knowledge of cloud networking concepts such as subnets routing connectivity options and traffic security controls combined with experience integrating cloud networks with on premises infrastructure
* Apply practical skills with command line interfaces infrastructure scripting and automation tools to enable repeatable deployments efficient troubleshooting and consistent environment management across teams
* Communicate complex cloud architecture concepts and tradeoffs clearly to technical and non technical stakeholders while working effectively in a hybrid work model and collaborating across global or distributed teams


**Certifications Required**
 AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional or equivalent cloud architect certification

Job Description
**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI\-led, platform\-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry\-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654\.4M FY26 revenue with 17\.4% Y\-o\-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436\.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3\.2% Q\-o\-Q and 16\.2% Y\-o\-Y growth. Our 27,500\+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries.

 **About Position:**

  

We are looking for an experienced Program Manager with 8 to 12 years of expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) architecture, cloud transformation, and enterprise program delivery. The ideal candidate will possess a strong blend of technical architecture knowledge, cloud strategy experience, stakeholder management capabilities, and program execution expertise. This role requires leading large\-scale cloud initiatives while ensuring successful delivery, governance, operational excellence, and alignment with business objectives.

* **Role: Program Manager**
* **Location: Pune**
* **Experience: Between 8 to 12 Years**
* **Job Type: Full Time Employment**

 **What You'll Do:**

  

* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of enterprise cloud programs focused on GCP architecture and modernization initiatives.
* Collaborate with cloud architects and engineering teams to define scalable, secure, and business\-aligned cloud solutions.
* Translate business and technical requirements into actionable program plans and delivery roadmaps.
* Drive cloud migration, transformation, and optimization initiatives across enterprise environments.
* Manage project schedules, milestones, dependencies, risks, and resource planning activities.
* Collaborate with architects, product owners, QA teams, DevOps engineers, security teams, and business stakeholders throughout delivery.
* Facilitate architecture reviews, technical governance discussions, and program status reviews.
* Monitor project progress and proactively address risks, issues, and dependencies.
* Ensure adherence to cloud architecture standards, security policies, and compliance requirements.
* Support production readiness, deployment planning, and operational transition activities.
* Drive Agile delivery practices including sprint planning, release management, and stakeholder communication.
* Establish governance frameworks, reporting mechanisms, and performance metrics for cloud programs.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams to ensure timely and successful project execution.
* Contribute to process improvements, automation initiatives, and operational excellence programs.
* Maintain project documentation, program dashboards, risk registers, and executive reports.
* Mentor teams and promote best practices across cloud delivery and program management functions.

 **Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 8 to 12 years of experience in Program Management, Cloud Transformation, or Enterprise Technology Delivery.
* Strong understanding of GCP architecture, cloud services, and enterprise cloud adoption strategies.
* Experience managing large\-scale cloud migration and modernization programs.
* Knowledge of GCP services including Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Run, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, IAM, and networking services.
* Strong understanding of cloud architecture principles, scalability, security, reliability, and performance optimization.
* Experience working closely with cloud architects, platform engineers, and DevOps teams.
* Proven track record of managing enterprise\-scale projects involving multiple stakeholders and cross\-functional teams.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, and modern delivery methodologies.
* Strong risk management, dependency management, and program governance skills.
* Experience supporting cloud security, compliance, and governance initiatives.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, cloud automation, Infrastructure as Code, and DevOps practices.
* Strong analytical, decision\-making, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.
* Experience preparing executive\-level reports, dashboards, and program status updates.
* Ability to balance business priorities with technical requirements and delivery constraints.
* Strong leadership, ownership, and collaboration skills.

 **Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company\-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check\-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

e07b4495.title: Platform Architect
e07b4495.description:
**Role Overview**


We are looking for an experienced **Platform Architect** to define and drive the architecture of a modern, cloud\-native platform supporting scalable, secure, and resilient applications.


The role requires strong expertise in **containerization, microservices, Kubernetes, cloud platforms, Redis, multi\-tenant architecture, and cross\-region deployment**. Microsoft Azure experience is preferred.


The Platform Architect will work closely with engineering, DevOps/SRE, security, and product teams to establish platform standards, reference architectures, and reusable technical patterns.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Define the overall architecture and technical direction for the platform.
* Design scalable and resilient **microservices\-based architectures**.
* Establish standards for containerized workloads and Kubernetes deployments.
* Define cloud architecture using Azure services and cloud\-native design principles.
* Design secure and scalable **multi\-tenant architectures**, including tenant isolation and resource segregation.
* Define **multi\-region deployment**, failover, disaster recovery, and resilience strategies.
* Design caching and distributed state\-management solutions using **Redis**.
* Establish standards for service communication, API design, asynchronous messaging, retries, resiliency, and fault handling.
* Define platform security patterns including identity, access control, secrets management, and workload isolation.
* Define observability standards for logs, metrics, traces, alerts, and service health.
* Guide Infrastructure\-as\-Code, CI/CD, and automated platform deployment practices.
* Conduct architecture and design reviews and drive resolution of architectural risks and technical debt.
* Create and maintain reference architectures, design documentation, and architecture decisions.
* Mentor engineering teams on cloud\-native and distributed\-system design practices.


**Core Technical Skills**

**Must Have**

**Containerization**

* Strong experience with Docker/OCI containers.
* Understanding of container lifecycle, security, networking, and image optimization.

**Kubernetes**

* Strong hands\-on architectural knowledge of Kubernetes.
* Experience with:
* + Deployments, StatefulSets, Services, and Ingress
	+ ConfigMaps and Secrets
	+ Autoscaling and resource management
	+ Persistent storage
	+ RBAC and network policies
	+ Cluster and workload high availability
* Experience with **Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)** preferred.

**Microservices \& Distributed Systems**

* Strong understanding of:
* + REST APIs and service\-to\-service communication
	+ Event\-driven and asynchronous architectures
	+ API gateways
	+ Service decomposition
	+ Resiliency patterns
	+ Distributed transactions
	+ Eventual consistency
	+ Idempotency
	+ Fault tolerance and graceful degradation

**Cloud Architecture**

* Strong cloud architecture experience, preferably with **Microsoft Azure**.
* Familiarity with relevant Azure services such as:
* + AKS
	+ Azure Container Registry
	+ Azure Front Door / Application Gateway
	+ Virtual Networks and Private Link
	+ Microsoft Entra ID
	+ Managed Identities
	+ Key Vault
	+ Azure Monitor / Application Insights
	+ Azure Storage
	+ Azure SQL or equivalent databases
	+ Azure Service Bus / Event Hubs
	+ Azure Managed Redis

**Redis**

* Experience designing Redis for:
* + Distributed caching
	+ Session or transient state
	+ High availability
	+ Replication and clustering
	+ Cache invalidation
	+ Performance optimization

**Multi\-Tenant Architecture**

* Experience designing SaaS or shared platforms with:
* + Tenant isolation
	+ Identity and authorization boundaries
	+ Data and resource segregation
	+ Tenant provisioning
	+ Noisy\-neighbor mitigation
	+ Tenant\-level monitoring and configuration

**Multi\-Region Architecture**

* Experience designing:
* + Regional deployment patterns
	+ Active\-active and active\-passive architectures
	+ Traffic routing
	+ Disaster recovery
	+ Regional failover
	+ Data replication
	+ RTO/RPO strategies

**Preferred Skills**


Experience in one or more of the following areas is desirable:

* Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or Bicep
* Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
* Helm and GitOps
* Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or Event Hubs
* OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana
* API Management and service mesh
* SQL and NoSQL databases
* Zero\-trust and cloud security
* SRE and reliability engineering practices


**Experience**

* Typically **10\+ years of software or platform engineering experience**.
* At least **4–6 years of experience in cloud\-native and distributed\-system architecture**.
* Proven experience architecting production platforms using Kubernetes and microservices.
* Experience designing highly available, scalable, and resilient systems.


**Key Architecture Competencies**


The candidate should be able to evaluate architectural trade\-offs such as:

* Shared vs dedicated tenant infrastructure
* Shared Kubernetes clusters vs tenant\-specific clusters
* Database\-per\-tenant vs shared database models
* Stateless vs stateful services
* Synchronous APIs vs asynchronous messaging
* Active\-active vs active\-passive regional deployments
* Managed cloud services vs self\-managed components
* Security and isolation vs infrastructure cost

 **About Us:**



Atlas Systems Inc. is a Software Solutions company headquartered in East Brunswick, NJ. Incorporated in 2003, Atlas provides solutions across GRC, Technology, Procurement, Healthcare Provider and Oracle to customers globally.

https://atlas.bamboohr.com/careers/621

  

Job Title: SharePoint Architect – Financial Services



Location: Bangalore



Work Timing: US Business Hours



Experience: 10\+ Years Overall \| 6\+ Years SharePoint / Microsoft 365



Engagement Type: Long\-term Contract or Full\-Time

 **Position Summary**



We are seeking a senior SharePoint Architect to lead enterprise\-scale SharePoint and Microsoft 365 initiatives in a BFSI environment. The role owns platform strategy, future\-state architecture, modernization, governance, business analysis, and delivery across SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, Power Platform, RPA, and AI\-enabled collaboration solutions. The architect will advise senior stakeholders and lead onshore/offshore teams supporting investment, operations, and portfolio functions.



The ideal candidate combines deep SharePoint/M365 architecture expertise with an AI\-first mindset, including practical exposure to LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Bots, Claude AI / Claude Code, multi\-skill/multi\-agent models, MCP, and Microsoft Power Platform AI capabilities.

 **Key Responsibilities**


**SharePoint / Microsoft 365 Architecture \& Modernization**



Own the SharePoint / Microsoft 365 platform roadmap and define scalable future\-state architecture across SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, and Power Platform.



Lead enterprise modernization and migration from legacy SharePoint environments to SharePoint Online, establishing architecture standards, governance, security, information architecture, and platform best practices.



Partner with business and IT leaders using deep business analysis skills to understand new problem statements, map current/future processes, identify automation opportunities, and translate requirements into scalable solutions; guide and mentor distributed onshore/offshore delivery teams.

 **AI\-First \& Agentic Microsoft 365 Solutions**



Drive an AI\-first development approach by embedding LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, conversational Bots, intelligent search, and AI\-assisted workflows directly into SharePoint, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and enterprise solutions.



Leverage Claude AI / Claude Code and similar LLM platforms for multi\-skill/multi\-agent approaches across requirements, architecture, development, testing, documentation, modernization, and support. Apply Model Context Protocol (MCP) to securely connect AI models/agents with SharePoint, Microsoft 365, APIs, enterprise data, applications, and development tools for end\-to\-end software solution development.



Apply enterprise security, data protection, grounding, guardrails, observability, human oversight, and Responsible AI practices for AI\-enabled solutions, particularly within regulated financial\-services environments.

 **Business Analysis, Power Platform, RPA \& Intelligent Automation**



Architect new end\-to\-end business flows and RPAs using Power Apps and Power Automate, from problem discovery and process analysis through solution design, automation, integration, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement.



Provide hands\-on architectural exposure to AI Hub in Power Automate, including AI prompts, AI models / AI Builder, and document intelligence capabilities for document extraction, classification, processing, workflow automation, and AI\-enabled business scenarios.



Identify opportunities to combine Power Automate, AI Builder/Document Intelligence, LLMs, agents, and enterprise data to modernize manual and legacy workflows. Assess and migrate existing RPAs/workflows built using competitive tools such as Alteryx, Automation Anywhere, and UiPath into Power Automate while preserving business controls, reliability, auditability, and operational continuity.

 **Governance, Security \& Leadership**



Establish platform governance, security, lifecycle management, development standards, reusable patterns, and adoption practices across SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Power Platform, and AI\-enabled solutions.



Stay current with the Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Copilot/AI, and broader AI technology roadmaps; evaluate emerging capabilities and advise leadership on adoption, architecture, risk, and business value.



Provide architecture reviews, technical direction, mentoring, stakeholder communication, and delivery governance in fast\-paced, high\-visibility enterprise programs.

 **Required Qualifications**



Bachelor's/master's degree in computer science, Engineering, IT, or related discipline with 10\+ years overall experience and 6\+ years of strong SharePoint / Microsoft 365 experience.



Strong hands\-on expertise in SharePoint Online, Microsoft 365, Teams, OneDrive, Power Apps, and Power Automate, with proven experience leading enterprise SharePoint programs, modernization initiatives, platform roadmaps, future\-state architecture, and automation/RPA delivery.

  

Practical exposure to AI\-first application development using LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Bots, Claude AI / Claude Code, multi\-skill/multi\-agent models, and MCP\-based enterprise integration.



Exposure to Power Automate AI Hub capabilities including AI prompts, AI models / AI Builder, and document intelligence; ability to identify and architect practical AI\-enabled automation scenarios.



Deep business analysis and process\-engineering capability to understand ambiguous/new problem statements, conduct discovery, map processes, define requirements, and design brand\-new flows/RPAs. Experience assessing and migrating automations from Alteryx, Automation Anywhere, UiPath, or similar platforms to Power Automate. Strong governance, security, stakeholder management, communication, and distributed/offshore leadership skills; BFSI or regulated\-industry experience strongly preferred.

 **Technical Skills**



SharePoint Online, M365, Teams, OneDrive \| Power Apps/Automate, AI Hub, AI Prompts, AI Builder, Document Intelligence \| Business Analysis, Process Mapping, RPA Design \& Migration (Alteryx/Automation Anywhere/UiPath to Power Automate) \| LLMs, RAG, Agents, Bots, Claude AI/Claude Code, MCP, Multi\-Agent/Multi\-Skill Orchestration \| Architecture, Governance, Security, Integration.

 **Core Competencies**



SharePoint/M365 Architecture • Business Analysis \& Process Discovery • New Flow/RPA Design • RPA Migration to Power Automate • AI\-First/Agentic Solutions • Claude AI \& MCP • Power Platform/AI Hub • Governance \& Security • BFSI • Stakeholder \& Distributed\-Team Leadership.

* Lead Oracle and AI readiness assessments to build a phased modernization roadmap covering applications, data, integration, cloud platform, security, governance and change adoption.

* Lead multi\-disciplinary teams across Testing, Legacy Integrations, Cloud Enablement and Change Management as solution lead for RFPs, bringing Oracle AI capabilities and Cognizant accelerators to customer opportunities.

 Work model
   

  

 At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role's business requirements, this is an onsite position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Pan India.
   

  

 The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
   

  

 What you must have to be considered
   

  

* Experience leading mid to large\-size Oracle programs as a Solution Architect in transformation programs, with a deep understanding of the customer journey to Oracle and the various options available.
* Experience in pre\-sales activities, including leading RFP/RFI responses as Solution Lead, and managing multiple streams within a program such as functional, integration, data migration and change management.
* Breadth of understanding of the overall Oracle landscape, interdependencies between modules and cross\-functional integration, with strong awareness of the Oracle product roadmap and market trends across Fusion Cloud Applications, OCI, data platforms, generative AI and agentic AI.
* Hands\-on understanding of Oracle Fusion Cloud embedded AI capabilities and Oracle AI Agent Studio, including agent design, orchestration, tools, security and lifecycle management.
* Working knowledge of OCI AI services and enterprise AI architecture patterns, including generative AI, retrieval\-augmented generation, vector databases, APIs and integration services.


 These will help you succeed

* Experience defining responsible AI, security, privacy, compliance, observability and human\-in\-the\-loop controls for enterprise solutions.
* Ability to create and present AI\-enabled solution demonstrations, reference architectures and executive\-level value propositions for business and technology stakeholders.
* Strong industry domain and process leadership skills, building trust in customer conversations.

Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

---------------

  

We are seeking an experienced Sr. Program Manager to lead and scale our Alternate Delivery Models portfolio as part of our Delivery Service Partner (DSP) program in India. This is a high\-impact role at the forefront of our India expansion, responsible for end\-to\-end program management across innovative delivery channels including drone delivery, electric vehicle fleets, and micro\-mobility solutions.  

The ideal candidate brings 5–7 years of program management experience, a strong operational mindset, and a passion for building scalable, cost\-effective last\-mile delivery solutions from the ground up.

The Alternate Delivery Models team operates under the DSP program and is chartered with reimagining last\-mile delivery across India. As we expand into new markets in India, this team plays a critical role in launching, stabilizing, and scaling emerging delivery solutions that complement our traditional delivery network. You will work cross\-functionally with operations, technology, finance, fleet management, and external partners to drive innovation and operational excellence.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

  

* Own end\-to\-end program management for alternate delivery models including Drone Delivery, Electric Fleet (L3 EVs, L5 EVs), Saddle Bags, Walker/Biker on EV, and Amazon Lockers.
* Lead the launch of new alternate delivery programs across India expansion markets, from concept through pilot to full\-scale deployment.
* Develop and execute stabilization plans post\-launch to ensure consistent service quality, delivery reliability, and operational efficiency.
* Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for each delivery model, including delivery speed, cost per delivery, capacity utilization, and customer satisfaction.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders including Operations, Finance, Technology, Safety, and Sustainability teams to align on program goals and execution plans.
* Conduct market analysis and benchmarking to identify opportunities for new delivery models and geographic expansion.
* Manage relationships with external partners, vendors, and regulatory bodies relevant to drone operations, EV fleet management, and locker deployments.
* Create and present business reviews, program updates, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
* Work with Operations leadership to integrate alternate delivery models into existing fulfillment and last\-mile networks, ensuring seamless handoffs.
* Lead vendor development initiatives including vendor identification, capability assessment, performance benchmarking, and continuous improvement programs to build a robust and cost\-effective supply base.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 5\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
