a7fbdd93.title: Director, Technical Consulting— Marketing Cloud Next
a7fbdd93.description:
**Description**
****ROLE OVERVIEW****
 Salesforce is currently seeking a Director,Technical Consulting (Marketing Cloud Next) to join our Global Delivery Centre (GDC) team. We are looking for an experienced professional services leader who has experience in scaling professional services delivery centers across the world. In addition The Director — Marketing Cloud Next is an execution\-focused technical leader responsible for architecting and delivering end\-to\-end migrations from legacy marketing platforms (Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, legacy SFMC) to Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next. As a foundational member of the Strategic Migration CoE and Migration Factory, you will act as primary technical authority for the Marketing Cloud Next track — owning the solution design, data architecture, subscriber migration strategy, journey migration blueprint, and Data Cloud unified profile design. You will combine deep Marketing Cloud Next platform expertise with advanced data migration methodologies to ensure that subscriber data, consent records, journeys, content and preference data are migrated with full integrity, compliance and zero business disruption.
   

  

 This role is 50% billable and in addition to people leadership, you will work with our customers and partners as a senior technical architect/program architect/CTO to solve critically important business challenges using Salesforce’s Cloud.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead a team of up to 8 direct reports, comprising Architects and potentially Managers, providing technical direction, mentorship, and performance leadership.
* Serve as a Senior/Principal Technical Architect for Marketing Cloud migration projects, contributing hands\-on technical expertise and architectural leadership at approximately 50% utilization.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the client, guiding customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies and Enterprise AI Architecture that drive increased business value.
* Identify and lead internal critical initiatives to grow the Industries Architects’ consulting practice; serving as an active contributor to the community’s overall knowledge base and expertise, specifically driving the evolution of an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology within the practice.
* Design the subscriber and audience data migration strategy, including data extension schema, subscriber key mapping, suppression list migration, consent record preservation (GDPR/CAN\-SPAM/CASL) and historical send data handling.
* Architect the Salesforce Data Cloud implementation for unified customer profile design, identity resolution rules, data stream ingestion from source systems, and audience segmentation activation to Marketing Cloud Next.
* Own the journey migration blueprint — mapping legacy automation workflows, drip campaigns and triggered sends from source platforms to Marketing Cloud Next Journey Builder, including decision splits, wait steps and exit criteria.
* Define end\-to\-end data lineage including data profiling, cleansing logic, transformation mapping and reconciliation strategies for all subscriber objects, data extensions and consent tables.
* Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.
* Lead a project team of developers focused on driving optimized solutions for our clients leveraging Salesforce clouds.
* Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third\-party stakeholders
* Establish trust with the customer’s leadership, promoting and/or implementing best practices with Salesforce
* Highlight and manage risk areas in the solution in a proactive manner, and commit to seeing an issue through to completion


**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**
* Marketing Cloud Next Platform Depth: Advanced expertise in Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Mobile Studio, Advertising Studio and Contact Builder / Audience Builder.
* Data Cloud / CDP: Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Data Cloud — data stream configuration, identity resolution, unified profile modelling, segmentation and activation to MC Next.
* Subscriber Data Architecture: Deep understanding of subscriber data model, data extensions, sendable vs non\-sendable objects, contact counts, suppression logic and list management at scale.
* Consent \& Compliance Architecture: Expert knowledge of GDPR, CAN\-SPAM, CASL, POPI — consent record migration, preference centre design, suppression list management and compliance\-aligned data handling.
* Email Deliverability: Strong understanding of sender reputation, IP warm\-up strategy, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and deliverability validation post\-migration.
* Data Migration Methodology: Proven expertise in executing high\-volume subscriber migrations — data profiling, ETL pipeline design, transformation mapping and reconciliation for marketing data objects.
* Integration Architecture: Understanding of Marketing Cloud Connect (CRM sync), REST/SOAP Marketing Cloud APIs, API\-triggered sends and event\-driven messaging patterns.
* AMPscript / SSJS: Proficiency in dynamic content scripting for migrated email templates — ensuring legacy personalisation logic is recreated accurately in MC Next.


**Minimum Requirements**
* 18\+ years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects and handling individual contributors.
* 8\+ years of people management experience
* Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills
* Demonstrated experience migrating high\-volume subscriber databases (10M\+ records) with zero consent data loss
* Experience migrating from Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot or legacy SFMC Classic to Marketing Cloud Next
* Hands\-on experience with ETL tools — Informatica Cloud, Talend, MuleSoft, Azure Data Factory — for large\-scale subscriber data extraction and transformation
* Strong interpersonal skills \- nurture effective working relationships with others
* Proficiency in English. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience


**Preferred Skills — Good To Have**
* CTA
* Experience migrating from Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot or legacy SFMC Classic to Marketing Cloud Next
* Hands\-on experience with ETL tools — Informatica Cloud, Talend, MuleSoft, Azure Data Factory — for large\-scale subscriber data extraction and transformation
* Knowledge of Salesforce Interaction Studio / Personalisation for 1\-to\-1 journey personalisation post\-migration
* Experience with WhatsApp, LINE, Push and SMS channel migration in addition to email
* Familiarity with marketing data warehouse patterns (Snowflake, Databricks) as upstream Data Cloud data sources
* Understanding of Salesforce Loyalty Cloud or Commerce Cloud as upstream journey trigger sources
* Thorough individual with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies, including hands\-on delivery patterns for generative AI and agentic frameworks.
* A great listener with the ability to communicate with people in diverse roles
* Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration
* Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems
* Adept at navigating/mediating conflict and fostering healthy dialogue
* Exceptional analytical skills \- experience overseeing and managing business metrics, productivity, AI evaluation frameworks, and outcomes.

6377edb2.title: Delivery Manager I
6377edb2.description:
**Role Description**
 We are seeking an experienced and results\-driven
 **Transformation Delivery Manager** 
 to lead strategic technology transformation initiatives and manage the successful delivery of large\-scale fixed bid programs for a specific customer, account, or industry vertical.
   

  

 This role serves as the single point of accountability for delivery excellence, commercial performance, customer satisfaction, and business outcomes across a portfolio of transformation initiatives. The Transformation Delivery Manager will be responsible for driving complex digital transformation programs from strategy through execution while ensuring predictable delivery, contractual compliance, margin achievement, and customer success.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in program delivery, fixed bid project management, transformation leadership, customer engagement, financial governance, and operational excellence. This role requires extensive experience managing multi\-million\-dollar fixed bid engagements, distributed global teams, and large\-scale product/platform implementations.
   

  

 The Transformation Delivery Manager will work closely with customer executives, business stakeholders, architects, engineering leaders, product teams, project managers, and delivery organizations to ensure transformation objectives are achieved within agreed scope, schedule, quality, and financial commitments.
   

  

**Preferred Domain Expertise**
* Telecom Operations / AIOps / Network Operations
* Healthcare \& HealthTech Platforms
* Banking, Financial Services \& Insurance (BFSI)


**Key Responsibilities**
**Transformation \& Delivery Leadership**
* Own end\-to\-end delivery accountability for transformation programs, product implementations, platform modernization initiatives, and large\-scale fixed bid engagements.
* Lead strategic transformation roadmaps focused on digital modernization, cloud adoption, AI\-enabled operations, automation, process transformation, and platform engineering.
* Translate customer business objectives into executable delivery plans, measurable outcomes, and transformation milestones.
* Ensure successful realization of transformation goals while maintaining delivery predictability and customer confidence.
* Act as the primary delivery executive responsible for program success, customer satisfaction, and business outcomes.


**Large\-Scale Fixed Bid Program Delivery**
* Lead delivery of complex fixed bid projects and programs with full accountability for scope, schedule, quality, cost, and contractual commitments.
* Establish robust delivery governance frameworks to ensure projects are delivered within approved budgets and timelines.
* Manage multi\-workstream programs involving cross\-functional teams, third\-party vendors, and geographically distributed delivery organizations.
* Drive proactive scope management and prevent scope creep through disciplined change control processes.
* Ensure contractual obligations, service commitments, milestones, and acceptance criteria are achieved.
* Identify delivery risks early and implement mitigation plans to protect schedule, quality, and financial targets.
* Manage customer expectations while balancing delivery commitments and commercial objectives.
* Drive successful execution of product implementation, migration, modernization, and transformation programs.


**Financial \& Commercial Management**
* Own P\&L responsibility for assigned programs and portfolios.
* Ensure achievement of revenue, margin, utilization, profitability, and cost management targets.
* Monitor project financial health through forecasting, budget tracking, earned value analysis, and variance management.
* Lead estimation reviews, solution validation, effort planning, and pricing governance for fixed bid engagements.
* Drive financial discipline through effective resource utilization, productivity improvements, and operational efficiencies.
* Manage contractual changes, commercial negotiations, and scope governance to protect project profitability.
* Provide accurate forecasting and financial reporting to leadership and customer stakeholders.


**Customer Engagement \& Executive Stakeholder Management**
* Serve as the trusted delivery advisor and strategic partner to customer leadership teams.
* Build strong executive relationships across business, technology, operations, and transformation functions.
* Lead executive governance meetings, steering committees, operational reviews, and transformation status reviews.
* Communicate program health, risks, dependencies, financial performance, and business outcomes effectively.
* Proactively manage escalations and drive timely resolution of critical customer issues.
* Identify opportunities for account expansion, additional transformation initiatives, and value creation.
* Ensure customer expectations are aligned with contractual commitments and delivery realities.


**Delivery Governance \& Operational Excellence**

c457a8db.title: Program Manager - Operations, Andhra Pradesh
c457a8db.description:
**About Mitti Labs**

Mitti Labs is a climate\-tech startup dedicated to transforming the rice industry by supporting smallholder farmers in adopting sustainable practices. Our mission is to bring AI and satellite technology into traditional rice farming, reducing methane emissions while improving farmer livelihoods.


Backed by NASA\-supported science and a strong ecosystem of partners, we work with global corporations to help them achieve their net\-zero goals through verified, high\-quality carbon credits. Our initiatives include building the world's most advanced dMRV for rice, launching a 40,000 farmers project in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh and reducing air pollution from stubble burning in Punjab. We have built partnerships with the likes of Syngenta Foundation, Dr Reddy's Foundation, The Nature Conservancy and Ebro Foods.


Our customers \- including Fortune 500 companies and leading agri\-businesses \- trust Mitti Labs to deliver measurable impact across climate, food systems, and sustainability. We are a team of 40\+ data scientists, agronomists, engineers, and operators.

**Role Description**  

  

Mitti Labs is currently working with 10,000 farmers across different regions in AP. We need a strong state lead or project lead to manage the execution of carbon process\-related and input sales related tasks in our project regions across the State.


Through our implementation partner, we will have a field force of around 100\. You will be responsible in ensuring partners meet their targets and execution happens seamlessly.


Some of your objectives will include:


* Ensuring partners are meeting their tasks as per a pre\-defined roadmap
* Continually streamlining systems and processes to ensure execution
* Continually training, re\-training, and supporting the field agent force
* Holding field agents and partners accountable, and helping them problem solve and find solutions?


We are seeking a driven task master, who has the ability to rally internal and external teams and the strong interpersonal and communication skills needed to meet these objectives.  

  



**Key Responsibilities**  

  

1\. External Partner Operations Management

* Maintain strong relationship with implementation partners teams, at managerial and execution level
* Strategise solutions with implementation partners basis problems
* Continually build and update SOPs and systems to ensure performance
* Collaborate with local stakeholders involved in the program, including agri universities, government bodies, NGOs, KVKs, Agriculture Departments etc.
* Daily standups with Ops Execution team, QA/QC team, and implementation partner’s teams (at managerial and operational levels)
* Ability to create network of logistics providers and local resources to support tasks


2\. Internal Communications

* Work with internal teams on carbon processes compliance, product, R\&D to ensure smooth implementation and communication of improvements
* Work on smooth execution of inputs distribution business in collaboration with inputs business head, and with support from inputs logistics team
* Daily/weekly analytics on performance on carbon processes, input distribution, and offer insights to Ops Execution, Product and leadership
* Offer support on Science Ops, R\&D ops, agronomic demos, etc.


3\. Operational Execution and Leadership

* Take initiative as a leader of the program, manage state level teams, project coordinators and field agents to ensure on\-ground execution
* Building and maintaining granular task sheets and roadmaps, to ensure timeline and execution of projects are meeting requirements
* Drive farmer engagement programs through trainings, awareness campaigns and demonstration plots
* Oversee procurement, logistics and distribution of climate smart agri inputs to ensure availability and accessibility
* Ensure field agents are trained, and operating as per SOP, make quick corrections when deviations are observed
* Maintaining, updating and improving document repository of SOPs, Training Manuals, Processes
* Build marketing material in coordination with on\-ground teams to represent progress/success/wins basis data collected from fields
* Create input market material for field agents, how to pitch to farmer, how to sell product, with SOPs \+ Video walkthroughs

  

**Requirements**  

Your skills, mindset and demeanor should align with the following requirements:

* Passionate about climate, agriculture, sustainability, scientific innovation and impact
* Strong and independent task master, ability to design and execute on roadmaps
* Experience in Agri Project Management
* Strong communication skills and composure when dealing with large scale projects and large teams
* Process excellence mindset
* People management. High cultural sensitivity and ability to motivate rural teams.
* Ability to pre\-empt issues and offer solutions to fire\-fight
* Willingness to travel to fields on daily basis
* Ability to understand and engage with agrarian communities, understanding of farmers, FPOs, NGOs, Government Departments, etc...

**Experience:**

* Strong professional experience (7\+ years) \- ideally in agri\-project management, field extension management, input distribution/sales
* Category experience in Paddy farming is strongly preferred
* Proven experience in optimizing processes and building systems and strategies to support scale
* Strong educational background, preferably in Agribusiness management, Field Extension management, operations / supply chain strategy type roles
* Experience managing large field teams (100–300 people) through partner organizations or direct teams.
* Demonstrated capability in building high\-performance cultures, coaching mid\-level managers, and creating accountability systems.
* Strong ability to create MIS, and monitor KPIs at scale.
* Hands\-on experience using project management tools (Notion, Google Workspace, Excel, Looker Studio, etc.).
* Experience in multi\-district or multi\-state program rollouts.
* Prior experience implementing QA/QC frameworks, audits, field validation checks, and adherence to SOP.
* Experience in generating detailed stakeholder\-specific reports and documentation to synthesize findings and learnings to diverse stakeholders.
* Experience ensuring compliance with carbon methodologies, government schemes, donor requirements, or agri certification programs.
* Native fluency in Telugu is a must

  

**Benefits**  

Purpose driven work \- tackling the worlds most pressing challenges \- climate change, food security, water security, farmer livelihoods improvement.  

  

Culture / Team / Environment \- our team includes the best minds in science, product, business and operations, in an environment where collaboration and openness is highly valued, unbiased, objective decision making, direct relationship with founders, and encouragement of career growth in a rapidly scaling organization.  

  

Exposure to multiple stakeholders \- internal and external, ability to operate at the center of the organization.  

  

**How to Apply**


Please apply through this Google Form link: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc7JBre\_oKXlgFlgErc66XFqcZfTkc8Gjo\_QWLDEesTCPpCWw/viewform

d45061a7.title: Customer Engagement Manager
d45061a7.description:
**About Ema**
 Ema is building the world’s leading Agentic AI platform to transform enterprise productivity. We enable organizations to delegate repetitive tasks to Ema, the Universal AI Employee, delivering 10x gains in workforce efficiency, across functions. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.
   

  

 We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production — we ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.
   

  

**The Role**
 The Customer Engagement Manager owns a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts end\-to\-end: every engagement, every outcome, every relationship, every expansion opportunity. Think of this as the McKinsey Associate Partner model applied to enterprise AI delivery.
   

  

 You are the single point of accountability for your accounts. The customer calls you — not your manager — when they have a problem. You staff delivery teams, oversee solution quality, run executive readouts, measure ROI, drive adoption, rebuild trust when things break, and grow the book through proven production value.
   

  

**This is not a project management role.** 
 This is an account ownership role that combines delivery orchestration, outcome ownership, customer leadership, and commercial growth.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
* Account Ownership
* Own your accounts end\-to\-end: every engagement, every outcome, every relationship. Everything good or bad stops with you.
* Be the single point of contact the customer calls for any problem — delivery, quality, adoption, escalation, or expansion.
* Maintain a holistic view of each account: engagement status, risk exposure, opportunity pipeline, and the customer’s strategic priorities for the quarter.
* Run account planning: engagement roadmaps, resource forecasting, risk assessment, and growth strategy.
* Delivery Orchestration
* Staff and direct delivery teams (Engineering Leads, Product Managers) across your accounts.
* Oversee delivery quality across all engagements: review solution architectures, attend go\-live rehearsals, ensure evaluation rigor.
* Manage cross\-engagement dependencies within an account (e.g., shared integration infrastructure between parallel deployments).
* Serve as the delivery escalation point: join war rooms, coordinate fixes across Engineering and Product, and communicate resolution to the customer.
* You don’t write code — but you review architectures, challenge unrealistic scope, and ensure go\-live readiness. Your leverage is orchestration and judgment.
* Outcome Ownership \& Continuous Improvement
* Own post\-go\-live outcomes: adoption, ROI, accuracy, and user trust. This role absorbs the Outcomes Manager function for your accounts.
* Run regular usage readouts: AI deflection rates, false positive/negative trends, HITL escalation patterns, user bypass rates, and trust signals.
* Separate product gaps from process, training, or expectation gaps. Not everything that looks broken is an engineering problem.
* Drive continuous improvement cycles: readout → diagnose → prioritize → fix → re\-measure.
* Communicate outcomes in business language: efficiency gains, cost savings, error reduction — not just dashboards, but diagnosis and action plans.
* Executive Stakeholder Leadership
* Run QBRs with VP/C\-level stakeholders: present outcomes, risks, improvement plans, and the strategic roadmap.
* Navigate internal customer politics: when the VP of IT and VP of Business disagree on priorities, facilitate alignment around shared success metrics.
* Communicate bad news credibly: present the data, the diagnosis, and the recovery plan — without losing trust.
* Handle C\-level escalations. When the CTO threatens to terminate or the CFO questions ROI, you are the person in the room.
* Commercial Growth
* Grow your book through outcome\-driven expansion: deliver the first SOW excellently, measure ROI rigorously, present evidence to the C\-suite, then propose the next SOW grounded in proven value.
* Identify new use cases by deeply understanding customer business processes and pain points — not by pushing a product catalog.
* Know when to push for expansion vs. when to stabilize. Premature expansion erodes trust. You earn the right to grow by delivering first.
* Co\-sell with Sales: provide the delivery credibility and outcome evidence that makes expansion proposals close.
* Product \& Platform Partnership
* Act as the voice of your customers to Product and Core Engineering. Translate field patterns into structured, actionable feedback — not one\-off requests.
* Identify cross\-customer patterns that signal platform gaps or opportunities.
* Partner with Product on customer\-facing roadmap discussions: what’s coming, what’s not, and how to manage expectations.
* Team Development
* Coach Engineering Leads and Implementation Managers on architecture quality, customer communication, delivery discipline, and outcome thinking.
* Promote shared standards and best practices across engagements.
* Build reusable account\-level assets: engagement playbooks, QBR templates, outcome tracking frameworks, and expansion qualification criteria.


**Qualifications**
**Required**
* 15\+ years in enterprise technology delivery, consulting, account management, or customer leadership.
* 5\+ years owning enterprise accounts end\-to\-end: delivery, outcomes, relationship, and growth — not individual projects within someone else’s account.
* Track record managing or directing delivery teams (Engineering Leads, TPMs, consultants) assigned to their accounts.
* Post\-go\-live outcome ownership: measured ROI, tracked adoption, driven continuous improvement, and rebuilt trust after production issues.
* Commercial accountability: grown account revenue through outcome\-driven expansion, not just retention.
* Enterprise stakeholder management at VP/C\-level across multiple concurrent accounts.
* Production track record — beyond POCs. Scale and accountability required.


**Preferred**
* Experience with AI, automation, or agentic workflow platforms in production.
* Background at a consulting firm (McKinsey, BCG, Deloitte) or enterprise SaaS PS org (ServiceNow, Salesforce, UiPath) in a delivery\-heavy account leadership role.
* Experience with partner\-mediated delivery (delivering through consulting partners to end clients).
* Familiarity with enterprise integrations (APIs, auth, CRM/HRIS/ITSM platforms) at a judgment level, not implementation level.
* Experience in a scaling startup ($5M–$50M ARR) where account management practices were being built, not inherited.


 Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.
   

  

 Ema Unlimited is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or genetics.

3e717989.title: Manager/Senior Manager, Technical Consulting — Revenue Cloud Advanced(RCA)
3e717989.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

**Role Overview**
*The Manager, Technical Consulting — Marketing Cloud Next leads a team of Technical Consultants and Sr Technical Consultants delivering enterprise\-scale migrations from legacy marketing platforms (Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, legacy SFMC) to Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next and Salesforce Data Cloud. This role sits within Salesforce Professional Services' Global Delivery Centre (GDC) and is a 50% billable position — equally accountable for hands\-on technical architecture delivery and people leadership of the Marketing Cloud Next migration track within the Migration Factory. As a trusted advisor to clients and a people\-first leader within the CoE, you will drive high\-quality, repeatable delivery across concurrent migration waves while growing a high\-performing team of marketing technology migration specialists*
**Responsibilities**
* People Leadership: Manage up to 15 direct reports (Sr Technical Consultants and Technical Consultants) across the Marketing Cloud Next migration track — responsible for hiring, onboarding, mentoring, performance management and career development.
* Technical Delivery (50% Billable): Act as the hands\-on Technical Architect for complex Marketing Cloud Next migration engagements — owning solution design, subscriber data architecture, journey migration blueprint, Data Cloud implementation design and cutover strategy.
* Migration Factory Contribution: Drive the Marketing Cloud Next track within the Migration Factory — ensuring wave delivery adheres to factory standards, playbooks and accelerators, and that all team members follow the MDLC phase discipline.
* Trusted Advisor: Serve as the senior technical point of contact for clients on Marketing Cloud Next migrations — building trusted relationships with client marketing operations leads, CDOs and Enterprise Architects.
* Workshop Leadership: Lead and facilitate functional and technical discovery workshops, solution design reviews and cutover planning sessions with client stakeholders and internal delivery teams.
* Solution Design Governance: Review and approve all Marketing Cloud Next solution design documents, data mapping artefacts and integration designs produced by the track team — ensuring compliance with factory standards and Salesforce best practices.
* Data Architecture Oversight: Oversee the subscriber data migration strategy — including data extension schema design, consent record migration (GDPR/CAN\-SPAM/CASL), suppression list architecture and Salesforce Data Cloud unified profile design.
* Journey Migration Leadership: Guide the team in translating legacy marketing automation workflows, drip campaigns and triggered sends to Marketing Cloud Next Journey Builder — ensuring business logic equivalence is preserved.
* Risk Management: Proactively identify and manage solution risks within the Marketing Cloud Next track — including subscriber key conflicts, deliverability degradation, consent compliance gaps and Data Cloud ingestion failures.
* Practice Development: Drive internal initiatives to grow the Marketing Cloud Next migration practice — developing reusable playbooks, config accelerators, subscriber migration toolkits and AMPscript/SSJS template libraries.
* Cross\-track Collaboration: Work closely with Lead Architects, Integration Architects and Data Migration Architects across concurrent waves to align Marketing Cloud Next delivery with the broader migration programme dependencies.
* Metrics \& Outcomes: Own and report on team utilisation, delivery velocity, defect density, client satisfaction (CSAT) and wave throughput metrics for the Marketing Cloud Next track.
* Hiring \& Talent: Actively participate in hiring, interviewing and onboarding Marketing Cloud Next technical consultants — building pipeline of talent aligned to the Migration Factory's growth roadmap.


**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**
* Marketing Cloud Next Platform: Advanced hands\-on expertise in Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Mobile Studio and Contact Builder — with proven ability to lead complex migration deliveries.
* Salesforce Data Cloud: Hands\-on experience with Data Cloud — data stream configuration, identity resolution, unified profile design and segmentation activation to Marketing Cloud Next.
* Subscriber Data Migration: Proven expertise migrating high\-volume subscriber databases, data extensions, consent records and suppression lists with zero data loss and full compliance preservation.
* Consent \& Compliance: Expert knowledge of GDPR, CAN\-SPAM, CASL — consent architecture design, preference centre migration and compliance\-aligned subscriber data handling.
* Integration Architecture: Understanding of Marketing Cloud Connect (CRM sync), REST/SOAP MC APIs, API\-triggered sends and event\-driven messaging integration patterns.
* Data Architecture \& Management: Strong understanding of subscriber data models, data extension architecture, sendable objects, contact counts and Large Data Volume (LDV) strategies for marketing platforms.
* Platform Security: Knowledge of data encryption, field\-level security and compliance protocols during subscriber data migration windows.
* Sharing \& Visibility: Understanding of how migrated subscriber and consent data will be secured and accessed post\-deployment across business units and regions.
* People Management: 5\+ years of experience managing technical consulting or engineering teams — including performance management, career development, hiring and mentoring in a delivery\-oriented environment.


**Preferred Skills — Good To Have**
* Experience migrating from Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot or legacy SFMC Classic to Marketing Cloud Next
* Hands\-on experience with ETL tools (Informatica, Talend, MuleSoft, Azure Data Factory) for large\-scale subscriber data migration
* Knowledge of Salesforce Interaction Studio / Personalisation for journey personalisation post\-migration
* Familiarity with email deliverability management — IP warm\-up, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, sender reputation management
* Experience with WhatsApp, Push, SMS and LINE channel migration in addition to email
* Understanding of marketing data warehouse patterns (Snowflake, Databricks) as upstream Data Cloud data sources


**Experience Requirements**
* 10–16 years of Salesforce and marketing technology consulting experience
* 5\+ years of hands\-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud delivery experience, with at least 2 end\-to\-end migration projects
* 5\+ years of people management experience leading technical consulting or delivery teams
* Demonstrated track record of leading concurrent migration workstreams in a factory or programme delivery model


****SALESFORCE \& PLATFORM CERTIFICATIONS****
* Salesforce Marketing Cloud Email Specialist (Required)

61f9dd96.title: Business Technology Solutions Manager- Salesforce Delivery

 and

 We are seeking a seasoned Salesforce professional with a deep understanding of the Salesforce ecosystem, particularly in the field of Salesforce Health Cloud. This individual will play a crucial role in expanding our Salesforce practice, driving digital transformation across various industries, with a special focus on healthcare. Our firm looks to leverage your innovative thinking and leadership to develop cutting\-edge business solutions that leverage AI and Analytics to deliver maximum value to our clients.

As a Salesforce expert, the candidate will draw on their skills and experience to lead defining salesforce related business solutions/sales plays; work with team(s) to develop ZS capabilities (including: selling collateral and assets/accelerators/demos); and take the offerings to ZS’ client to convert to real opportunities, supporting the entire lifecycle of engagements. To do so, you will need to deeply understand customer requirements, understand the salesforce.com ecosystem and work closely with functional specialists to develop innovative, cutting\-edge business solutions leveraging AI/Analytics to maximize the value to our clients. You will work closely with functional specialists to develop creative business solutions, solving some of the most exciting problems for our clients.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* End\-to\-End Delivery Management:
+ Deliver exceptional client service, ensuring projects stay within expected timeframes and budgets.
+ Review application and technical design documents, ensuring they follow Salesforce best practices and integrate effectively into the client's infrastructure.
+ Team and Capability Development:
+ Develop team skills and collaborate to create accelerators and assets that enhance our service offerings to clients.

* Offerings and Business Development:
+ Collaborate with ZS and industry experts to define integrated programs and offerings, taking them to market with the client service teams.
+ Lead large\-scale business development and delivery engagements, especially in the Healthcare sector.

* Mentoring and Coaching:
+ Provide on\-the\-job feedback and coaching to team members and actively participate in the counseling and mentoring of junior consultants within the organization.

* Solution Architecture and Design:
+ Collaborate with healthcare organizations to understand their business needs and design customized Salesforce Health Cloud solutions.
+ Lead the architecture and design of scalable, secure, and high\-performance Salesforce Health Cloud implementations.

* Technical Guidance and Quality Assurance:
+ Develop and maintain technical documentation, including solution designs, data models, and integration patterns.
+ Conduct code reviews and ensure best practices are followed for Salesforce Health Cloud implementations.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Bachelor's degree with major in Computers or Electronics.
* 10\+ years’ of overall professional experience; with at least 5 years in a leadership role within a professional services firm.
* Proven experience as a Salesforce Health Cloud Architect, designing and implementing solutions for healthcare organizations.
* Strong understanding of the Salesforce platform, including platform configuration, Visual Force, Lightning, Workflows, Apex, and AppExchange.
* In\-depth knowledge of healthcare data models and HIPAA regulations.
* Proficiency in shaping, providing consulting, building \& implementing solutions using Salesforce cloud offerings.
* Good understanding of DevOps as they apply to Salesforce, including various methodologies and tools such as Salesforce DX.
* Active Salesforce Certifications Architect is strongly preferred.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Willingness to travel to meet client needs.


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Salesforce certifications, such as Salesforce Certified Application Architect or Salesforce Certified System Architect.
* Proficiency in using MuleSoft and familiarity with other Salesforce cloud offerings like Sales, Service, Community, and Marketing Cloud.
* Working experience with Salesforce.com organization to leverage the ecosystem.
* The successful candidate will demonstrate a high level of motivation, excellent problem\-solving skills, a strong work ethic, and executive\-level presence and communication.


**How you’ll grow:**
* Cross\-functional skills development \& custom learning pathways
* Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
* Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s\-curves, individual contribution and role expansions


**Perks \& Benefits:**
 At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in India, visit ZS India office locations \| Where we work \| ZS.
   

  

**Hybrid working model:**
 We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on\-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face\-to\-face connections.
   

  

**Travel:**
 Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client\-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.
   

  

**Considering applying?**
 At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.
   

  

 If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

 ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.
   

  

 To complete your application:
   

  

 Candidates must possess or be able to obtain work authorization for their intended country of employment. An on\-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.

**IE IoT Software Program Manager – Linux \& Industrial Solutions**
**Role Overview**
 The IE IoT Software Program Manager is responsible for driving end‑to‑end execution of Qualcomm’s Linux platform initiatives with a strong emphasis on upstream alignment, open\-source excellence, distribution enablement, lifecycle management, and the productization of industrial‑grade IoT solutions.
   

  

 This role demands exceptional cross‑functional leadership, deep expertise in embedded Linux development ecosystems, and the ability to orchestrate execution across kernel, Yocto, Debian/Ubuntu, user‑space frameworks, CI pipelines, and industrial solution teams. A customer‑first approach, cost‑efficient decision making, and proven experience transforming prototypes into robust, production‑ready industrial solutions are essential.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Linux Platform \& Upstream Leadership**
* Define and lead mainline alignment, upstreaming strategies, and branch lifecycle management across mainline, LTS, and stable trees.
* Oversee open‑source compliance, release coordination, and adherence to Qualcomm’s Linux‑first execution strategy.
* Ensure predictable upstream refresh cadences across kernel, Yocto, and Debian/Ubuntu ecosystems


**Distro Enablement \& Ecosystem Integration**
* Drive end‑to‑end enablement across Yocto, Debian, and Ubuntu distributions, including graphics, multimedia, AI/ML, connectivity, robotics, and industrial frameworks.
* Champion developer‑first workflows, upstream‑friendly integration practices, and clear, high‑quality open‑source documentation.


**Productization \& Industrial IoT Solution Readiness**
* Convert platform capabilities and prototypes into stable, repeatable, production‑grade industrial IoT solutions.
* Integrate key industrial protocols (OPC UA, Modbus, EtherCAT, Profinet, MQTT, CoAP, etc.) into platform roadmaps and solution blueprints.
* Drive cost‑optimized decision making across feature sets, cloud usage, and hardware/software selections.


**Customer Engagement \& Solutions Engineering**
* Maintain strong customer focus—translate customer needs into actionable, prioritized engineering workflows.
* Lead solution prototyping, PoCs, and integration efforts by coordinating across functional teams.
* Deliver developer‑grade documentation, solution guides, and production‑ready reference implementations.


**Cross‑Functional Program Leadership**
* Manage large cross‑functional execution spanning kernel, multimedia, Android, connectivity, user space, and partner teams that includes the HW platform teams.
* Own schedules, milestone alignment, dependency mapping, risk management, and executive communications.
* Ensure Linux‑first, developer‑first discipline across the entire engineering pipeline.


**Quality, Testing \& Automation Excellence**
* Drive strong pre‑merge validation, CI/CD health, and continuous testing coverage across mainline and LTS branches.
* Track quality regressions across features, drive closure with partner teams, and uphold production‑readiness KPIs.


**Required**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 10–15\+ years of leadership experience within embedded Linux/Kernel/Yocto/Open‑Source ecosystems.
* Deep understanding of:
+ Upstream Linux development workflows (maintainers, linux‑next, LTS/stable branches).
+ Kernel branching models, mainline alignment, Yocto/OE pipelines, and Debian/Ubuntu packaging and workflows.
+ Open‑source contribution processes (patch submission, review cycles, Gerrit/Git workflows).

* Demonstrated success managing complex, multi‑disciplinary engineering programs.
* Exceptional communication skills and strong stakeholder management with a risk‑driven decision mindset.


**Preferred**
* Experience with industrial IoT systems, industrial protocols, or Linux‑based industrial platforms.
* Background in prototyping, customer‑facing engineering, or productizing industrial IoT software stacks.

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.

dd1d979a.title: Principal Program Manager, Enterprise AI Strategy & Governance
dd1d979a.description:
We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You are a highly skilled program manager with strong understanding of Artificial intelligence technology and its transformative potential. With deep expertise in leading complex, cross\-functional programs, you thrive in fast\-paced environments where strategic thinking and execution go hand in hand. You are comfortable collaborating with diverse stakeholders, from engineers to executive leadership, and excel at aligning program objectives with organizational strategy.
   

  

 You bring a proven track record of managing enterprise\-scale AI initiatives, including the evaluation and integration of new models, tools, and third\-party solutions. Your leadership style fosters a culture of continuous improvement, and you are adept at change management, ensuring smooth adoption of Gen/Agentic AI technologies across corporate functions. If you are energized by the challenge of shaping the future of AI at scale, Synopsys offers you the platform to make a lasting impact.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Lead and scale Synopsys' enterprise AI Governance operating model across GenAI, LLMs, Agentic AI, third\-party AI solutions, and internal AI applications, establishing processes for intake, evaluation, approval, monitoring, risk management, and lifecycle oversight
* Partner with Legal, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Compliance, Procurement, Engineering, Product, IT, and business stakeholders to evaluate AI technologies and use cases, ensuring alignment across risk, regulatory compliance, IP protection, privacy, and security requirements
* Operationalize governance frameworks including NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF), ISO/IEC 42001, and Responsible AI principles, translating them into practical workflows that balance innovation velocity with enterprise risk
* Define governance patterns for Agentic AI systems, including access controls, monitoring, auditability, and lifecycle management, partnering with R\&D teams to ensure safe and responsible deployment
* Drive AI Academy initiatives in partnership with People and business leaders to build AI literacy, responsible AI awareness, and role\-specific AI skills across the organization, developing adoption playbooks and enablement programs
* Develop governance metrics, executive dashboards, and reporting mechanisms to drive transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement across AI adoption and risk management
* Support strategic AI ecosystem partnerships, platform evaluations, and technology provider assessments, contributing to enterprise AI strategy, adoption roadmaps, and executive communications


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* Shape how Synopsys governs, deploys, and scales AI technologies across 30,000 employees, establishing the foundation for responsible and secure AI adoption company\-wide
* Enable business units and corporate functions to adopt GenAI and Agentic AI safely and effectively, reducing risk exposure while accelerating innovation velocity
* Build governance processes that protect Synopsys' intellectual property, customer data, and regulatory compliance posture as AI becomes embedded across products and operations
* Drive workforce readiness and AI literacy across the organization, ensuring employees have the skills and awareness to integrate AI into their daily work responsibly
* Establish Synopsys as a leader in enterprise AI governance, operationalizing best practices that set the standard for responsible AI adoption in the semiconductor and high\-tech industry
* Provide executive leadership with visibility into AI adoption, risk posture, and business impact through metrics, dashboards, and reporting that inform strategic decision\-making
* Create governance mechanisms that adapt to evolving AI technologies, regulatory requirements, and business needs, ensuring Synopsys stays ahead of the curve as AI capabilities advance


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline
* 12\+ years of experience leading complex enterprise\-scale technical programs within software, semiconductor, cloud, AI, or high\-tech environments
* Experience building or operating AI Governance, Responsible AI, technology risk, compliance, cybersecurity, or enterprise transformation programs
* Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic AI, AI platforms, and AI adoption challenges within large organizations
* Experience coordinating cross\-functional reviews involving Legal, Privacy, Cybersecurity, Compliance, Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders
* Familiarity with governance and risk frameworks such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and emerging AI regulatory requirements is a plus,
* Experience with portfolio management and workflow tools such as Jira, SharePoint, Confluence etc.
* Experience driving enterprise adoption, change management, workforce enablement, or AI upskilling initiatives is a plus


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can translate complex AI governance and risk topics into clear, actionable guidance for executives, engineers, and business leaders without losing the technical nuance
* You influence across organizations and executive levels without direct authority, building trust and alignment through credibility, clarity, and follow\-through
* You operate comfortably in ambiguity, building governance structures and processes in environments where technology, policy, and business objectives are evolving in real time
* You connect the dots between AI technology capabilities, governance requirements, risk management, and business value, ensuring that governance enables rather than blocks progress
* You manage multiple high\-stakes initiatives simultaneously, keeping stakeholders aligned, timelines on track, and deliverables moving without dropping details
* You have a point of view on what good AI governance looks like and you are not afraid to push back when a policy is too vague, a process is too slow, or a risk assessment misses the actual exposure


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 You will be part of the Strategic Missions \& Technologies (SMT) organization, helping drive Synopsys' enterprise AI journey. The team partners closely with Engineering, Product, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, IT, People, IP group along with executive leadership to enable the responsible, secure, and scalable adoption of AI across the company. This role reports to the Head of AI Governance, Program Management and Chief of Staff for Strategic Missions \& Technologies (SMT). This onsite role is based in Bangalore and requires regular collaboration with US\-based teams, including overlap with Pacific Time hours.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

5eabc9be.description:
**Company Description** 
 Rudram Realty, part of Rudram Group, is built on a vision of helping customers find the right real estate investment for their needs. The organization focuses on turning property aspirations into practical, successful outcomes. By simplifying each step of the real estate journey, Rudram Realty aims to make transactions transparent, efficient, and rewarding. Team members collaborate closely with clients, providing guidance and support from initial inquiry to final purchase. **Role Description** 
 The Presales Specialist is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Noida. The Presales Specialist will prepare and deliver presentations, proposals, and product information, while coordinating with the sales team to support deal closure. * Strong Analytical Skills to assess customer requirements, evaluate property options, and support data\-driven recommendations.

* Relevant experience in real estate, property consulting, or a sales/presales environment is preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Real Estate, or a related field is beneficial.

19d65226.description:
**Job Description**

 **Senior Presales Consultant** 
 with strong multi\-cloud expertise and hands\-on Salesforce knowledge. The ideal candidate will design and propose scalable, secure, and cost\-efficient technical solutions across diverse technology ecosystems—including Salesforce, AWS, Azure, and integration/middleware platforms—without vendor bias.
   

  

 This role bridges sales, delivery, and engineering, bringing deep technical insight, excellent communication skills, and strong solution\-design capabilities to the RFx process.
   

  

 MTX is a global technology consulting firm that enables organisations to modernise through digital transformation. With data as the new currency, MTX helps transform long\-term strategy with outcomes in mind around happiness, health and the economy. MTX improves decision\-making with speed and quality by partnering with leading cloud technologies. MTX provides expertise across various platforms and technologies, including Microsoft, Google Cloud, Salesforce, artificial intelligence/machine learning, data integration, data governance, data quality, analytics, visualization, and mobile technology.

 The Senior Pre\-Sales Consultant is expected to lead large\-scale/complex project(s), executing the following responsibilities:
   

  

 Client, Sales \& RFx Engagement:
   

  

* Lead the analysis of RFI/RFP/Tender documents to understand customer pain points, objectives, technical landscape, and constraints.

* Translate requirements into epics, modules, feature lists, and high\-level solution blueprints.

e1f68fbe.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
e1f68fbe.description:
Enterprise Bot is the leading provider of GenAI, Conversational AI, and automation software, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland. Our intelligent virtual assistants and automation tools help organizations improve efficiency, reduce costs, and deliver exceptional customer experiences across industries such as banking, insurance, and logistics. Our mission is to become the world’s \#1 AI\-driven automation software provider within the next five years.
 


  


 We work with leading companies such as the SIX Group (Swiss Stock Exchange), SWICA, Generali, and others to enhance customer interactions and automate business processes using our cutting\-edge Conversational AI technology.
 


  


 Our global team includes more than 70 highly skilled professionals from diverse backgrounds.
 


  


 We foster an open, progressive company culture with state\-of\-the\-art technology and flat hierarchies. At Enterprise Bot, you’ll experience a unique blend of passion, purpose, challenge, and fun.
 


  


 We’re growing rapidly across Europe and looking for a
 **Senior Solutions Engineer** 
 who combines deep technical expertise with strong business acumen to help our customers succeed.
 


  

 Tasks
   


 As a
 **Senior Solutions Engineer** 
 , you’ll act as the technical backbone of our sales and customer engagement process. You’ll collaborate with Sales, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to design, present, and deliver impactful automation solutions. This role blends hands\-on technical work with strategic engagement — ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of technology, business value, and customer experience.
 


  


**Key Responsibilities** 



  


**Pre\-Sales \& Technical Enablement** 



  

  
* Partner with the Sales team to understand customer requirements and design tailored AI automation solutions using Enterprise Bot’s platform.
  
* Deliver compelling product demos, proof\-of\-concepts (POCs), and presentations that clearly communicate technical and business value.
  
* Lead technical discovery sessions and develop architecture proposals and integration plans.
  


  


**Solution Design \& Delivery** 



  

  
* Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable solution architectures.
  
* Collaborate with Engineering teams during pilots and implementations to ensure seamless technical delivery.
  
* Provide technical validation and support during critical phases of the sales cycle.
  


  


**Customer Engagement \& Partnership** 



  

  
* Build trusted relationships with customers by acting as a technical advisor throughout the engagement.
  
* Ensure customer success by proactively identifying risks and helping resolve technical challenges.
  
* Be available to support key customer engagements or escalations when necessary.
  


  


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



  

  
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to align roadmap priorities with customer feedback.
  
* Contribute to technical enablement materials, training sessions, and playbooks to strengthen overall sales effectiveness.
  
* Advocate for customer needs within the organization and help improve solution delivery processes.
  


  


**Thought Leadership \& Market Engagement** 



  

  
* Represent Enterprise Bot at industry events, webinars, and conferences.
  
* Stay up to date on AI automation trends, cloud technologies, and emerging best practices in the B2B SaaS landscape.
  
* Contribute to positioning Enterprise Bot as a trusted technology partner and thought leader in intelligent automation.
  


  

 Requirements
   

  
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field (Master’s preferred).
  
* 5\+ years of experience in Pre\-Sales, Solutions Engineering, or similar roles, with at least 2 years at a senior level.
  
* Proven track record in B2B SaaS or AI\-automation environments (experience with conversational AI, RPA, or cloud\-based automation is a strong plus).
  
* Experience with voice technologies such as ACD and IVR workflows is a must.
  
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
  
* Strong English communication skills and the ability to engage effectively across technical and business stakeholders. Proficiency in French and Spanish is an added advantage.
  
* Strong understanding of enterprise systems (CRM, ERP, cloud infrastructure, APIs, etc.).
  
* Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship\-building skills.
  
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and perform under pressure in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.
  


  


**Preferred Qualifications** 



  

  
* Hands\-on experience with CRM or presales tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot).
  
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, and related certifications.
  
* Understanding of NLP, automation workflows, or integration frameworks (e.g., REST, GraphQL).
  
* Experience in enterprise\-scale solution delivery and customer success collaboration.
  


  

 Benefits
   

  
* Be part of a rapidly growing company at the forefront of AI automation and conversational AI solutions used by leading global enterprises.
  
* Shape solutions that make a measurable impact for Fortune 500 clients and leading European enterprises.
  
* A culture comprised of diverse, global teams who have a passion for collaboration, creativity, and excellence in client service
  
* A competitive salary and scope for further advancement.
  
* A great environment that promotes open feedback and a flat hierarchy, working at Enterprise Bot is a refreshing mix of purpose, challenge, and fun.

72af9bd6.description:
**WirelessCar’s Journey**


WirelessCar drives the future of mobility by connecting vehicles and developing cutting\-edge digital services. We help leading brands—like Volkswagen, Volvo, and Jaguar Land Rover—innovate, enhance mobility, and accelerate their digital transformation. Join us and shape the next era of automotive technology!

  

We are looking for a **Senior Software Engineer – Cloud \& Backend** to join our cross\-functional DevOps team.


In this role, you will design, build, deploy, and operate **cloud\-native, microservice\-based solutions** end\-to\-end. You will provide technical leadership for complex systems and critical components, contribute to architecture and technical direction, and take ownership of the quality, reliability, and sustainability of the services you help build.


You will work with modern technologies including **Java, AWS, Kubernetes, microservices, and CI/CD**, while collaborating closely with developers, architects, Product Owners, and other stakeholders.


Beyond individual delivery, you will help shape engineering practices, reduce technical debt and systemic risk, mentor engineers, and contribute to the long\-term technical evolution of our systems and platform.

#### **Here’s what you’ll focus on**

* Design, build, deploy, and operate **cloud\-native, microservice\-based solutions** end\-to\-end.
* Lead architecture and technical direction for **complex systems and critical components**.
* Translate business and technical requirements into robust, scalable, secure, and cost\-effective solutions.
* Own delivery outcomes including **quality, reliability, performance, and sustainability**.
* Drive continuous improvement of systems, services, and engineering practices.
* Define, promote, and uphold **engineering standards, security practices, operational excellence, and quality**.
* Identify, prioritize, and reduce **technical debt and systemic risks** across services and teams.
* Make technical decisions with awareness of **customer value, cost, business impact, and operational considerations**.
* Lead technical discussions, design reviews, and code reviews.
* Mentor and support engineers through knowledge sharing, technical guidance, and daily collaboration.
* Lead technical initiatives and improvements when needed.
* Collaborate in cross\-functional Agile teams to clarify **system context, dependencies, risks, and the bigger picture**.
* Take responsibility across the complete **DevOps lifecycle**, including development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and production support.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues and drive root\-cause analysis and long\-term improvements.
* Contribute to engineering culture and support the wider organization with **deep technical expertise**.

#### **We Offer You**

* A people\-focused company with a healthy work\-life balance and a hybrid way of working.
* A flat organizational culture built on trust, openness, and autonomy.
* The opportunity to work with modern technologies and connected mobility solutions.
* A global workplace with international collaboration and opportunities for professional growth.
* Hands\-on work with **Java, AWS, Kubernetes, microservices, and CI/CD**.
* A strong DevOps culture with complete lifecycle ownership.
* The opportunity to influence technical direction and engineering practices.
* Opportunities to mentor engineers and contribute to the wider engineering community.
