6cd12c3e.title: Solution Architect - Teamcenter (BOM/Structures)
6cd12c3e.description:
**Hello Visionary!**
 We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an outstanding addition to our vibrant team. Siemens Mobility is an independent handled company of Siemens AG. Its core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems, intelligent road traffic technology and related services. The Information Technology (IT) department has the global responsibility for the internal IT of Siemens Mobility. Its goal is to provide a robust and efficient IT landscape derived from business and market demands. Your personality and individuality make the difference. In our team, we increase business performance and point the way into the digital age. Is that exactly your thing? Then live your passion in a cross\-location team in which you can actively craft the future of our company. You open up new possibilities for our customers with your competence. Connected with this is an exciting career path that leads you to ever new projects and solutions in the field of IT for Siemens Mobility.
   

  

**We are looking for a Solution Architect \- Teamcenter (BOM/Structures)**
 Digitization poses major challenges for many companies and will change processes immensely in the coming years. This is also the case at Siemens Mobility GmbH – as an IT Solution Architect (f/m/d), you will actively help shape and accompany a Siemens Teamcenter transformation project. The project works according to the SAFe methodology and strives to replace the current SAP PLM system with a modern Teamcenter system (based on Teamcenter 14\.3 and Active Workspace 6\.3\) for approximately 15 000 users.
   

  

**You’ll make a difference by:**
* You are a Solution Architect in the Siemens Teamcenter transformation project for one or more topics of for following list
+ “Coordinated Material Management” (IMM)) and "Substance Compliance"
+ Collaboration and data exchange with external partners (module “Supplier Connect”)
+ Product structures (module “Multi Structure Foundation” and related Engineering topics)

* Your responsibility is the complete and consistent replacement of the existing SAP solution with the new Teamcenter solution in this area of expertise.
* You will analyze the business requirements, but also the existing IT landscape (SAP and other systems) and translate this into a solution design for Teamcenter to ensure efficient integration.
* You will analyze, design and optimize the sophisticated Teamcenter solution and suitable architectures in detail to make Teamcenter user\-friendly and optimized for the Siemens Mobility Business
* You will be responsible for Manufacturing Integration in Mobility IT and for the topic beyond the project period.
* As a member of an agile, international team (SAFe methodology), you will work closely with the product owner, the supplier's implementation authorities and other authorities in the team as well as across teams.


**You’ll win us over by:**
* You have a degree (Master's/Diploma) in computer science or a similar field of study.
* In addition, you have several years of in\-depth experience in the field of Teamcenter design \& development, as well as configuration/customizing, with a distributed system environment and integration of major software tools – ideally with a focus on product structures
* A good knowledge of the product development processes in the manufacturing industry is desirable.
* SAP PLM knowledge is desirable
* In depth knowledge of Teamcenter Bill of Materials and Bill of Processes is must
* Knowledge and working experience in product structure is must
* Knowledge of MES (Manufacturing Execution System) is desirable
* Time Management while creating BOP for shopfloor is desirable
* Ideally, you also have experience in working in agile project teams
* You have a structured, independent, and solution\-oriented way of working, communication and partnership skills.
* Very good English skills are required due to the global orientation of the role, with German language skills being an additional advantage.


**Join us and be yourself!**
 We value your outstanding identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and build a better tomorrow with us.
   

  

**Make your mark in our exciting world at Siemens.**
 This role is based in Pune and is an Individual contributor role. You might be required to visit other locations within India and outside. In return, you'll get the chance to work with teams impacting \- and the shape of things to come. We're Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and encouragement and help us shape tomorrow.
   

  

 Find out more about Siemens careers at: www.siemens.com/careers \& more about mobility at https://new.siemens.com/global/en/products/mobility.html

706438f2.title: Solution Architect - Shared Services
706438f2.description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well\-being, and work\-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.
   

  

 Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As a Solution Architect at Empower, you will be a hands\-on technical leader and solution\-shaping architecture contributor supporting Human Resources, Legal, Compliance, and the Office of the CIO. You will partner with business leaders, Business and Enterprise Architects, product owners, cybersecurity, engineering, operations, data, and vendor teams to translate business outcomes, regulatory obligations, and operational needs into secure, scalable, resilient, and cost\-effective end\-to\-end solutions.
   

  

 The role spans SaaS platforms, cloud services, applications, integrations, data, and infrastructure, with particular emphasis on ServiceNow and AWS. You will guide initiatives from discovery through implementation, define target\-state and reference architectures, document decisions and trade\-offs, and establish reusable patterns and guardrails. You will also support the broader shared\-services technology landscape, including Atlassian Jira and Confluence, Palantir Foundry, SQL Server, and PostgreSQL, while ensuring solutions are supportable, observable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise standards.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own end\-to\-end solution architecture for moderately to highly complex initiatives across Human Resources, Legal, Compliance, and the Office of the CIO, connecting business capabilities and processes to application, integration, data, security, and technology designs.
* Lead discovery and translate functional and nonfunctional requirements \- including security, privacy, records retention, auditability, availability, recovery, performance, scalability, supportability, and cost \- into practical architecture options and recommendations.
* Create and maintain architecture deliverables such as current\-state and target\-state views, context and logical diagrams, deployment models, data flows, integration designs, nonfunctional requirements, architecture decision records, reference architectures, roadmaps, and transition plans.
* Serve as a ServiceNow architecture lead, defining scalable platform and solution designs across workflows, the platform data model, CSDM and CMDB, integrations, identity and security, custom applications, environment strategy, performance, upgradeability, and platform governance. Evaluate fit\-to\-platform and minimize unnecessary customization.
* Design AWS solutions aligned with AWS Well\-Architected principles across identity and access management, networking, compute, storage, databases, integration, observability, backup and recovery, high availability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
* Define and guide infrastructure automation using AWS CloudFormation and/or Terraform, including reusable templates and modules, source control, automated validation, environment promotion, secrets handling, policy guardrails, and stack, state, and drift management.
* Embed DevOps and DevSecOps practices into solution designs, including CI/CD, automated testing, security scanning, release and rollback strategies, monitoring and logging, alerting, incident readiness, and operational handoff.
* Architect secure, reusable integration patterns across SaaS platforms, AWS, on\-premises systems, and vendor ecosystems using APIs, events, messaging, files, and data pipelines. Define contracts, authentication, error handling, observability, and lifecycle governance.
* Guide relational database architecture for SQL Server and PostgreSQL, including data design, performance, security, high availability and disaster recovery, backup and recovery, migration, and appropriate use of AWS managed database services.
* Provide architecture oversight through delivery by reviewing detailed designs, guiding engineering teams, leading proofs of concept, resolving cross\-system dependencies, and verifying implementation against approved architecture.
* Evaluate technologies and vendor solutions, advise on build, buy, and configure decisions, and identify opportunities to simplify, modernize, rationalize, and optimize the shared\-services application portfolio and run cost.
* Contribute to architecture standards, design\-review forums, reusable patterns, decision records, and lessons learned. Communicate recommendations, risks, and trade\-offs clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.


**Required Qualifications**
* At least 5 years of progressive experience designing and delivering enterprise technology solutions, including ownership of end\-to\-end solution design for multiple moderately to highly complex initiatives.
* Demonstrated ServiceNow solution or platform architecture experience in a large enterprise environment \- not solely platform administration or development \- including translating business requirements into platform capabilities and governing implementation.
* Deep knowledge of the ServiceNow platform architecture, including but not limited to, application scopes, Business Rules, Script Includes, ACLs, APIs, and platform configuration.
* Strong AWS architecture experience and working knowledge across core cloud domains, with the ability to evaluate security, resilience, operational, performance, and cost trade\-offs.
* Hands\-on experience with infrastructure as code using AWS CloudFormation and/or Terraform, including reusable components and automated deployment workflows.
* DevOps or DevSecOps experience with Git\-based delivery, CI/CD, automated testing, deployment automation, observability, and production supportability.
* Enterprise application and integration architecture experience across SaaS, cloud, and on\-premises systems, with strong knowledge of API, event, identity, and data integration patterns.
* Experience designing solutions using both SQL Server and PostgreSQL, with an understanding of performance, security, high availability and disaster recovery, backup and recovery, and migration considerations.
* Ability to define and evaluate functional and nonfunctional requirements and to design for privacy, security, auditability, segregation of duties, records management, and other controls appropriate to sensitive or regulated environments.
* Strong architecture modeling and documentation skills, with experience in design reviews, architecture decision records, reference patterns, and implementation governance.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, facilitation, and communication skills, with the ability to influence cross\-functional teams and explain technical decisions, risks, and trade\-offs to varied audiences.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or comparable architecture\-level experience; Certified System Administrator (CSA), Certified Application Developer (CAD), or relevant Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) credentials.
* Architecture experience with ServiceNow capabilities relevant to shared services, such as ITSM, ITOM, Strategic Portfolio Management, HR Service Delivery, Integrated Risk Management or GRC, Legal Service Delivery, App Engine or Workflow Studio, Integration Hub, MID Server, CSDM, and CMDB.
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect \- Associate or Professional, and/or a HashiCorp Terraform certification.
* Enterprise architecture or administration experience with Atlassian Jira and Confluence, including workflows, permissions, automation, integrations, Marketplace app governance, and cloud or data\-center lifecycle management.
* Palantir Foundry experience, including data integration and pipelines, Ontology modeling, application or workflow enablement, security and governance, and production lifecycle practices.
* Experience supporting Human Resources, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Finance, or Office of the CIO technology capabilities in a regulated enterprise.
* Experience with containers, serverless computing, event\-driven architecture, microservices, and scripting or automation languages.
* Familiarity with architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, Agile or product operating models, SaaS and platform lifecycle management, vendor evaluation, cloud financial management or FinOps, and application rationalization.


 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. A master's degree is a plus.


 Physical Requirements/Working Conditions
   

  

* Normal office working conditions.


 Do we want to call out another qualification: Deep knowledge of the ServiceNow platform architecture, including but not limited to, application scopes, Business Rules, Script Includes, ACLs, APIs, and platform configuration.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to diversity. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, religion, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable state or local law.

**Ciklum** 
 is looking for a

 to join our team full\-time in India.
   

  

 We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

 As a SAP Analytics Cloud \& Datasphere Consultant, become a part of a cross\-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and develop analytic applications using SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) and SAP
* Datasphere, focusing on KPI and analytical models that support strategic business initiatives
* Build interactive dashboards and KPI applications in SAC for both import and live scenarios, leveraging data sourced from SAP Datasphere and other platforms
* Create scalable, secure, and governed data models in SAP Datasphere to support advanced analytics and reporting use cases
* Integrate SAC dashboards seamlessly with SAP Datasphere datasets, ensuring up\-to\-date and consistent analytics for end users
* Utilize predictive scenarios, R\-visualizations, and external libraries to create immersive and insightful user experiences in both SAC and Datasphere environments
* Continuously optimize dashboard and application performance across SAC and Datasphere, while providing recommendations for enhancements and identifying bottlenecks

* Connect, model, and harmonize data from SAP and non\-SAP sources in Datasphere, facilitating cross\-system analytics through SAC
* Design comprehensive reports with multiple tabs, queries, visualizations, and drill\-down capabilities tailored to business requirements
* Apply best practices in data visualization and user experience, enhancing accessibility and adoption of solutions built on SAC and Datasphere
* Demonstrate expertise in data integration, connectivity, and modelling across SAC, Datasphere, and other data platforms
* Utilize strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to address technical challenges and drive continuous performance improvement
* Provide technical leadership, coaching, and mentorship to team members, fostering knowledge growth in SAC and Datasphere technologies
* Establish and maintain best practices for software quality, documentation, and project delivery within agile and scrum frameworks
* Customize SAC applications using scripting languages (such as JavaScript) and leverage advanced features in Datasphere for data orchestration and automation

* Expertise with SAC predictive functionality, Smart features (Smart Assist, Smart Predict, Smart Discovery), advanced story canvases, data blending, cross\-calculations, input controls, and linked analysis
* Skilled in connecting SAC and Datasphere to varied data sources, including SAP HANA, and external databases

da35f5d6.title: Architect, Apps & AI
da35f5d6.description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft Industry Solutions \- Global Center Innovation and Delivery Center (GCID) delivers end\-to\-end solutions by enabling accelerated adoption and productive use of Microsoft technologies. An organization of well over 1000\+ exceptional people, GCID presents a great opportunity for highly skilled services professionals to make a foray into consulting, solution development and delivery roles.
   

  

 The Architect is a senior leader responsible for the successful technical execution and delivery of complex client projects across diverse domains. This role acts as a strategic anchor between clients, senior leadership, delivery managers, project managers, and delivery teams. In the AI\-first GCID organization, Architect(s) are expected to embed AI\-native thinking into delivery models, ensuring solutions are intelligent, scalable, and aligned with business outcomes. The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, demonstrates breadth of expertise, and advocates for solutions that deliver true client value.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**AI\-First Delivery Leadership**
* Embed AI\-first principles into delivery workflows, leveraging automation and intelligent orchestration where applicable.
* Own the Architecture and drive end\-to\-end delivery of complex projects, ensuring solutions are scalable, robust, and aligned with client business outcomes.
* Drive engineering excellence through reusable components, accelerators, and scalable architecture.
* Oversee technical execution across multiple projects, ensuring adherence to best practices, quality standards, and compliance requirements.
* Collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to define strategies, delivery plans, milestones, and risk mitigation approaches.
* Act as a technical point of contact for clients, translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Ensure delivery models are optimized for modern, AI\-native execution, including integration of automation and intelligent processes.
* Ability to step into at‑risk projects, quickly assess issues, and establish a credible path to recovery or exit.


**Engineering Excellence**
 Promote high\-quality engineering throughout all projects. Enforce coding standards, architectural integrity, and performance goals. Establish secure coding, TDD, and observability practices. Support ongoing learning and certifications. Advance modern methodologies like Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD for scalable solutions. Build a team culture of technical rigor, innovation, and accountability.
   

  

**Innovation \& Thought Leadership**
 Track new technologies to guide strategy. Drive innovation in delivery, assets, and tools for better efficiency. Promote best practices and continuous improvement across teams.
   

  

**Client Engagement \& Solutioning**
 Apply design thinking to develop user\-centric solutions that also support business objectives, architecture, and project delivery. Collaborate with clients to identify their needs and provide guidance throughout each stage of the project. Participate in pre\-sales and solutioning activities by preparing estimates, proofs\-of\-concept, and technical proposals. Additionally, maintain strong client relationships to ensure satisfaction and ongoing value.
   

  

**Team Management \& Mentorship**
 Lead cross\-functional teams, promote learning and collaboration, and uphold technical standards. Review work, offer feedback, and support team growth.
   

  

**Quality \& Compliance**
 Ensure secure, compliant, and reliable solution delivery through secure coding, test‑driven development, observability, design reviews, and quality gates across all engagements.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* 16\+ years of experience in software/solution engineering, with at least 8\-12 years as Architect and delivery leadership roles.
* Proven experience in leading delivery of complex, multi\-disciplinary projects.
* Strong understanding of modern delivery methodologies (Agile, Scrum, DevOps, etc.).
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, problem\-solving, and team leadership skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Relevant certifications are a plus.


**Areas of Expertise**
**Full Stack Application Engineering**
* 
+ End\-to\-end design and development of modern web and mobile applications using React, Angular, Next.js, Blazor, or equivalent frameworks
+ Strong backend expertise using .NET / Java / Node.js / Python, with clean architecture, domain\-driven design, and API\-first principles
+ Experience building microservices and distributed systems using REST, gRPC, event\-driven patterns, and asynchronous processing
+ Hands\-on expertise with relational and NoSQL databases (Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB) and performance tuning
+ Strong understanding of state management, scalability, resiliency, and application security


**AI Driven Application Development**
* Proven expertise in AI‑driven application development, embedding intelligence directly into modern, cloud‑native applications.
* Extensive hands‑on experience using GitHub Copilot as a core engineering capability to accelerate solution design, coding, refactoring, testing, and documentation across delivery teams.
* Demonstrated ability to foster a Copilot‑assisted engineering culture (“vibe”) \- enabling rapid iteration, AI pair‑programming, explain‑as‑you‑build workflows, and high‑velocity delivery without compromising engineering quality.
* Strong experience modernizing application landscapes using GitHub Copilot‑assisted approaches, including rapid codebase comprehension, dependency analysis, large‑scale refactoring, and migration to cloud‑native and AI‑enabled architectures.

c01f77e5.title: D&T Project Delivery Manager
c01f77e5.description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
   

  

 Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
   

  

 Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The
 **D\&T Project Delivery Manager \- CTO Infrastructure, Network \& Cyber Security (DTIS)** 
 is responsible for the end\-to\-end delivery of enterprise technology and cyber security initiatives within Haleon's Digital \& Technology (D\&T) organization.
   

  

 The role provides governance, planning, reporting, execution oversight and delivery leadership across CTO Infrastructure Services, Network Services, Cloud Platforms and Digital Technology Information Security (DTIS) portfolios. This includes initiatives such as:
   

  

**CTO Infrastructure \& Network**
* Data Center Modernization
* Cloud Transformation
* Infrastructure Refresh Programs
* Server \& Storage Services
* Network Transformation
* SD\-WAN
* Enterprise Connectivity
* Unified Communications
* Disaster Recovery \& Business Continuity
* End User Computing
* Infrastructure Resilience


**Cyber Security \& DTIS**
* Identity \& Access Management (IAM)
* Privileged Access Management (PAM)
* Security Operations (SOC)
* Vulnerability Management
* Endpoint Security
* Cloud Security
* Network Security
* Data Protection
* Cyber Risk Remediation
* Security Compliance Programs
* Third\-Party Security Initiatives


 The Project Manager ensures delivery predictability, operational stability, cyber risk reduction, compliance adherence and continuous improvement across enterprise technology and security services.
   

  

 This role works closely with business stakeholders, Architecture, Infrastructure Engineering, Cloud Operations, Cyber Security teams, Risk \& Compliance functions, suppliers and managed service providers to ensure successful delivery of business\-critical initiatives.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 To deliver Infrastructure, Network, Cloud and Cyber Security projects safely and predictably, ensuring agreed business, operational and security outcomes are achieved through effective planning, governance, risk management and stakeholder engagement.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
 The Project Delivery Manager is accountable for:
   

  

* Successful end\-to\-end delivery of assigned CTO and DTIS projects.
* Consistent application of D\&T governance, delivery and security frameworks.
* Effective management of scope, plans, risks, issues and dependencies.
* Delivery of Infrastructure, Network, Cloud and Security transformation programs.
* Clear and timely reporting of project health, cyber risk posture and key decisions.
* Strong stakeholder, supplier and partner management.
* Operational stability and risk reduction through successful project execution.
* Delivery of business, technology, compliance and security outcomes.
* Support of enterprise resilience, availability and disaster recovery objectives.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Project Delivery \& Execution
* Own delivery of Infrastructure, Network, Cloud and Cyber Security projects from initiation through closure.
* Lead delivery using Agile, Waterfall or Hybrid methodologies.
* Coordinate enterprise transformation initiatives across multiple technology towers.
* Deliver projects involving:
+ Infrastructure Modernization
+ Network Transformation
+ Cloud Migration
+ IAM \& PAM
+ Vulnerability Management
+ Data Protection
+ Security Operations
+ Disaster Recovery
+ Cyber Risk Remediation

* Ensure alignment with architecture, security and operational standards.
* Planning \& Control
* Build and maintain comprehensive project plans, milestones and dependencies.
* Coordinate project activities across Cyber Security, Infrastructure, Network and Cloud teams.
* Manage change requests and project scope in a controlled manner.
* Track remediation commitments and project deliverables.
* Manage critical path activities and inter\-project dependencies.
* Risk, Issue \& Dependency Management
* Proactively identify, assess and manage project, operational and cyber security risks.
* Coordinate remediation of findings arising from:
+ Internal Audits
+ External Audits
+ Risk Assessments
+ Penetration Testing
+ Security Compliance Reviews

* Track mitigation plans through closure.
* Maintain visibility of delivery risks, cyber exposure and operational impacts.
* Stakeholder Management \& Communication
* Serve as the primary point of contact for business, D\&T, Security and Infrastructure stakeholders.
* Facilitate governance reviews, steering committees and leadership updates.
* Provide clear communication on:
+ Delivery Progress
+ Risks \& Issues
+ Cyber Security Posture
+ Financial Status
+ Key Decisions

* Drive stakeholder alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
* Financial \& Resource Management
* Manage project budgets, forecasts and financial controls.
* Work with Finance teams on planning and variance reporting.
* Ensure effective allocation and utilization of project resources.
* Manage infrastructure, cloud and cyber security project investments.
* Supplier \& Third\-Party Management
* Manage third\-party vendors, implementation partners and managed service providers.
* Oversee:
+ MSSPs
+ Cloud Service Providers
+ Telecommunications Providers
+ Infrastructure Partners
+ Security Technology Vendors

* Monitor supplier performance and contractual obligations.
* Escalate delivery or service issues through governance channels.
* Governance, Compliance \& Reporting
* Ensure adherence to D\&T governance and cyber security controls.
* Support:
+ Internal Audits
+ External Audits
+ Compliance Assessments
+ Assurance Reviews
+ Stage Gate Reviews

* Provide executive reporting on:
+ Project Health
+ Risk Exposure
+ Security Remediation
+ Infrastructure Transformation Progress
+ Cloud Adoption Metrics

* Service Transition \& Operational Readiness
* Support transition to Operations and Service Management teams.
* Ensure operational readiness activities are completed successfully.
* Coordinate support model alignment and service handover.
* Track benefits realization and cyber risk reduction outcomes.
* Continuous Improvement
* Drive lessons learned and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Promote delivery excellence, governance maturity and operational effectiveness.
* Support the adoption of cyber security best practices.
* Foster a culture of accountability, resilience and risk\-based decision\-making.


**What Good Looks Like**
* Infrastructure and Cyber Security projects are delivered with minimal surprises.
* Cloud migrations and technology refresh programs complete successfully.
* Security findings and vulnerabilities are remediated proactively.
* Enterprise platforms maintain high availability and stability.
* Stakeholders have clear visibility of delivery progress and risk posture.
* Governance processes are consistently followed.
* Business, security and compliance objectives are achieved.
* The Project Manager is viewed as reliable, organized and accountable.


**Essential**
**Qualifications \& Skills**
* 8\-13 years of experience delivering projects within Technology, Infrastructure, Network, Cloud, Cyber Security or Information Security environments.
* Strong experience managing complex enterprise technology transformation initiatives.
* Experience delivering projects across:
+ Infrastructure Services
+ Network Services
+ Cloud Platforms
+ Cyber Security Programs

* Strong understanding of Agile, Waterfall and Hybrid delivery methodologies.
* Excellent stakeholder management, planning and communication skills.
* Experience managing risks, dependencies and budgets in global matrix organizations.

* Security Operations (SOC)
* Vulnerability Management
* Endpoint Security
* Network Security
* Data Protection
* Cloud Security
* Cyber Risk Management
* Security Compliance \& Governance


**Preferred**
* Experience operating within enterprise portfolio governance frameworks.
* Experience supporting highly regulated environments.
* Experience leading cloud migration and infrastructure transformation programs.
* Familiarity with: Microsoft Azure, AWS, VMware, Cisco, Palo Alto, Arista, F5\.
* Knowledge of security frameworks: ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, GDPR / Data Privacy.

 2026\-09\-26

 Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. 835d7923.title: Solution Architect - Senior
835d7923.description:
The Solution Architect – Senior is responsible for defining and developing solution architectures that align with enterprise architecture strategies, principles, policies, standards, and business requirements. This role evaluates and applies solution designs for specific systems in collaboration with project and product teams and ensures solutions meet business, technical, security, governance, compliance, scalability, and performance requirements. The role involves translating complex business and technical requirements into scalable solution designs, evaluating multiple architectural options, conducting cost\-benefit analysis, and recommending optimized solutions. The Solution Architect – Senior also stays current with emerging technologies and supports pilots and proof\-of\-concept initiatives to validate new technology capabilities.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Define solution and system architectures in alignment with enterprise architecture strategies, standards, reference architectures, and technology principles.
* Decompose systems into components, perform functional allocation, and establish interfaces between systems and system components.
* Develop and evaluate multiple solution options, conduct cost\-benefit analysis, and recommend optimized solutions based on business and technical requirements.
* Design scalable architecture solutions for cloud\-based platforms, enterprise applications, data and analytics platforms, and integrated systems.
* Develop and maintain architecture deliverables, including conceptual and logical models, solution diagrams, architecture patterns, and technical documentation.
* Apply enterprise architecture standards, frameworks, technology stacks, architecture patterns, and reference models to solution designs.
* Architect and integrate enterprise applications, data platforms, APIs, and other technology systems to deliver end\-to\-end solutions.
* Translate complex business requirements, industry requirements, and governance considerations into practical and scalable technical solutions.
* Ensure solution designs address security, governance, compliance, performance, scalability, buildability, and operational requirements.
* Collaborate with project, product, engineering, data, security, and business teams to drive successful solution development and delivery.
* Provide technical leadership and influence architecture decisions across cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Facilitate and support pilots, proof\-of\-concept activities, and technology evaluations to validate emerging technologies and architectural approaches.
* Analyze infrastructure and technology capacity and provide recommendations to support current and future business needs.
* Maintain awareness of emerging technologies, software trends, tools, and industry practices and assess their applicability to business solutions.
* Support the adoption of Agile, DevSecOps, CI/CD, automation, and modern software delivery practices.
* Identify, assess, and manage technical risks and issues and drive appropriate mitigation actions.
* Build strong relationships with customers, business stakeholders, technology teams, and peers to promote effective solution development and delivery.
* Apply effective Business Relationship Management practices to ensure technology solutions deliver measurable business value.
* Drive changes in technical architecture and standards into solution designs when business or technology needs evolve.


**Mandatory Skills**


* Enterprise Architecture and Solution Design

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

### **Nice to Have**

* Knowledge of advanced analytics, predictive modeling, and AI\-driven decision systems.
* Experience with IoT and connected product ecosystems.

### **Experience**

* Experience designing enterprise data, analytics, AI/ML, and integration solutions.

879f54ac.description:
Are you a technical leader who thrives on solving complex architectural challenges while building and growing high\-performing teams? Amazon is looking for a Solutions Architect Manager to lead a team of solutions architects who design and deliver scalable, reliable systems that directly impact how our customers experience our products and services. In this role, you will define the strategic direction for your team, partner with cross\-functional stakeholders, and drive architectural decisions that balance performance, cost, security, and operational excellence. You will navigate ambiguity, set clear goals, and establish the metrics that measure success — all while developing the next generation of technical talent on your team.



Key job responsibilities


* Define and communicate team vision, goals, and long\-term strategy by working backwards from customer problems, partnering with stakeholders across engineering, product, and business teams to align on priorities and architectural direction.
* Lead architectural reviews and drive system design decisions, evaluating tradeoffs across reliability, security, performance, and cost while ensuring solutions are scalable and maintainable over time.
* Build, grow, and manage an inclusive team of solutions architects, providing coaching, career development, and actionable feedback that empowers each team member to deliver results and advance their professional growth.
* Establish workflows, service level agreements, and audit mechanisms that ensure operational excellence, data\-driven decision\-making, and measurable quality across your team's deliverables.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes and reduce complexity, leveraging generative artificial intelligence tools and reusable patterns to improve team productivity and accelerate solution delivery.


A day in the life You might start your morning reviewing an architecture proposal from a team member, asking targeted questions that sharpen the design before a stakeholder review. After a quick sync with partner engineering teams to align on integration timelines, you shift into a one\-on\-one with a direct report to discuss their development goals and an upcoming stretch project. Later, you prepare a narrative for leadership that outlines your team's progress against quarterly objectives and flags emerging risks. Throughout, you balance hands\-on technical guidance with the strategic thinking needed to keep your team moving in the right direction.



About the team Our team is focused on designing solutions that help Travel \& Logistics customers in India build and scale systems that they can rely on every day. We work closely with engineering, product, and business partners to turn complex requirements into clear, actionable architectures. We value collaboration, intellectual curiosity, and a commitment to operational rigor. As we look ahead, we are investing in new approaches to accelerate how we deliver solutions — and we want leaders who are excited to shape that future while building a team culture grounded in trust, inclusion, and continuous learning.


### **Basic Qualifications**


* 10\+ years of architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc. experience
* 2\+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* 8\+ years of technology solutions development and evangelising end\-to\-end technology roadmaps that guide IT transformations toward cloud computing experience
* Bachelor's degree

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience in cloud architecture and CXO level engagement


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit \[https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations) for more information. 003d5958.title: GCP Solution Architect-VOIS
003d5958.description:
**Who we are**
--------------



VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
  

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
  

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  

\#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------



We are seeking a skilled and hands\-on GCP Platform Engineer to join our Data \& Analytics team in Pune. This role is focused on building, operating, automating, and continuously improving Google Cloud Platform services that support applications, analytics platforms, automation workloads, and data solutions. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring platform reliability, security, observability, scalability, and cost efficiency while enabling the onboarding of new services and solutions. This opportunity is ideally suited to professionals with strong GCP engineering expertise, infrastructure automation experience, and a collaborative Agile delivery mindset.

**What you’ll do**
------------------



Build, operate, and maintain platform services across Google Cloud Platform.  

Support the onboarding of applications, automation workloads, data pipelines, and internal platform services.  

Provision, configure, and manage cloud infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code practices.  

Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines, Git\-based workflows, and automated deployment processes.  

Manage GCP services including IAM, VPC, GCS, BigQuery, GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Composer, Pub/Sub, Cloud Logging, and Cloud Monitoring.  

Implement and maintain security guardrails covering access management, secrets management, compliance, tagging, and governance standards.  

Manage Kubernetes\-based workloads and containerised platforms using Docker and GKE.  

Troubleshoot and resolve platform issues across compute, networking, storage, orchestration, monitoring, and identity layers.  

Create and maintain reusable Terraform modules, deployment frameworks, operational runbooks, SOPs, and technical documentation.  

Support platform operations including upgrades, patching, vulnerability remediation, incident response, and access reviews.  

Monitor platform performance, reliability, and utilisation, identifying opportunities for service optimisation and automation.  

Collaborate within Agile teams, contributing to sprint planning, backlog refinement, and continuous improvement activities.

**Who you are**
---------------



Degree or higher qualification in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.  

Minimum 5 years of professional experience in cloud engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, or related fields.  

Strong hands\-on experience configuring, deploying, and managing services within Google Cloud Platform.  

Experience with GCP services including IAM, VPC, Cloud Storage, BigQuery, GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Composer, Pub/Sub, Monitoring, and Logging.  

Strong expertise in Terraform or comparable Infrastructure as Code solutions.  

Experience building and supporting CI/CD pipelines and Git\-based development workflows.  

Good understanding of Kubernetes, Docker, networking concepts, firewall rules, service accounts, private connectivity, and secrets management.  

Proficiency in Python, Bash, or similar scripting languages.  

Ability to diagnose and resolve complex cloud platform issues across multiple technology layers.  

Experience creating operational documentation, runbooks, support procedures, and implementation standards.  

Knowledge of platform maintenance activities including patching, upgrades, vulnerability remediation, and governance processes.  

Experience working within Agile delivery frameworks such as Scrum, Kanban, or SAFe.  

Strong communication, stakeholder engagement, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills.  

Experience with Airflow/Cloud Composer, BigQuery operations, data pipelines, Dataflow, or Spark workloads is advantageous.  

Exposure to Site Reliability Engineering practices, production support, incident response, and automation\-driven operations is preferred.

**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------



Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------



Opportunity to work within a global Data \& Analytics environment supporting enterprise\-scale cloud platforms.  

Exposure to modern cloud\-native technologies, platform engineering practices, and automation frameworks.  

Opportunity to contribute to strategic cloud migration and transformation programmes.  

Collaborative Agile working environment with opportunities to influence platform standards and best practices.  

Experience working with global stakeholders and cross\-functional engineering teams.  

Opportunity to enhance cloud, DevOps, security, and operational excellence capabilities.

**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------



Advanced Google Cloud Platform architecture and platform operations.  

Enterprise\-scale Infrastructure as Code and cloud automation practices.  

Platform reliability engineering, observability, and incident management techniques.  

Cloud governance, security, and compliance implementation in large organisations.  

FinOps fundamentals, cloud cost optimisation, and resource utilisation management.  

Agile delivery practices and collaborative platform engineering methodologies.  

Large\-scale migration, modernisation, and cloud transformation approaches.

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
----------------------------------------------



Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.

**Join Us**
-----------



At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  

With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

Apply for Vodafone jobs only through the official Vodafone Careers website to avoid job scams and fraud.
  

\#JDEnhancedByTARA

-----------------------------

7ed7abc4.title: Technical Program Manager, Stores Application Security
7ed7abc4.description:
**Description**
 Amazon Application Security is looking for a security\-focused Technical Program Manager who wants to make a difference and support Amazon builders to ensure that protecting customer data is at the forefront of all development.
   

  

 Our team approaches security challenges with empathy and curiosity to help Amazon builders identify areas of improvement and learn how to navigate the highly dynamic space of application security. Amazon Application Security focuses on enabling our builders to provide a secure and trustworthy experience to our customers without compromising the overall customer experience.
   

  

 In this role you will work directly with security teams and Amazon builders providing direct front line support and security expertise to Amazon teams.
   

  

 You’ll also find this role will routinely challenge your background in technical product ownership, process development, operational and management skills, project management, critical thinking, relationship\-building, and problem\-solving. You’ll also find yourself challenged in unique ways when operating at the massive scale of Amazon, unique to a select few corporations in the world. You must be self\-directed and open to new challenges, adept at prioritization, innovation, and collaborating with others.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Plan, organize, and manage all phases of the project lifecycle ensuring successful delivery. This includes defining success criteria, developing and managing project governance plans, project schedules, team goals, communication strategies and project milestones.
* Collaborate with internal customers (senior business leaders, development teams, application security engineering teams and other partner security teams) to understand their needs, their business and how we can improve their security posture.
* Architect and manage internal scope of work documents with the customer clearly defining success criteria and timelines. Hold all stakeholders accountable to these documents through the project lifecycle, escalating as necessary.
* Build and manage relationships with key internal stakeholders and security teams and while advocating on behalf of our customers to deliver on their security goals.
* Guide the evolution and adoption of internal security support solutions, at times with complex priorities, prioritizing the work most beneficial to Amazon builders.
* Use knowledge of software system design to scope architecture, review associated threat models, educate customers on potential severity of security findings and guide developer and security engineering teams through remediation.
* Define and implement best practice methods, processes, tools and continuous improvement initiatives aimed at scaling and increasing the efficiency of Amazon’s security guidance and builder support processes.
* Own the creation and delivery of business proposals (growth, new areas of focus, etc) and metrics to security leadership.
* Proactively identify and manage program risk, identifying paths to overcome risks, and escalating when necessary
* Work effectively and make sound decisions in a dynamic environment with changing priorities.
* Influence, negotiate, resolve conflicts and achieve results through others who are not direct reports.
* Foster a positive work environment leveraging existing skills in active listening, encouraging diverse perspectives and adapting to a variety of personality types.


**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why Amazon Security
   

  

 At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. The role involves translating complex business and technical requirements into scalable solution designs, evaluating multiple architectural options, conducting cost\-benefit analysis, and recommending optimized solutions. * Define solution and system architectures in alignment with enterprise architecture strategies, standards, reference architectures, and technology principles.
* Decompose systems into components, perform functional allocation, and establish interfaces between systems and system components.

* Design scalable architecture solutions for cloud\-based platforms, enterprise applications, data and analytics platforms, and integrated systems.

* Analyze infrastructure and technology capacity and provide recommendations to support current and future business needs.
* Maintain awareness of emerging technologies, software trends, tools, and industry practices and assess their applicability to business solutions.
* Support the adoption of Agile, DevSecOps, CI/CD, automation, and modern software delivery practices.
* Identify, assess, and manage technical risks and issues and drive appropriate mitigation actions.

**About The Job**
 Job Title: Salesforce Technical Architect (Revenue Management / ARM Specialist)
   

  

 Experience: 9–12 Years
   

  

 Employment Type: Permanent \| Full\-Time
   

  

 Shift \& Hours: Regular Shift
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Technical Architect with 9 to 12 years of progressive enterprise experience, specializing in Salesforce Revenue Cloud / Agentforce Revenue Management (ARM). In this role, you will define overarching technical architectures and provide thought leadership to unlock maximum business value for our clients. You will bridge complex business processes with end\-to\-end technical solutions—spanning CPQ, Revenue Cloud/ARM, Billing, and ERP integrations—while building trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Architecture \& Solution Design: Lead end\-to\-end Salesforce system and solution architecture (functional and technical). Design scalable revenue architecture solutions using Salesforce ARM / Revenue Cloud, ensuring alignment with enterprise roadmaps and domain blueprints. ARM \& Revenue Lifecycle Leadership: Own technical delivery for Quote\-to\-Cash (Q2 C) processes, including product catalog design, complex pricing models (subscription, usage\-based, volume\-based), order orchestration, automated billing, and revenue recognition. Stakeholder \& Client Engagement: Engage senior client leadership in business\-outcome\-oriented conversations. Articulate platform value propositions, conduct gap analyses, and apply Design Thinking (Customer Journey Mapping and Service Blueprints). Technical Ownership \& Documentation: Own implementation tasks across full lifecycle delivery—from requirements scoping to deployment. Create detailed technical documentation (High\-Level Design/HLD, Low\-Level Design/LLD) and dynamic architectural diagrams. Integrations \& Data Strategy: Formulate master data management (MDM), data migration, and enterprise application integration strategies (connecting Salesforce ARM with ERPs, middleware/i Paa S, and upstream/downstream systems). Hands\-on Technical Guidance: Guide development teams in platform customization and technical execution, including AMPScript, SSJS, SQL, Data Extensions, advanced triggers, automations, and complex business logic. Team Leadership \& Delivery: Lead delivery teams, manage resource requirements, establish delivery plans, perform effort estimations, and mentor technical team members in a problem\-solving environment.
   

  

**Qualifications \& Requirements**
 Experience: 9–12 years of progressive experience in Salesforce delivery management, technical architecture, business analysis, and full lifecycle enterprise CRM implementations. ARM / Revenue Cloud Expertise: Proven expertise in Salesforce ARM (Agentforce Revenue Management / Revenue Cloud), Salesforce CPQ, and Billing engines. Deep understanding of advanced revenue management workflows, contract lifecycle management, and asset state management. Certifications: Salesforce Certified System / Application Architect, Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA), or Salesforce CPQ / Revenue Cloud / Cloud Sense certifications highly preferred. Core Competencies: Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills with an ability to present to executive audiences. Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and conflict\-management skills. Demonstrated track record of building, managing, and sustaining team\-oriented environments. Professional demeanor with a strong client\-first mentality and desire to innovate in a fast\-paced ecosystem.

bd84e8ab.title: Senior Solutions Architect, Generative AI
bd84e8ab.description:
NVIDIA is seeking a dynamic and experienced Generative AI Solution Architect with specialized expertise in training Large Language Models (LLMs) and implementing workflows based on Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG). As a key member of our AI Solutions team, you will play a pivotal role in architecting and delivering cutting\-edge solutions that leverage the power of NVIDIA's generative AI technologies. This position requires a deep understanding of language models, particularly LLMs, and a strong proficiency in designing and implementing RAG\-based workflows.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Architect end\-to\-end generative AI solutions with a focus on LLMs and RAG workflows.
* Collaborate closely with customers to understand their language\-related business challenges and design tailored solutions.
* Collaborate with sales and business development teams to support pre\-sales activities, including technical presentations and demonstrations of LLM and RAG capabilities.
* Work closely with NVIDIA engineering teams to provide feedback and contribute to the evolution of generative AI technologies.
* Engage directly with customers to understand their language\-related requirements and challenges.
* Lead workshops and design sessions to define and refine generative AI solutions focused on LLMs and RAG workflows and lead the training and optimization of Large Language Models using NVIDIA’s hardware and software platforms.
* Implement strategies for efficient and effective training of LLMs to achieve optimal performance.
* Design and implement RAG\-based workflows to enhance content generation and information retrieval.
* Work closely with customers to integrate RAG workflows into their applications and systems and stay abreast of the latest developments in language models and generative AI technologies.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance on best practices for training LLMs and implementing RAG\-based solutions.


**What We Need To See**
* Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent experience
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in a technical role, specifically focusing on generative AI, with a strong emphasis on training Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Proven track record of successfully deploying and optimizing LLM models for inference in production environments.
* In\-depth understanding of state\-of\-the\-art language models, including but not limited to GPT\-3, BERT, or similar architectures.
* Expertise in training and fine\-tuning LLMs using popular frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face Transformers.
* Proficiency in model deployment and optimization techniques for efficient inference on various hardware platforms, with a focus on GPUs.
* Strong knowledge of GPU cluster architecture and the ability to leverage parallel processing for accelerated model training and inference.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading workshops, training sessions, and presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Experience in deploying LLM models in cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and on\-premises infrastructure.
* Proven ability to optimize LLM models for inference speed, memory efficiency, and resource utilization.
* Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes) for scalable and efficient model deployment.
* Deep understanding of GPU cluster architecture, parallel computing, and distributed computing concepts.
* Hands\-on experience with NVIDIA GPU technologies, and GPU cluster management and ability to design and implement scalable and efficient workflows for LLM training and inference on GPU clusters


 With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our exclusive engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you! NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

6ab6488c.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
6ab6488c.description:
**About The Company**
 Forsys Inc is a leading global technology solutions provider dedicated to delivering innovative and comprehensive IT services to clients across various industries. With a strong focus on digital transformation, cloud computing, and enterprise solutions, Forsys Inc has built a reputation for excellence in delivering tailored technology strategies that drive business growth and operational efficiency. Our commitment to quality, innovation, and client satisfaction positions us as a trusted partner for organizations seeking to leverage technology for competitive advantage. We foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that encourages continuous learning and professional development, ensuring our team remains at the forefront of technological advancements.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Technical Architect specializing in Revenue Management and ARM (Agentforce Revenue Management) to join our dynamic team. This full\-time, permanent role requires a professional with 9 to 12 years of enterprise\-level experience in Salesforce solutions, particularly in Revenue Cloud and related modules. As a Salesforce Technical Architect, you will be responsible for designing and implementing scalable, end\-to\-end revenue management solutions that align with client business objectives. You will serve as a technical leader, providing strategic guidance and hands\-on expertise to ensure successful delivery of complex Salesforce projects. Your ability to bridge technical solutions with business needs will be critical in driving value for our clients and establishing long\-term trusted relationships with key stakeholders.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 To be successful in this role, candidates should possess a strong background in Salesforce enterprise solutions, with extensive experience in Revenue Cloud and ARM modules. Certifications such as Salesforce Certified System Architect, Application Architect, or Technical Architect are highly preferred. A deep understanding of Salesforce CPQ, Billing, and revenue recognition processes is essential. Candidates should demonstrate excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences. Proven leadership capabilities, problem\-solving skills, and experience managing full lifecycle Salesforce implementations are critical. A professional demeanor, client\-first attitude, and a passion for innovation in a fast\-paced environment are also required.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 As a Salesforce Technical Architect, your responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Architecture \& Solution Design: Lead the development of comprehensive Salesforce system architectures, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with enterprise roadmaps. Design technical blueprints for Revenue Cloud and ARM implementations that support business growth and process efficiencies.
* ARM \& Revenue Lifecycle Leadership: Manage the technical aspects of Quote\-to\-Cash (Q2C) processes, including product catalog management, complex pricing models (subscription, usage\-based, volume\-based), order orchestration, automated billing, and revenue recognition strategies.
* Stakeholder \& Client Engagement: Collaborate with senior client stakeholders to understand business needs, articulate platform capabilities, and conduct gap analyses. Use design thinking methodologies to map customer journeys and develop service blueprints that enhance user experiences.
* Technical Ownership \& Documentation: Oversee the full project lifecycle from requirements gathering to deployment. Create detailed technical documentation, including High\-Level Design (HLD), Low\-Level Design (LLD), and architectural diagrams to ensure clarity and maintainability.
* Integrations \& Data Strategy: Develop strategies for master data management, data migration, and enterprise application integration. Connect Salesforce ARM with ERP systems, middleware solutions, and other upstream/downstream systems to ensure seamless data flow.
* Hands\-on Technical Guidance: Provide technical mentorship to development teams, guiding platform customization, scripting (AMPScript, SSJS), SQL queries, data extensions, triggers, automations, and complex business logic implementations.
* Team Leadership \& Delivery: Lead project teams, manage resource allocation, establish delivery timelines, perform effort estimations, and mentor team members to foster a collaborative and problem\-solving environment.


**Benefits**
 At Forsys Inc, we value our employees and offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your professional and personal well\-being. Our benefits include competitive salary packages, health insurance plans, and retirement savings options. We promote work\-life balance through flexible working hours and encourage ongoing professional development with training programs, certifications, and knowledge\-sharing sessions. Our inclusive culture fosters innovation and collaboration, providing opportunities for career growth within a supportive environment. Additionally, employees have access to various wellness initiatives and employee assistance programs to ensure a healthy work environment.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity
   

  

 Forsys Inc is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that a diverse workforce enhances our ability to serve our clients effectively and fosters a culture of innovation and respect. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected status.

e23db02a.title: Cloud Platform Architect
e23db02a.description:
SambaNova is a leader in next\-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full\-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi\-turn agents, code generation, and long\-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack\-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state\-of\-the\-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Cloud Platform team owns the production inferencing service that serves SambaNova's models to customers on RDU accelerators, including capacity planning, deployment, monitoring, and incident response across regions in the United States, Asia, Europe, and Latin America.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Cloud Operations team is seeking an experienced engineering leader to scale the platform our internal and external customers use to access SambaNova RDUs.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 In this role, you'll architecting our next\-generation system from the ground up, running the Kubernetes infrastructure that powers some of the most advanced AI workloads in the industry, and bridging multi\-cloud and on\-prem environments in ways no generic SaaS company can offer. Your work will directly impact the productivity of every engineer at SambaNova and by extension, the speed at which we ship the future of AI computing.
   

  

 Some of your responsibilities include:
   

  

* Architect, build, and maintain our next\-generation internal developer platform, automating and streamlining our cloud and on\-prem infrastructure
* Design, write, and manage Terraform modules to provision and manage resources across AWS, GCP, and Azure, ensuring consistency and reproducibility
* Build and manage highly available, secure, and performant Kubernetes clusters that serve as the primary runtime for our diverse AI workloads
* Design and implement robust networking solutions (VPCs, load balancers, firewalls, service meshes) that seamlessly connect our multi\-cloud and hybrid environments
* Collaborate with AI and software engineering teams to understand their needs, provide golden paths to production, and build internal tools that accelerate their development cycles
* Implement best practices for observability (monitoring, logging, tracing) to ensure system reliability and performance, and participate in on\-call rotation


**Required Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Cloud Infrastructure roles
* Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Go, Rust)
* Expertise with Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, or self\-managed) in production environments \- pods, operators, CRDs, CNIs, etc.
* Expertise with Infrastructure as Code with the ability to manage complex, multi\-cloud environments
* Strong proficiency with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure), with a solid understanding of the core services (compute, storage, networking, IAM)
* Networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, load balancing) and security best practices in the cloud


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in a hybrid environment bridging cloud and on\-premise/data center infrastructure
* Experience managing infrastructure for data\-intensive or ML/AI workloads
* Knowledge of building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, ArgoCD)
* Experience with service mesh technologies (e.g., Istio, Linkerd)
* Contributions to open\-source projects or a public portfolio of code (GitHub)

 ₹10,300,000—₹12,500,000 INR

**EEO Policy**
 SambaNova Systems is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard basis of age (40 and over), color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, national origin/ancestry, race, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding), sexual orientation, and any other applicable status protected by federal, state, or local laws.
   

  

**Benefits Summary For US\-Based, Full\-Time Employment Positions**
 SambaNova offers a competitive total rewards package, including the base salary, plus equity and benefits. We cover 95% premium coverage for employee medical insurance, and 77% premium coverage for dependents and offer a Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution. We also offer Dental, Vision, Short/Long term Disability, Basic Life, Voluntary Life, and AD\&D insurance plans in addition to Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options like Health Care, Limited Purpose, and Dependent Care.
